context:
Title: Post-2000s Dad's Wild Parenting Style
Description: A young man travels through time, becomes a father to an 8-year-old son, and joins a parenting reality show where he challenges traditional education methods with his gaming-friendly approach.

INT. GAMING ROOM - DAY

Quick cuts: RGB lights syncing to a quiet hum. A gaming chair still warm. Code on a monitor shifts to a child's screensaver.

KUNHUN (O.S.)
Dad. You promised me a study desk. This is a gaming throne.

KUNHUN pulls AICHEN's hand, his expression caught between hope and disappointment. AICHEN (25, eyes still adjusting to this timeline) looks at the setup like it's evidence in a trial.

A CAMERAMAN edges into frame, capturing the moment.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Education Master System initialized. Current reputation: 0. Demonstrate your philosophy.

A translucent UI materializes: [REPUTATION: 0]. It highlights Kunhun's frayed backpack strap, the tell of weight carried.

AICHEN
(stunned whisper)
Philosophy?

AICHEN (V.O.)
In my past life, screens were the enemy. Eighteen years of digital exile meant freedom tasted like regret. I won't build his cage from the same keys.

AICHEN looks at Kunhun. Sees the kid he could have been.

AICHEN
Desk upgrade pending. Homework—show me the damage.

KUNHUN extracts a workbook, every answer correct but the pages thin from eraser burn.

AICHEN
You did the work. You kept the promise.

He sets the book down with respect, not dismissal.

AICHEN
Now I keep mine. One mission.

KUNHUN
(suspiciously)
This is a loyalty test. For the cameras.

AICHEN
(hands him a controller)
This is a trust fall. I'll catch you.

CAMERAMAN
We're live in ninety seconds.

AICHEN
Perfect. We'll show them the tutorial.

He helps Kunhun into the co-pilot chair. They load a cooperative puzzle game. Problem-solving, not violence.
continuation:
INT. STUDIO - DAY

HOST XIAO SA faces the audience and panel.

XIAO SA
"Parenting Done Right." Three methods. One million yuan. Your vote decides which child gets the future you trust.

The central screen illuminates.

INT. ZHANG YAN'S HOME - DAY

ZHANG YAN mops with metronomic intensity. Daughter ZI HAN writes, flinching at every splash.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

AUDIENCE MEMBER A (Female)
She sacrifices everything.

OBSERVER A (Female)
Everything includes her daughter's focus.

AUDIENCE MEMBER B (Female)
I saw the girl lose her place three times.

The screen transitions.

INT. WANG LEI'S HOME - DAY

WANG LEI stands over son WANG ZIXUAN, who's clutching a phone like a lifeline.

WANG LEI
(shouting)
Run! Run from your potential! Run!

Zixuan runs. Not away—he runs stairs. Punishment laps. His face is stone.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

AUDIENCE MEMBER C (Male)
Tough love built our generation.

OBSERVER B (Female)
Tough love, or just tough?

AUDIENCE MEMBER B (Female)
First was love through labor. Second, love through fear. What could possibly be third?

The screen reveals Aichen and Kunhun.

INT. GAMING ROOM - DAY

AICHEN and KUNHUN wear headsets, but their eyes meet across the monitors. Their game—a city builder—requires planning, resource management, compromise.

KUNHUN
(into mic)
Dad, if I zone the residential wrong, the whole simulation collapses.

AICHEN
(into mic)
Then we rezone. Failure's just data.

The system UI pulses: [REPUTATION +250].

KUNHUN
Will this hurt my chances at... the good schools?

AICHEN
You're building a functional economy at eight. I'd say you're auditing college courses.

KUNHUN
(laughs)
Can we put a skate park in the university quad?

AICHEN
Design it for the kid you are. Not the resume they want.

The system UI glows: [MILESTONE: Authentic Play].

INT. STUDIO - DAY

The footage freezes on Kunhun's face—alive, deciding.

XIAO SA
Sacrifice. Authority. Or... collaboration?

OBSERVER A
The boy's hands move with purpose. Not escape.

AUDIENCE C
My son is asking me what game that is.

XIAO SA
Vote now. But remember—one child wins the fund. A million children watch the lesson.

INT. GAMING ROOM - DAY

Kunhun saves his progress. Logs off. No argument.

KUNHUN
Dad? That was the best homework ever.

AICHEN
System, status.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
[REPUTATION: 1,850]. Not trending. Enduring.

Aichen watches Kunhun drift toward bed, already sketching tomorrow's build.

AICHEN (V.O.)
Maybe the best parenting isn't a system to game.

He turns off the rig. The RGB fades to a single nightlight.

AICHEN (V.O.)
It's a campaign we choose to play together.

FADE OUT.

title: My Love Begins With You

context:
Title: My Love Begins With You
Description: A young woman attends a business dinner to help her mother, only to encounter a man from her past who reveals a shocking secret.

INT. HOTEL HALLWAY - NIGHT

CLOSE UP - A pair of nude-colored high heels walking on a carpeted hallway. The steps are measured, controlled.

Camera tilts up to reveal GU XINING in a white blouse and blue skirt. Determination barely masks her tension.

GU XINING (V.O.)
For Mom's sake. Just get through tonight.

GU XINING arrives at a door marked 1958, swipes her card with a trembling hand, and enters.

INT. HOTEL PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

GENERAL WANG stands too close to GU XINING, his hand a weight on her shoulder. GU XINING holds a wine glass like a shield.

GENERAL WANG
The Fangyuan project is yours. Your mother would be proud.

GU XINING
(frozen smile)
I'm grateful for the opportunity.

The door opens.

JIN BEICHUAN stands motionless in the doorway. His gaze locks with GU XINING's.
continuation:
GENERAL WANG
(standing quickly)
Jin! We didn't expect—

JIN BEICHUAN
(entering)
My plans changed. How fortunate.

His eyes note GENERAL WANG's hand, GU XINING's rigid posture.

JIN BEICHUAN
(to GU XINING)
Jingbei taught us negotiation, didn't it? Some tactics shouldn't require repetition.

GENERAL WANG
Both Jingbei alumni—perfect for the project!

JIN BEICHUAN
A collaborative partnership. That's what we called it.

He moves closer. GU XINING's knuckles whiten on her glass.

JIN BEICHUAN
Six months of research. Shared resources. Shared space.

JIN BEICHUAN
Shared a bed.

CLOSE UP - GU XINING's face. Shock flickers, then something harder: recognition of a trap. Her jaw sets.

Title: The Nation's Mighty Dragon
Description: A powerful commander returns to eliminate an international criminal who traffics children and threatens national security.

INT. HELICOPTER - DAY

SOUND of helicopter blades whirring.

A helicopter flies over a coastal city at dusk.

Inside, MU SHAOFENG, dressed in a black leather coat, sits calmly. He opens a vintage pocket watch, revealing a photo of a young girl—his daughter.

CAN LANG (V.O.)
Sir, we've confirmed the location. Port 7 warehouse. Six children inside.

MU SHAOFENG
Land. This ends tonight.

He closes the pocket watch with a determined look.

EXT. AIRFIELD - DAY

CAN LANG leads a group of soldiers in tactical gear. They stand in formation as the helicopter lands.

MU SHAOFENG exits the helicopter with a commanding presence.

SOLDIERS
(in unison)
Welcome, General!

The soldiers kneel on one knee in two rows, creating a path for MU SHAOFENG.

MU SHAOFENG walks forward, followed by CAN LANG.

MU SHAOFENG
All units, extract the children. Poison Fang is mine.

SOLDIERS
(in unison)
Yes, sir!
continuation:
INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Two terrified CHILDREN are huddled together inside a large metal cage.

POISON FANG, with a distinctive wolf tattoo, crouches by the cage, taunting them.

POISON FANG
Such clear eyes. Such healthy organs. You'll make me rich.

A SUBORDINATE approaches him.

SUBORDINATE
Boss, everything's ready for tomorrow's shipment.

Suddenly, a voice echoes through the warehouse.

MU SHAOFENG (V.O.)
Poison Fang. You traffic children, collude with foreign powers, threaten national security.

POISON FANG and his men look around, startled.

POISON FANG
Who's there? Show yourself!

MU SHAOFENG (V.O.)
Three crimes. One sentence.

MU SHAOFENG walks into the light, confronting them.

POISON FANG
You're a dead man walking.

MU SHAOFENG
(smiles)
Justice doesn't wait.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Prince's Awakening
description: A modern man finds himself transported into an ancient painting, awakening as the Crown Prince of the Great Qin Empire, only to discover a conspiracy against him.
context:
Title: The Prince's Awakening
Description: A modern man finds himself transported into an ancient painting, awakening as the Crown Prince of the Great Qin Empire, only to discover a conspiracy against him.

INT. MODERN OFFICE - DAY

A young man in a suit (THE PRINCE) sits in a luxurious office chair, slowly unrolling an ancient scroll painting.

THE PRINCE (V.O.)
Seventy million yuan for a painting. The board wants my head, but the Jade Maiden... she recognized me.

He traces the woman's face with his finger. The silk seems to breathe beneath his touch. The lights flicker—then die. The city skyline dissolves into darkness.

The woman in the painting turns her head. Looks at him.

THE PRINCE
(whisper)
That's not—

ZHAO RUI (O.S.)
Am I beautiful?

THE PRINCE recoils. ZHAO RUI stands before him—identical to the painting, but alive. Breathing.

Reality warps. The office dissolves like ink in water.

INT. ANCIENT PALACE CHAMBER - DAY

THE PRINCE snaps awake in ancient robes, his head pillowed on ZHAO RUI's lap. The scent of sandalwood fills his lungs.

THE PRINCE
(struggling upright)
I was just—

ZHAO RUI
(gently)
Your Highness. You fainted.

She holds a calligraphy brush, ink still wet on the tip.

ZHAO RUI (CONT'D)
(leaning close)
There's a mark I've been meaning to show you. A mole, here.

THE PRINCE
(fighting dizziness)
My office. The painting—

Pain lances through his skull. Memories bloom: a crown, a throne room, this woman's face at a court ceremony.

THE PRINCE (V.O.)
Hostile takeover. I'm wearing another man's sins.

ZHAO RUI
continuation:
Your Highness?

THE PRINCE looks at her—really looks. The careful way she holds herself. The rehearsed blush.

THE PRINCE
Show me.

ZHAO RUI
(breath catching)
Your Highness...

She reaches for her collar.

THE PRINCE (V.O.)
Six months ago, she entered the Eastern Palace. The old me treated her like a goddess. Untouchable. But her pulse is too steady.

THE PRINCE grabs her wrist.

THE PRINCE
Tell me, Zhao Rui... if you were truly mine, what would you give up for me?

ZHAO RUI
Everything. I am devoted—

THE PRINCE
Even your clan? The Prime Minister's ambitions? The Empress's favor?

ZHAO RUI
(panicking)
I don't understand what you—

THE PRINCE
You understand perfectly. They sent you to make me weak. Distracted. To prove I'm unfit for the succession.

ZHAO RUI
(voice shaking)
I'm just a woman.

THE PRINCE
(finger to her lips)
No. You're a battlefield. And I intend to win.

THE PRINCE tears her garment slightly at the shoulder. The silk whispers.

ZHAO RUI
(startled)
They'll say you're depraved.

THE PRINCE
(smiling)
Then let them. Let them see exactly what they wanted.

THE PRINCE leans in. The screen fades to black.

title: Her Son Was Targeted by the Boss

context:
Title: Her Son Was Targeted by the Boss
Description: A woman scorned by her cheating fiancé seeks revenge at a bar, leading to a fateful encounter with a powerful man from her fiancé's own family.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

QIAO JING (eldest daughter of the Qiao family) sits at the bar, her phone screen showing Yan Xuan's betrayal. She drains her martini.

QIAO JING (V.O.)
Three years. A text message. "Sorry, things changed." Watch what change looks like, Yan Xuan.

A SLEAZY MAN approaches.

SLEAZY MAN
Beautiful lady, let me erase your ex for you.

QIAO JING
You're not my type.

SLEAZY MAN
(grabbing her wrist)
Let me change your mind—

YAN QIN (head of the Yan family) appears, gripping the man's wrist.

SLEAZY MAN
(terrified)
Fourth Master Yan...

YAN QIN
Disappear.

The Sleazy Man flees.

QIAO JING studies YAN QIN through her drunken haze, then drapes her arms over his shoulders.

YAN QIN
You're playing with fire.

QIAO JING
I came here to burn it all down.

She kisses him. His hand finds her waist. He doesn't pull away.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

The door slams. Silk shimmers to the floor. YAN QIN and QIAO JING tumble onto the bed.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - NIGHT

QIAO WU (second daughter of the Qiao family) strides in, YAN XUAN following.

QIAO WU
(consulting phone)
Room 1808. She's so predictably desperate.

YAN XUAN
(furious)
If she's with someone—

QIAO WU (V.O.)
Then you'll need a new fiancée. Someone loyal. Someone who knows family secrets.

She pockets her phone.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

QIAO JING straddles YAN QIN on the bed, her fingers tracing his scar.

YAN QIN
You know who I am?

QIAO JING
(laughing)
Your nephew's ex-fiancée. The one he fears.

YAN QIN
Are you sure?

QIAO JING
Wasn't yesterday.

She kisses his scar.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

QIAO WU and YAN XUAN stop at Room 1808. YAN XUAN's hand trembles on the handle.

YAN XUAN
(venomous)
This ends tonight.

QIAO WU
For her, yes.

He throws the door open. Inside: empty champagne bottles, a silk tie monogrammed YQ, the bed still warm. The window drapes billow. Empty.

YAN XUAN
Where—

QIAO WU checks her phone. A new message: "With Fourth Master. Safe."

She stares at the tie. Her smile vanishes.

QIAO WU
(whisper)
You stupid girl.

ON SCREEN: THE END

Title: Rise from Humble Beginnings
Description: A modern poetry champion finds himself transported to ancient times after a mysterious earthquake, waking up bound in a woodshed far from his former life of luxury.

INT. MODERN LOFT - NIGHT

Candlelight flickers. GU QING is tied to a chair with silk rope, smiling.

ZHANG XIAOMAN (V.O.)
Brother Gu Qing, you're so predictable when you win.

ZHANG XIAOMAN, wearing a black silk dress, walks up to GU QING.

ZHANG XIAOMAN
This year's Poetry Competition. First place. Again.

GU QING
(smiling proudly)
Winning is a habit. Understanding the price—that's the art.

LI SHISHI, wearing a red dress, approaches from behind and rests her hands on GU QING's shoulders.

GU QING
Soon you'll find out that I'm even better in other ways.

LI SHISHI
Brother Qing, you're playing a dangerous game.

ZHANG XIAOMAN sits on GU QING's lap. The three share a charged moment.

GU QING
You're both afraid of the silence after the applause.

LI SHISHI
Then show us there's nothing to fear.

GU QING
What? Can't wait already?

ZHANG XIAOMAN
The great poet has been working all day. We should help you... relax properly.

Suddenly, the room SHAKES. The floor SPLITS with a glowing seam.

GU QING
(panicking)
What the hell?

The chair TIPS backward. He VANISHES into the light.
continuation:
EXT. DALIANG CAPITAL CITY - DAY

Majestic ancient city gates. Soldiers ride horses beneath poetry banners.

INT. WOODSHED - DAY

GU QING, now wearing ancient clothing, is tied to a chair with rough hemp rope. He wakes up with a start.

GU QING
(shouting)
Xiaoman! Shishi! The floor—!

He looks around and realizes the environment has completely changed. Two men in ancient clothing enter: a bald, scarred man named ZHANG LONG and his HENCHMAN.

HENCHMAN
Boss, the thief's awake.

ZHANG LONG
(contemptuously)
Thief? He's a ghost. No record of him anywhere.

GU QING
(confused and terrified)
Where is this? Who are you people? Where are my girls?

ZHANG LONG and the HENCHMAN close in on GU QING, their expressions menacing.

Title: Seduced the Wrong Uncle: Madam's Daily Revenge
Description: A secretary is framed for embezzlement and faces arrest, but she holds leverage over her boss after a night together, threatening to expose their affair to his nephew, her fiancé.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: President Nan

QIN KE lies on the sofa, breathless. NAN MING cages her with his arms, suit jacket gone.

ON SCREEN: Night

Their lips meet. A shattered wine glass on the floor.

ON SCREEN: One night passes

INT. OFFICE - DAY

Two SECURITY GUARDS enter the elevator.

QIN KE rises from the sofa, adjusting her red dress.

ON SCREEN: Nan Ming's Office

NAN MING touches the lipstick mark on his jaw. He turns toward QIN KE, lifting her chin.

ON SCREEN: Nanfeng Group President - Nan Ming
ON SCREEN: Nanfeng Group Secretary - Qin Ke

NAN MING
Thirty million in bribes. Police downstairs. Kneel now, and I'll cut three years from your sentence.

QIN KE
(smiling faintly)
Uncle... are you certain I'm the one who took it?
continuation:
KNOCKING at the door.

POLICE (O.S.)
Open up! Police!

QIN KE glances toward the door, blows NAN MING a kiss, then opens it.

She immediately pulls NAN MING against the door, pinning him.

NAN MING
Qin Ke—

QIN KE
Beg?

NAN MING
Your final chance.

QIN KE
Prison for peace? Perfect. But last night... you were compromised. I saved you. The five billion shares from our Liyuan merger—transfer them to Nan Yibo before my sentencing. Your nephew. Your blood. You wouldn't betray family, would you?

NAN MING
(angrily)
Still thinking about money? You have no heart.

QIN KE
I'm his woman, not yours. Whether I have a heart is none of your business.

NAN MING grabs QIN KE, pins her against the door, and kisses her fiercely.

The POLICE burst through the door.

POLICE
Don't move!

Title: Four Treasures Strike: Mommy Prepares to Attack
Description: A hacker child discovers his father is about to marry the woman who wronged his mother six years ago, and rallies his siblings to intervene.

INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

CONGCONG (10, Second Treasure), leather jacket swallowing his frame, types furiously. Sunglasses perch on his head. A lollipop sticks from his mouth.

Monitors glow: news footage shows LING FAMILY HEIR beside TANG QIANQIAN. Headline scrolls: "LING-TANG WEDDING: 7 DAYS."

CONGCONG (V.O.)
Dad's getting married. To the woman who buried Mom six years ago.

A young ASSISTANT enters, holding a burner phone.

ASSISTANT
Boss, DNA match confirmed. Ling Xiang is your father.

CONGCONG takes the phone, studies it. Jaw tightens.

CONGCONG
(into encrypted mic)
Big Brother, Third Brother. Target acquired. Operation Family Extraction is go.

EXT. MOUNTAIN FOREST - DAY

DAXI (11, First Treasure), meditation robes faded, sits on granite. Stillness personified.

His smartwatch vibrates. Encrypted message: "Wedding in 7 days. Tang Qianqian."

DAXI
(soft, certain)
The mountain taught me patience. Not for this.

He stands, bowing to the peaks.
continuation:
EXT. BAMBOO FOREST COTTAGE - DAY

TIANTIAN (9, Third Treasure), lab coat dragging, measures tincture drops. Round glasses magnify focused eyes.

An OLD MAN watches from a wheelchair, breathing eased.

OLD MAN
Little miracle worker. Leaving us?

TIANTIAN
(never looking up)
Family emergency. One drop at dawn, not two.

He checks his cracked tablet. Message: "Wedding. Tang Qianqian."

TIANTIAN
(whisper)
She doesn't get to finish what she started.

EXT. CITY ROAD - NIGHT

TANG YUE (28), helmet on, weaves through traffic. Precise, not reckless.

RADIO BROADCAST (V.O.)
...Ling Xiang and Tang Qianqian's Golden Moon Hotel wedding. A corporate takeover in bridal white...

She stops at a red light. Removes helmet. Face etched with exhaustion.

TANG YUE (V.O.)
Six years dead. Time to RSVP.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT (SIX YEARS AGO)

TITLE: SIX YEARS AGO

TANG YUE (22), tentative, holds a wine glass. TANG QIANQIAN (24) pours, smile sharp as broken glass.

TANG QIANQIAN
One toast, Sister. For your birthday.

She taps the rim. Powder dissolves.

TANG QIANQIAN
(over her shoulder)
The entertainment's here.

THREE MASKED MEN enter. Corporate event masks—owl, fox, stag.

TANG YUE
(stiffening)
Qianqian, what is this?

TANG QIANQIAN
(leaning close)
Your inheritance. Drink.

The men cheer, pressing the glass to TANG YUE's lips. Not violent—insistent. Celebratory.

Her vision blurs. TANG QIANQIAN answers her phone, turning away.

TANG QIANQIAN
(into phone)
It's done. Shares transfer at midnight.

She looks back once. Not triumphant—relieved. As if closing a door.

TANG YUE collapses. The last sound: champagne cork pop. Celebration.

context:
Title: When Will the Moon Be Full & When Will the Moon Shine on My Return
Description: A young man returns to the city, leaving behind his beloved in the countryside, but tragedy strikes before their reunion.

INT. FAREWELL CEREMONY - DAY

Gongs and drums echo across the village square. A banner hangs: "Farewell to Educated Youth." Villagers swarm a registration table.

LI MINGGUANG (23), red flower pinned to his shirt, clutches a worn suitcase. He checks the crowd again, his smile tightening.

LI MINGGUANG (V.O.)
Qiuyue promised she'd come. She never breaks a promise.

He signs the departure ledger with trembling fingers, then brushes dust from his suitcase—faintly embroidered: "Q.M. Forever."

LI MINGGUANG (V.O.)
Unless she's found out.

EXT. LAKESIDE - MEMORY

Young Li Mingguang and LU QIUYUE (18) sit by the lake. She threads a reed through his fingers.

LU QIUYUE
Hold this. Tighter. Like you're holding onto me.

She ties the reed into a ring, then slips a small magnolia hairpin from her braid—tucks it into his palm.

LU QIUYUE
When you see this, you'll remember. I'll come to the city. We'll build a home with real windows.

Li Mingguang clutches the pin, their foreheads touching.

BACK TO:

INT. BUS - DAY

Li Mingguang sits alone, turning the magnolia hairpin over in his fingers. The seat beside him stays empty.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

The bus rumbles forward. LU QIUYUE appears around the bend, sprinting, her braid coming loose. She waves a package.

LU QIUYUE
(calling out)
Mingguang! The puppy—your mother—
continuation:
INT. BUS - DAY

A PASSENGER points out the window.

PASSENGER
Isn't that your girl? Running like her feet are on fire.

Li Mingguang snaps his head around. He shoves the window open, hairpin clutched in his fist.

LI MINGGUANG
Qiuyue! Here—stop!

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

The bus brakes. Qiuyue stumbles to the window, gasping, clutching a squirming black puppy.

LU QIUYUE
(trying to smile)
Your mother wanted you to have Dahuo. For the city. So you won't be alone.

LI MINGGUANG
(taking the puppy)
Qiuyue, listen. I've got work lined up at the steel factory. Three months. Then I'll send for you.

LU QIUYUE
I placed third in the province. On the exam. They'll announce it next week.

Li Mingguang's face lights up.

LI MINGGUANG
Third? Qiuyue, that's—

She presses the reed ring into his hand alongside the puppy.

LU QIUYUE
Keep your window open. I'll find you.

The bus lurches forward. Their hands stretch until only fingertips touch—then separate. Qiuyue stands in the dust, watching until the bus vanishes.

INT. BUS - NIGHT

Li Mingguang tucks the puppy under his coat. He threads the magnolia hairpin through the reed ring, holding it up to catch moonlight.

LI MINGGUANG (V.O.)
Third in the province. She'll get that scholarship. We'll find a place near the university.

Headlights sweep the road. Suddenly, a flock of geese scatters across the headlights. The DRIVER swerves hard.

Metal screams. The bus tilts.

EXT. VILLAGE ENTRANCE - DAYBREAK

Morning mist. Villagers cluster around a radio bulletin. LU QIUYUE pushes through, pale.

RADIO ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
...Bus Seventeen bound for the city was found overturned in the ravine. Rescue efforts continue.

An ELDERLY VILLAGER shakes his head.

ELDERLY VILLAGER
They say no survivors. Not yet.

Qiuyue's knees buckle. She catches herself on a post, then turns and walks away—steadier with each step.

CROWED
Qiuyue? Someone go with her—

INT. LU QIUYUE'S HOME - DAY

Qiuyue sits motionless on the bed. Her MOTHER hovers while an OLD DOCTOR packs his kit.

OLD DOCTOR
(quietly, to the parents)
She's carrying. Early days, but the pulse doesn't lie. And the sickness—morning and night.

FATHER
(whispering, sharp)
Who's the father?

The doctor glances at Qiuyue's steady gaze.

OLD DOCTOR
She hasn't spoken. But she's decided something. I can see it in her spine.

Qiuyue touches her stomach, her face hardening into a mask of determination.

EXT. FROZEN CITY - DAY

The sky is overcast. The city is covered in ice and snow, a scene of apocalypse.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Three months. That's how long the world has been freezing.

INT. ABANDONED BUILDING - DAY

VICTIM (O.S.)
(weakly)

INT. ABANDONED BUILDING HALLWAY - DAY

VICTIM
(struggling)
We had a deal! I gave you everything!

(quietly, almost gentle)
Everything wasn't enough.

The cold takes us all eventually.

continuation:
EXT. SNOWY GROUND - DAY

The VICTIM falls onto the snowy ground. Their body is still. Within seconds, ICE CRYSTALS spiderweb across their skin. A stray dog approaches, nudges the body, then backs away as it begins to freeze solid.

EXT. SHEN YUNAN'S HOUSE ENTRANCE - DAY

Heavy snow falls. XU ZHIYI (28, exhausted but determined), XIAO LIANG (30, handsome but with hollow eyes), and CHEN MENGROU (26, nervous) huddle at the entrance. Xu Zhiyi rubs her hands, her fingers blue at the tips.

XIAO LIANG
(softly)
You're shivering.

XU ZHIYI
(avoiding his gaze)
We shouldn't be here.

CHEN MENGROU
We have to. Your ex... he's the only one with supplies left in this district. The military cleared out yesterday.

XIAO LIANG
(places a hand on Xu Zhiyi's shoulder)
Remember what he was like before all this? He'd have given you the world.

XU ZHIYI
(flinched at his touch)
That was a lifetime ago.

She stares at the door. A flicker of memory crosses her face—falling snow, a different door, a different betrayal. She blinks it away.

XU ZHIYI
(quietly)
He won't help us. Not after what I did.

XIAO LIANG
Then we give him a reason.

Xiao Liang's hand moves to his belt. The kitchen knife handle is visible. Xu Zhiyi sees it. Their eyes meet. Something passes between them—recognition, resignation.

XU ZHIYI
(dully)
I'll try.

She knocks. The sound is muffled by the cold.

XU ZHIYI
Shen Yunan. It's... it's me.

The door opens a crack. SHEN YUNAN (29, hardened, eyes sharp) appears. He sees her. His expression doesn't change, but his grip tightens on the doorframe.

SHEN YUNAN
You're still alive.

XU ZHIYI
(nods, voice breaking)
I need—

XIAO LIANG suddenly grabs Xu Zhiyi from behind, the knife blade cold against her skin. But his grip is loose, his hands trembling.

XIAO LIANG
(shouting)
Open the door, Shen! Or she freezes out here with the rest of us!

SHEN YUNAN's eyes flick from the knife to Xiao Liang's face. He sees the desperation, the calculation. He sees Xu Zhiyi's eyes—wide, but not surprised. She's been here before.

SHEN YUNAN
(stepping out, unarmed)
Let her go. Take me instead.

XIAO LIANG
(laughs, brittle)
You think I'm stupid? Inside. Now.

Shen Yunan holds Xu Zhiyi's gaze for a long moment. Something in her expression makes him pause. Then he opens the door completely.

Waiting inside, barely visible: rows of SUPPLIES. Canned goods. Medicine. And on a table, a PHOTO of Shen Yunan and Xu Zhiyi—years younger, smiling.

XIAO LIANG pushes Xu Zhiyi forward, toward the warmth, toward the past she left behind.

Pests.

Identity?

A dragon among men. An emperor among dragons.

Impossible! You vanished—

My domain is inviolate. Choose your death.

We were forced! Please—let us serve—

Service requires honor.

Emperor. The Northern Seal has finally lifted. Your family—

Where?

Jinghai. Construction site and West Market.

Summon them all. Every. Single. One.

They trust you!

Little Lucky Star JIN BAO weaves between the tables, tossing an immortal peach into the air and catching it. He picks up a jade bottle and takes a sip.

JIN BAO (V.O.)
(panicked)
The celestial nectar! Father will be furious...

JIN BAO
(having a bright idea)
I'll replace it with essence of morning dew—identical appearance!

JIN BAO closes his eyes and casts a spell. The empty jade bottles on the ground are refilled.

IMMORTALS (O.S.)
This year's celestial nectar is purer than the finest jade!

JIN BAO
(nervous)
Someone's coming!

IMMORTALS (O.S.)
Let us toast to the Emperor's health!

JIN BAO quickly hides beneath a banquet table.

The CELESTIAL EMPEROR and the IMMORTALS arrive at the Peach Banquet.

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
(surprised)
Jin Bao? Perfect timing. Help me sample this year's nectar.

JIN BAO
(waving his hand)
I'm just a trainee, Your Majesty. This honor is too great.

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
Nonsense. One sip grants a century of wisdom. You need it most.

The CELESTIAL EMPEROR picks up a bottle of "celestial nectar" and prepares to drink.

JIN BAO
(shouting)
Emperor, wait!

The CELESTIAL EMPEROR has already taken a sip.

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
(frowning)
Interesting... earthy notes. Unconventional.

TAIBAI JINXING
(choking back laughter)
Dew essence, Your Majesty. The boy's signature move.

The IMMORTALS suppress smiles, accustomed to Jin Bao's antics.

CELESTIAL GENERAL
Your Majesty, the law demands—

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
(raises hand)
continuation:
He who guards the nectar must taste it first. Tradition.

JIN BAO's spell misfires, ringing the Thunder Bell.

The sky fills with dark clouds, lightning and thunder.

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
The Nine Heavens Thunder Tribulation? For a child's prank?

A bolt of lightning strikes toward JIN BAO.

JIN BAO
(screaming)
I didn't mean to!

JIN BAO falls from the sky, encased in protective golden light.

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
Jin Bao!

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
Heaven tempers flawed jade through trial.

TAIBAI JINXING
This mortal journey will teach him responsibility.

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
When his merit is complete, he shall return. Perhaps then he'll be worthy of his title.

JIN BAO transforms into a golden light, descending from the heavens.

JIN BAO (V.O.)
Mortal life? Maybe I can finally escape celestial law! Wait... what's a 'father'?

EXT. FOREST - DAY

A horse carriage stops in the forest. Guards stand watch.

The golden light flies into the carriage. Inside, PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN rests. The golden light enters PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN's womb.

PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN suddenly awakens, feeling the sacred energy.

PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN
(whispering)
A celestial soul... chooses me?

YE SHUZE approaches with a physician's bag.

YE SHUZE
(calling out)
Princess, you fainted. I brought medicine—

PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN
(shocked, protective)
Stay back!

PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN's palm strikes out, maternal magic flaring.

YE SHUZE dodges, eyes widening with recognition.

YE SHUZE
(astonished)
Your Highness... you're carrying the prophesied one.

PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN
(determined)
Then this child already protects his mother. Good.

Title: The Demon's Arrival
Description: A Demon Lord defeated in battle is reborn in the modern world and must navigate his new identity while planning his return to the demon realm.

INT. DEMON REALM - NIGHT

The DEMON LORD hovers above his shattered throne, surrounded by three CELESTIAL AVATARS. His armor bleeds shadows.

OPPONENT 1
Demon Lord, your reign ends here!

DEMON LORD
Then let oblivion know... I never bowed.

Abyssal lightning arcs from his fists. The avatars raise shields of pure starlight. Sparks weld cracks in reality itself.

OPPONENT 2
Your twelve legions are broken. Your human consort sealed beyond time itself. Why continue?

The DEMON LORD's hand strays to his chest—where a human heartbeat pulses faintly beneath divine armor.

DEMON LORD
(softly)
She taught me that even gods can bleed.

He unleashes a nova of blue-black fire, shattering two avatars. OPPONENT 3 rises from the ash, opening a portal that inverts gravity.

OPPONENT 3
Hahaha! The Chaos Abyss doesn't rebirth, Demon Lord. It UNMAKES!

The DEMON LORD's form unravels, atom by atom. As he vanishes, his armor disintegrates—revealing a simple SILVER NECKLACE. Human work.

The necklace falls. Clatters once. Dissolves into light.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

YE TIAN wakes with a violent gasp. Sweat-drenched sheets. Wrong body. Wrong world. He stares at his hands—too soft, too mortal. LIN YIXUE clutches the sheets, watching him.

YE TIAN (V.O.)
A thousand years of blood... undone by a heartbeat I never wanted.

LIN YIXUE
You're saying you transmigrated? Everything Ye Tian did—none of it was you?

YE TIAN
Precisely.

LIN YIXUE
Bastard... I'll destroy you.

She lunges. Ye Tian catches her wrist mid-swing. Not rough—just immovable. Her fury meets his abyss.

YE TIAN
You've already tried. Last night, with wine and tears.

He releases her. She stumbles back, not from force, but from the truth.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

Three REPORTERS and a CAMERAMAN huddle outside ROOM 1208, studying a blurry paparazzi photo on a phone—Ye Tian's face circled in red.

FEMALE REPORTER
(whispering)
Ye family's bastard heir, caught with Lin Corp's president. This is our golden ticket.

The CAMERAMAN checks his watch: 8:47 AM. He kicks the door.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

YE TIAN's head whips toward the door. His pupils dilate—inhuman. He hears the whispers, the autofocus, the heartbeat in the corridor.

YE TIAN
Four mortals. One lens. They think you're sleeping with a "bastard."

LIN YIXUE
(laughs, bitter)
Which part is the lie?

CRACK! The doorframe splinters. The lock shatters.

Ye Tian moves—not teleportation, but pure, blurring speed. He snags his jacket, drapes it over Lin Yixue, and backs into the bathroom. Light catches the SILVER NECKLACE around his throat.

REPORTERS flood in. Lin Yixue stands, jacket held like armor.

FEMALE REPORTER
Lin Yixue! Where's Ye Tian—the illegitimate heir?

MALE REPORTER 1
We have photos! He's here!

LIN YIXUE
(frozen, then... smiles)
Photos? Of me... alone?

The bathroom door clicks open. Empty. The window's glass is FROSTED with rime. A single BLACK FEATHER drifts to the tiles.

MALE REPORTER 2
What the hell... it's July.

Lin Yixue touches the frost on the sill. It's real. And for the first time, her shock becomes wonder.

FADE OUT.

Title: From Corporate Slave to Boss
Description: An ordinary office worker's life is turned upside down when a freak accident causes her to swap bodies with her billionaire CEO boss.

INT. CITY STREET - DAY

A black Lamborghini cuts through traffic, pausing at a light.

A modest crowd of PHONE-OUTSPECTATORS jockeys for position, some waving, others muttering to friends.

GU NIANYI (28) weaves through on an electric scooter, gripping a delivery bag. She pauses, one foot down, checking her phone at the same intersection.

GU NIANYI (V.O.)
One minute you're delivering revised reports, the next you're delivering... nothing. Just trying to survive another performance review.

The Lamborghini's window rolls down. SONG RUICHEN (32) glances at his watch, impatience flickering across sharp features.

GU NIANYI (V.O.)
That's Song Ruichen. My boss. The man who once restructured an entire department between the 4th and 5th floors of an elevator ride.

TWO WOMEN beside Gu whisper, phones raised.

WOMAN 1
They say he fired his own uncle for looking at him wrong.

WOMAN 2
I'd be terrified to work for him. But god, the dental plan must be incredible.

The light changes. The Lamborghini purrs forward. Gu shakes her head, scooter humming as she turns toward a side entrance.
continuation:
INT. COMPANY LOBBY - DAY

SONG RUICHEN strides through the lobby, two assistants scrambling to keep pace, folders extended like offerings.

GU NIANYI waits by the elevators, tapping her foot, checking her cracked phone screen. A CLEANING LADY works a mop in tight circles nearby.

GU NIANYI
(thinking)
Two minutes late. He's already upstairs. Safe.

She exhales—just as Song's entourage rounds the corner. Gu spins, steps back, and her sneaker hits the wet tile.

GU NIANYI
Shit—

She lunges for the wall, misses, and careens forward. Song turns at the sound. They collide. Heads crack. Both bodies hit the marble with sickening finality. The assistants freeze.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

GU NIANYI wakes with a jolt. Fluorescent lights sear her vision. The smell is wrong—disinfectant and expensive cologne.

Her throat feels different when she swallows. She reaches up. Her fingers find cartilage. An Adam's apple.

GU NIANYI
(thinking)
No. That's not—

She pulls back the blanket. A man's chest. A hospital gown. Her hands—no, these hands—are wrong. Too large. Too smooth.

She spots a phone on the nightstand. Not her cracked screen. The latest model, unlocked with a face she doesn't recognize until—

She holds it up. The camera shows Song Ruichen's face, pale and bruised. The screen reflects his sharp jaw, his disheveled hair, his eyes—her eyes—wide with panic.

GU NIANYI
(thinking)
...me.

Title: The Empress Dowager is with Child
Description: A forbidden romance between an empress and an emperor ends in tragedy, leading to a modern-day woman's rebirth into the past.

INT. ANCIENT PALACE - DAY

Melodious ancient music plays.

JIANG WANSHUANG (30s), Empress Dowager in scarlet silk, reclines on a rosewood divan. Two male COURTIERS attend her—one pours wine, the other massages her shoulders.

EMPEROR LONG ZE (20s) storms in, dragon robes swirling.

LONG ZE
(angrily)
Get out. All of you.

The courtiers flee. Jiang Wanshuang doesn't move.

JIANG WANSHUANG
(leisurely)
What brings the Son of Heaven to this dowager's chambers?

Long Ze seizes her wrist.

LONG ZE
Wanshuang, I will not marry the Prime Minister's daughter. Don't use this method to anger me.

JIANG WANSHUANG
(serious)
Your father's will made me Empress Dowager. I'm your mother, by law.

LONG ZE
(coldly laughing)
Last moon you were in my bed. Not my mother's.

Jiang Wanshuang meets his eyes. Her expression hardens.

JIANG WANSHUANG
(laughing lightly)
Then perhaps I've tired of your inexperience, Your Majesty.

LONG ZE
(shocked)
You're lying.

JIANG WANSHUANG
(impatiently)
Leave me. Please.

Long Ze turns. Exits. Jiang Wanshuang watches until he's gone. She coughs. Blood spatters the jade cup. She collapses.

Long Ze hears. Rushes back in.

LONG ZE
(panicking)
Shuang'er! What did you do?

He catches her falling body.

JIANG WANSHUANG
(weakly)
Prime Minister's poison... finally took. Had to push you away... save you...

She dies. Long Ze holds her as the screen fades to black and white.

SUPER: Great Liang Dynasty, Year 1 of Tiansheng. Empress Dowager Jiang, deceased.
continuation:
INT. MODERN MANSION - DAY

2023. LIU HANYAN (20s) models a pink designer gown and diamonds, admiring herself in a mirror.

JIANG WANSHUANG (MODERN, 20s) enters in monochrome separates. She hurls a velvet box at Liu Hanyan's feet. A diamond necklace spills out.

JIANG WANSHUANG (MODERN)
Well, well, Liu Hanyan, you dare to steal my mother's heirlooms.

JIANG WANSHUANG (MODERN) crushes the necklace under her heel.

JIANG WANSHUANG (MODERN)
You and your mother are gone by dawn.

She exits. Liu Hanyan gathers the broken diamonds. Her eyes turn venomous.

INT. MANSION STAIRCASE - DAY

Jiang Wanshuang (Modern) climbs the marble stairs. Liu Hanyan appears at the top.

LIU HANYAN
Jiang Wanshuang!

Liu Hanyan shoves her. Jiang Wanshuang tumbles down the stairs. Her skull cracks against marble. Blood pools.

Liu Hanyan descends, first smiling, then feigning horror.

LIU HANYAN
(screaming)
Help! Somebody! Oh God!

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Jiang Wanshuang (Modern) lies on a hospital bed. A DOCTOR checks his watch.

DOCTOR
(looking at watch)
Time of death. 14:38.

The DOCTOR and NURSE exit. The body under the sheet opens ancient eyes—sharp, cold.

Title: Gale: Desperate Escape
Description: Xiao Lang and his companions attempt to escape from a compound in Myawaddy, only to be caught by ruthless guards.

INT. COMPOUND COURTYARD - NIGHT

A pair of THUGS patrol, their synchronized footsteps echoing off concrete. One pauses to light a cigarette - a predictable sixty-second delay.

XIAO LANG, YANG HAO, and two others flatten against a barracks wall. Xiao Lang's fingers trace a grease-pencil map on his palm.

The Thugs move on. Xiao Lang exhales, turns to Yang Hao.

XIAO LANG
(whisper)
They're gone. Ninety seconds.

XIAO LANG
She's occupied with the new shipment. Our only window.

XIAO LANG
If the south wall fails, scatter for the river. Don't wait.

Xiao Lang leads them in a low run across open ground, hugging the shadows.

EXT. FACTORY GATE - NIGHT

The group reaches a drainage pipe along the perimeter wall. Rusted barbed wire glints overhead. Xiao Lang tests the pipe - it holds.

YANG HAO
(voice cracking)
The map showed a cleared section. This is suicide!

A metallic PING rings out - a companion's belt buckle hits the pipe. They freeze.

THUG (O.S.)
Movement! North wall!

XIAO LANG
(shoving Yang Hao)
Up! Now!

YANG HAO
(frantic)
We've been spotted! Fall back?

XIAO LANG
(feral whisper)
Going back means the cages. Climb.

ANOTHER COMPANION
(weeping)
The wire's live! I saw them test it this morning!
continuation:
EXT. FACTORY DEAD END - NIGHT

Xiao Lang leads them along the wall to a stack of rotting pallets blocking a narrow gap. The wall ahead is sheer.

XIAO LANG
(desperate)
The river access should be...

He shoves a pallet. Beyond it, chain-link hums with current, razor wire glinting.

YANG HAO
(turning on Xiao Lang)
You said the south wall was low! You promised!

XIAO LANG
(quiet, hollow)
Someone gave me bad information. Someone here.

Bootsteps echo. The LEAD THUG emerges, tapping a baton against his palm. Six men fan out behind him.

LEAD THUG
(calling back)
Dead end! Surrounded!

He advances.

LEAD THUG
Boss said make it educational. Who's first?

THUGS swarm. Xiao Lang takes a blow to his ribs, crumpling over another companion.

XIAO LANG
(gasping)
We're contracted! You can't—

FEMALE BOSS (O.S.)
Stop.

The assault freezes. The FEMALE BOSS emerges, heels clicking. The MALE BOSS follows, examining his fingernails.

FEMALE BOSS
(measured)
Chen. I said contained, not pulped.

MALE BOSS
(to Female Boss)
One facility. That's what I entrusted you with. And you're staging a broadcast of incompetence?

He gestures at the beaten men.

MALE BOSS
My Bangkok partners see this footage, they'll question my stability. Then I question yours.

FEMALE BOSS
(crouching before Xiao Lang)
You came to Myawaddy seeking sanctuary. I gave you work. This is your gratitude?

She smiles, cold.

FEMALE BOSS
Here's your new contract. You tell me who sold you that map. Tonight. Or my men demonstrate the full hospitality of this city. Starting with your friend who can't stop crying.

A companion whimpers. Xiao Lang's jaw tightens.

FEMALE BOSS
(softly)
Nobody leaves Myawaddy without settling their tab.

title: Fall from Grace

context:
Title: Fall from Grace
Description: A loyal celestial general is falsely accused and executed, while his sister is stripped of her immortal bone and banished to the mortal realm.

INT. HEAVENLY PALACE - DAY

The Heavenly Palace shrouded in clouds and mist. Celestial beings gather together, their robes catching the aurora light.

IMMORTAL A (V.O.)
Nine Heavens Mystic Art, reveal all truths...

IMMORTAL B (V.O.)
Nine Heavens Mystic Art, obey my command.

FAIRY
General Vermillion Bird has cleansed the Northern Wastelands and returned the Demon Clan's ancestral seal. The Realm itself owes him debt!

XUANNIAO CLAN LEADER
(laughing heartily, yet weary)
Three generations of blood-soaked feathers... When the Heavens call, we answer. Even when the Heavens forget why they called.

HEAVENLY EMPEROR'S ENVOY
The Heavenly Emperor's Envoy, Lady Yao Ji arrives! All bow!

Lady Yao Ji, dressed in magnificent robes, walks forward with a scroll case that bleeds darkness.

CROWD
We welcome Lady Yao Ji.

LADY YAO JI
Nan Tian of the Xuanniao, kneel for judgment.

Heavenly soldiers step forward and grab NAN TIAN—golden chains materializing around his wrists.

FAIRY RUO LI
(shocked, stepping between them)
Lady Yao Ji! My brother bears the Emperor's own Phoenix Seal. He stood against the Demon King's blade when—

LADY YAO JI
continuation:
—when he learned their blade could cut both ways. The Nine Heavens Mystic Art caught him drafting new celestial laws. With demon script.

She unfurls the scroll. The characters writhe like black serpents.

FAIRY RUO LI
That's impossible! The Xuanniao cannot even read—

LADY YAO JI
Say another word, and you confess by association. Your clan's loyalty is precisely what makes his betrayal so poisonous.

FAIRY RUO LI
(kneeling, desperate)
Then let the Emperor himself wield the Thunder! Let him look in my brother's eyes when—

HEAVENLY EMPEROR'S ENVOY
The Emperor has looked. And wept. Do it.

Heavenly lightning—purple and sentient—descends from above and strikes NAN TIAN.

NAN TIAN
(screaming, his voice splintering into echoes)
Ruo Li—fly! The cage is the—!

Nan Tian turns to ash in the lightning, his Phoenix Seal shattering. Fairy Ruo Li watches in agony and collapses to the ground.

A MASKED FIGURE in black detaches from Yao Ji's shadow.

MASKED FIGURE
(whispering to Ruo Li)
You were always the brighter flame. That's why they clipped your wings first.

The Masked Figure reaches out and extracts a glowing immortal bone from Fairy Ruo Li's body. The bone pulses with her lineage memory. Fairy Ruo Li falls in pain, her eyes locked on the ashes.

HEAVENLY EMPEROR'S ENVOY
(reading the decree, voice hollow)
By order of the Heavenly Emperor: Fairy Ruo Li, stripped of the Xuanniao immortal bone, cast to the mortal realm. Her name erased from the Jade Record. Let no one speak of her again.

Lady Yao Ji watches coldly as the Masked Figure grinds the immortal bone to dust. Fairy Ruo Li loses consciousness and falls from the clouds, her silhouette shrinking against the endless sky.

title: Red Eyes, Golden Pupils
description: After his family is massacred and his father killed, Wang Hao inherits the Divine Master Ring and vows revenge against the traitor Qin Ao.
context:
Title: Red Eyes, Golden Pupils
Description: After his family is massacred and his father killed, Wang Hao inherits the Divine Master Ring and vows revenge against the traitor Qin Ao.

EXT. VILLA COURTYARD - NIGHT

Rain lashes the courtyard. Torchlight flickers across wet stone as BLACK-CLAD ASSASSINS cut down fleeing SERVANTS. Blood pools at the base of guardian lion statues. A cold wind carries the stench of iron.

A MAN IN BLACK silences WANG HAO'S MOTHER with a swift, professional cut. She falls without a sound.

QIN AO (50s), bald, beads clicking in his grip, watches from the veranda. Not with glee—with grim necessity.

QIN AO
(quietly)
Find the Master. Not the ring. The man.

SUBORDINATE
(bowing)
The family wing is clear. Only the old basement remains.

QIN AO
He won't hide. Not from me.

Qin Ao steps over a fallen guard, his robes untouched by blood.

QIN AO (CONT'D)
Burn it. Let the past turn to ash.

Torches arc through the rain. Smoke billows as fire devours the wooden eaves.

INT. BASEMENT - NIGHT

WANG YUANSHAN (50s), pale from poison, presses an ornate ring into his son WANG HAO's palm. The younger man's scholar's hands tremble.

WANG YUANSHAN
You were never meant for this path. The academy... your books...

WANG HAO
(whisper)
We can still leave. Together.

WANG YUANSHAN
This was your brother's burden. Now it's yours.

WANG HAO
(choked)
It's just metal. Brother is dead. Mother—

WANG YUANSHAN
Metal that holds a million souls. Qin Ao thinks he wants it. He doesn't understand the weight.

Footsteps pound overhead. Dust showers from the beams.

WANG YUANSHAN (CONT'D)
The tunnel behind the wine racks. It leads to the old well.

WANG HAO
Not without you.

WANG YUANSHAN
I've been dead for three years, Hao'er. Since the day they poisoned me. Today, I'm just making it official.

WANG HAO
(tears falling)
You promised to see me graduate.

WANG YUANSHAN
And you promised never to draw a blade. We both lied.

He shoves Wang Hao toward the hidden entrance.

WANG YUANSHAN (CONT'D)
Remember: the ring commands nothing. You command it.
continuation:
EXT. VILLA COURTYARD - NIGHT

Wang Hao emerges from the well, mud-soaked. The villa blazes, but rain contains the worst.

Through the flames, he sees his father in the basement doorway—upright, defiant.

WANG HAO
(scream swallowed by thunder)
FATHER!

WANG YUANSHAN (V.O.)
Don't seek revenge. Seek justice. Or become what he is.

The villa collapses inward. Sparks spiral into the storm.

EXT. VILLA COURTYARD - NIGHT

Wang Hao kneels before his father's scorched body in the smoking ruins. The ring rests in his palm—cold metal, no magic.

WANG HAO
(voice raw)
Justice. Or become what he is.

He slips the ring on. Nothing happens. No glow. Just weight.

WANG HAO (CONT'D)
Qin Ao. I'm coming. Not for Cloud Heaven Hall. For the man you burned. And the one you made me become.

A wave of dizziness hits. The smoke... the grief... Wang Hao's vision blurs. For a moment, the ring seems to pulse with heat.

His eyes sting. Tears? No—something else. A golden shimmer reflects in a puddle before him. In it, he sees his own eyes: bloodshot red, pupils flecked with gold.

Not a power. Not magic. Just the look of a man who's lost everything—and found something harder in its place.

WANG HAO (CONT'D)
(whisper)
This is what you wanted, Qin Ao? Then come and see what you've created.

The golden flecks fade, but the hardness remains. The ring is just metal. The transformation is his alone.

title: My Secret Marriage: The CEO's White Moonlight

context:
Title: My Secret Marriage: The CEO's White Moonlight
Description: Lin Tang prepares to meet her husband of two years for the first time, but fate has other plans.

INT. HOTEL HALLWAY - NIGHT

LIN TANG, elegant in a tailored suit, hesitates before a hotel suite door, fingers hovering near the handle.

LIN TANG (V.O.)
Two years of signatures on paper. A marriage in name only. And tonight, we become strangers no more...

LIN TANG steels herself, smoothing her jacket.

LIN TANG (V.O.)
Just be professional. You're here for the merger meeting, not a fairy tale. But what if he hates me on sight?

The door suddenly swings open. Strong hands pull her inside.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - CONTINUOUS

HUO BEICHENG, white shirt disheveled, grips LIN TANG's arm. His eyes are lucid but desperate.

LIN TANG
Mr. Huo—

HUO BEICHENG
Someone spiked my drink. I need help.

LIN TANG
Help?

Huo Beicheng
You're the doctor Su Zhenguo sent, aren't you?

Before Lin Tang can clarify, he stumbles forward. Instinctively, she catches him. Their eyes meet.

LIN TANG (V.O.)
He doesn't know. After all this time, he doesn't recognize his own wife.

She could push him away. Instead, she guides him toward the bed.

HUO BEICHENG
Stay. Please.

LIN TANG
You won't remember this tomorrow.

HUO BEICHENG
I'll remember you.

MONTAGE
- Lin Tang's fingers hesitantly brush his cheek
- The two embrace among scattered rose petals
- A single high heel falls silently from the bed
- Lin Tang's hand rests on his chest, a quiet choice
- Morning light filters through curtains
END MONTAGE
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

LIN TANG wakes beside HUO BEICHENG. His face is peaceful in sleep. She watches him, emotions warring across her features.

Her phone BUZZES. Caller ID: "Dad - Su Zhenguo."

DAD (V.O.)
Tangtang. Home. Now.

LIN TANG
(panicked whisper)
What did you do?

She silences the call. Huo Beicheng stirs. Grabbing her clothes, she flees. A distinctive red-soled heel remains on the carpet. Huo Beicheng's eyes open slowly. He touches the empty space beside him, then notices the shoe.

HUO BEICHENG
(softly)
Who are you?

INT. HOTEL ROOM - LATER

HUO BEICHENG, immaculate in a black suit, holds the shoe. SECRETARY ZHAO waits with a tablet.

HUO BEICHENG
Find the owner. Discreetly.

SECRETARY ZHAO
The car's waiting. Your grandmother insists you collect Mrs. Huo from the Su residence today.

HUO BEICHENG
The life-saving grace from two years ago. I've honored the contract. She hasn't.

He turns the shoe over in his hands, thoughtful.

HUO BEICHENG
The one who saved me last night—she left this behind. And something else.

SECRETARY ZHAO
Sir?

Huo Beicheng
A sense of... recognition.

He pockets the shoe.

HUO BEICHENG
To the Su family. Let's meet my wife.

FADE OUT.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

A quiet, dimly lit corridor, only the echo of high heels clicking on the floor.

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Miss Ye, your father is in critical condition. We need your signature.

LIN YIYI (V.O.)
Even someone like you has a day like this?

The camera pulls up to reveal a fashionably dressed woman, LIN YIYI, who stops in her tracks, her eyes cold as she looks ahead.

LIN YIYI
Do you still remember how you treated us, mother and daughter? Do you still remember how Mom died?

TRANSITION: A white flash, entering a flashback.

INT. HOME - DAY

ON SCREEN: Twenty years ago.

Little YIYI runs into the room holding a colorful pinwheel, happy and excited.

LITTLE YIYI
Daddy, look at my pinwheel!

Her father, YE FENG, lying on the bed looking irritated, snatches the pinwheel and throws it on the ground.

YE FENG
Get lost!

Little YIYI is frightened and starts crying.

YE FENG
(impatiently)
Always crying. Worthless girl.

YE FENG gets up and roughly grabs Little YIYI.

YE FENG
You're still crying! You jinx, you've cried away all my luck!

Mother SUN YUYU rushes in, kneeling down to protect Little YIYI.

SUN YUYU
Yiyi! Don't hit the child! If you want to hit someone, hit me!

YE FENG
(roaring)
Fine!

YE FENG unbuckles his belt and wildly whips SUN YUYU.

YE FENG
I'll teach you! Teach you both!
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

LIN YIYI and the DOCTOR stand by the bed. YE FENG lies unconscious with an oxygen tube.

DOCTOR
Your father's organs are failing. We need your consent to continue life support.

LIN YIYI
Is that so?

LIN YIYI
(interrupting)
Then don't trouble yourself, Doctor.

LIN YIYI takes out a bundle of dried mugwort and a lighter from her designer bag.

LIN YIYI
In our hometown, there's a folk remedy.

She lights the mugwort. The doctor flinches.

DOCTOR
Miss Ye, you cannot—

LIN YIYI
Please. Let us have a moment.

The doctor hesitates, then exits. LIN YIYI sits, holding the smoking mugwort.

INT. HOME - DAY

In the flashback, YE FENG lights a bundle of mugwort, smoke swirling.

YE FENG
I asked around. You're just being dramatic. Fumigate it and you'll be fine.

SUN YUYU lies in bed, seriously ill, coughing continuously. YE FENG waves the smoking mugwort around in front of her.

YE FENG
See, aren't you better now? You still have some money at home, right? I saw you hide it.

YE FENG lifts the pillow and takes the money hidden underneath. SUN YUYU weakly tries to stop him.

SUN YUYU
You can't... it's for Yiyi's school...

YE FENG
(pushing her away)
Get away from me! When I win at gambling, I'll bring it back tenfold.

YE FENG turns and leaves with the money.

INT. HOME - NIGHT

YE FENG returns home with a bruised and swollen face, horrified to find SUN YUYU collapsed on the ground, no longer breathing. Little YIYI cries heart-wrenchingly beside her.

YE FENG is so frightened by the scene that he collapses to the ground.

YE FENG
Yuyu... no...

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Back to reality, LIN YIYI holds the smoking mugwort, slowly approaching YE FENG on the bed.

LIN YIYI (V.O.)
This is the method you used to kill my mother. Now you're getting what you deserve.

LIN YIYI sits by the bed, tears welling up in her eyes.

LIN YIYI
You took everything from us. What right do you have to live?

YE FENG on the bed sheds a tear, his lips moving slightly.

YE FENG
(weakly)
Yiyi... forgive me... I was... a fool...

YE FENG finishes speaking, slowly closes his eyes, and stops breathing.

LIN YIYI watches for a long moment, then extinguishes the mugwort. She stands, smooths her dress, and walks out without a backward glance.

title: Three Reborn Brothers Spoil Me
description: After rebirth, three brothers reject their adoptive sister at a press conference, revealing past betrayals while their true sister watches from afar.
context:
Title: Three Reborn Brothers Spoil Me
Description: After rebirth, three brothers reject their adoptive sister at a press conference, revealing past betrayals while their true sister watches from afar.

INT. PRESS CONFERENCE - DAY

BACKGROUND VOICE (V.O.)
How much longer? The Lu Family Global Press Conference begins in minutes, and the third young master still hasn't arrived...

REPORTERS jostle anxiously. The atmosphere crackles with tension.

REPORTER A
The Lu brothers are coming out!

LU NANCHEN, LU YIZE, and LU YUNQING stride onto the red carpet flanked by BODYGUARDS. Flashbulbs erupt as REPORTERS surge forward.

ON SCREEN: LU NANCHEN - HEAD OF THE LU FAMILY
ON SCREEN: LU YIZE - TOP ACTOR
ON SCREEN: LU YUNQING - RENOWNED LAWYER

REPORTER B
Mr. Lu Yize, three years since your last win—how does it feel to hold the Best Actor award again?

REPORTER C
Mr. Lu Nanchen, with Lu Corporation's relisting, who deserves your thanks most?

LU NANCHEN
The three of us stand here today because of one person.

LU YUNQING
Without her, we'd be nothing.

LU NANCHEN
She is our sister, Chi.

A young woman in a pristine white suit, LU XIAOXIAO, pushes through the crowd.

LU XIAOXIAO
Big Brother!

She rushes toward LU NANCHEN with outstretched arms.
continuation:
EXT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

CHI XIA, wrapped in a worn red hoodie and scarf, stands alone on a desolate, snow-swept street. She watches the press conference on a building screen.

CHI XIA
(to herself)
Back to their perfect family. They won't miss my cheap noodles now.

She turns away, shoulders slumping. Snowflakes cling to her eyelashes.

Suddenly—a MAN stumbles into the road as a car speeds toward him.

CHI XIA
(shouting)
Watch out!

She lunges forward, shoving him clear. The car slams into her.

She hits the pavement hard. Blood trickles from her temple. Her vision blurs.

CHI XIA
(inner voice)
So this is how it ends... for people like me. Unseen. Unneeded.

She fades into darkness.

INT. PRESS CONFERENCE - DAY

Time rewinds. LU XIAOXIAO is about to embrace LU NANCHEN.

LU NANCHEN's hand shoots out, stopping her cold. He pushes her back gently but firmly.

LU YUNQING
Who exactly are you?

LU XIAOXIAO
(panicked)
I... Big Brother, it's me—Xiaoxiao!

LU YIZE
The adoptive daughter who cut all ties when we went bankrupt.

LU NANCHEN
The one who disappeared for three years without a word.

LU YUNQING
You're not our sister.

LU XIAOXIAO's face drains of color as the three brothers turn away in unison.

title: Tomb Keeper's Notes: Return to Coffin Mountain
description: A man plagued by nightmares seeks a legendary cure from a mysterious mountain, but obtaining it requires more than just finding it.
context:
Title: Tomb Keeper's Notes: Return to Coffin Mountain
Description: A man plagued by nightmares seeks a legendary cure from a mysterious mountain, but obtaining it requires more than just finding it.

INT. COFFIN MOUNTAIN - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHI QINGPING lies on the ground, convulsing. His fingers tear at the dirt, seeking purchase. He sits up, terror flattening his features.

Two silhouettes with furnace-green eyes manifest from the blackness. They move like puppets with cut strings—jerky, too fast. The air between them warps.

They hit him like a wave. His back arches. Something beneath his ribs glows—faint, fruit-shaped—then fades to nothing.

EXT. HAICHENG SHI MANSION COURTYARD - DAY

SHI QINGPING lurches awake. The teacup slips from his fingers and shatters. He stares at the shards, breathing hard.

BAO WANRU appears without a sound. Her hand hovers near his shoulder, not quite touching.

BAO WANRU
(low)
Again.

QINGWEN lingers by the courtyard gate, wringing a letter.

QINGWEN
Master. Doctor Xing... he's coming tonight. Says tomorrow's too late.

Shi Qingping closes his eyes. He already knows.
continuation:
INT. HAICHENG SHI MANSION INNER CHAMBER - DAY

The room sinks into twilight. DOCTOR XING ZICHENG holds SHI QINGPING's wrist, his thumb pressing the hollow of the pulse. The silence stretches.

XING ZICHENG
Your pulse is fleeing.

SHI QINGPING
(cold)
Give me a name for it.

XING ZICHENG
Coffin King Fruit. Nothing else.

SHI QINGPING
Coffin—

XING ZICHENG
Mountain. Yes.

Shi Qingping's hand tightens on the chair arm.

SHI QINGPING
How did you—

XING ZICHENG
I smell wet earth on you. The day after rain. Only one place near Haicheng.

LEI WENLI shifts from the shadows. His scarred knuckles are white.

LEI WENLI
(interjecting)
Master Shi. My grandfather was a tomb keeper there.

SHI QINGPING
(looking at LEI WENLI in surprise)
Speak.

LEI WENLI
The fruit doesn't obey. It collects. It chooses who owes the debt. If it summons you, it's not to give. It's to take payment.

SHI QINGPING
(turning to glare at XING ZICHENG)
If you're lying—

XING ZICHENG
Touch your left ribs. Count the marks.

Shi Qingping's hand goes to his chest. He doesn't look. He already feels the three bruises, glowing faintly through his silk robe.
