title: Return of the Son-in-Law
description: Li Shiheng, leader of the Liuhe Commerce Association, is ambushed in a warehouse and saved by the mysterious Ye Feng, to whom he pledges his loyalty and resources.
context:
Title: Return of the Son-in-Law
Description: Li Shiheng, leader of the Liuhe Commerce Association, is ambushed in a warehouse and saved by the mysterious Ye Feng, to whom he pledges his loyalty and resources.

INT. WAREHOUSE - DAY

Aerial shot of a massive industrial area. On-screen text reads: "Port City - Liuhe Warehouse District."

LI SHIHENG, blood at the corner of his mouth, is surrounded by more than a dozen men in black at the center of the warehouse.

BLACK-CLAD LEADER (O.S.)
Shiheng! There's no escape!

LI SHIHENG
(breathing heavily, defiant)
Twenty years I built Liuhe in this city. Come then. Let's see if you have the steel to finish what your masters started.

LI SHIHENG takes the initiative and fights the black-clad men. His skills are impressive, but he's outnumbered. Soon, a black-clad man holds a knife to his throat and pins him to the ground.

BLACK-CLAD MAN
(urgent whisper)
Time to retire, old man.

Just as the black-clad man is about to strike, a figure drops from the rafters with a kick, sending the attacker flying. The newcomer is YE FENG, wearing a black trench coat, with an extraordinary presence.

BLACK-CLAD MAN
Who are you?

YE FENG
(quiet, dangerous)
Wrong warehouse.

BLACK-CLAD LEADER
What audacity! Brothers, kill him!
continuation:
All the black-clad men rush at YE FENG. YE FENG moves with lethal economy, using precise strikes, quickly rendering all the black-clad men immobile. They lie motionless.

The roar of motorcycles is heard outside the warehouse. Four motorcycles speed in, followed by a large group of reinforcements in black suits.

SUBORDINATE
(anxiously)
President! The Four Pillars are coming! We got your tracker signal—

The reinforcements rush into the warehouse and freeze when they see the enemies on the ground and YE FENG standing unharmed. A subordinate runs to LI SHIHENG and kneels before him.

SUBORDINATE
(stricken)
We were blocked at the bridge. President, please forgive us!

LI SHIHENG ignores the subordinate and walks straight to YE FENG, kneeling on one knee. All the reinforcements behind him kneel in unison.

LI SHIHENG
(voice cracking)
You wear no colors. No banners. Yet you stand when I fall.

YE FENG
(helping LI SHIHENG up)
Please rise. I don't want this.

LI SHIHENG
(standing, intense)
They broke every rule of this city to take me down. You... you had no reason to interfere. Yet here I stand.

LI SHIHENG takes out a black card from his chest and hands it to YE FENG.

LI SHIHENG
The Eighth Card. There are only seven in existence. Until now. This isn't a favor—it's a foundation. Whatever you build in this city, Liuhe stands beneath it.

YE FENG takes the black card, looks at LI SHIHENG, deep in thought.

title: Radiant Like Her
description: A wealthy heiress hides her identity to live a simple life with the man she loves, only to face a turning point on their third anniversary.
context:
Title: Radiant Like Her
Description: A wealthy heiress hides her identity to live a simple life with the man she loves, only to face a turning point on their third anniversary.

INT. BARBECUE STALL - NIGHT

JIANG YAO, a young woman in a simple apron, skillfully grills meat skewers. Her scarred hands belie her noble birth.

EXT. CITY NIGHT ROAD - NIGHT

A convoy of black luxury cars speeds through the night.

QIN YUE (V.O.)
The old master is dying. Three years of silence is enough.

The lead car is a Rolls-Royce, imposing and powerful.

INT. BARBECUE STALL - NIGHT

JIANG YAO serves the grilled skewers to two male customers, THUG A and THUG B.

JIANG YAO
Enjoy.

THUG A suddenly grabs JIANG YAO's wrist.

THUG A
(grinning)
Boss lady, you're too good for this dump. Come work for me.

JIANG YAO struggles forcefully.

JIANG YAO
Let go of me!

THUG B also steps forward, and together with THUG A, they pull at JIANG YAO.

THUD B
Don't be shy. We'll triple your pay.

JIANG YAO
Let go of me!

THUG B
Just hear us out.

Suddenly, a BODYGUARD in a suit rushes forward and kicks THUG B away. More BODYGUARDS appear and quickly subdue the two thugs.

QIN YUE walks over, surrounded by bodyguards. He pulls out a stack of cash from his pocket and throws it on the ground.
continuation:
QIN YUE
This money buys your lives. Don't let me see you in Jiangzhou again. Get lost!

The two thugs scramble to pick up the money and flee.

QIN YUE turns to JIANG YAO and bows respectfully.

QIN YUE
Young lady, your father's final wish is to see you. The contract you signed gave you away.

JIANG YAO
(coldly)
I signed as Jiang Yao. Hui Zhou knows nothing.

QIN YUE
The board knows everything. They expect their chairwoman tomorrow.

JIANG YAO
(emotionally)
I have an anniversary. I promised Hui Zhou—

QIN YUE
Three years of secret assistance ends now. He thinks he earned his success alone.

JIANG YAO
(touching her simple wedding ring)
He did. I only opened doors.

QIN YUE
The Jiang family fortune of hundreds of millions needs its heir. Not a grill cook.

JIANG YAO
No more persuasion. Go back.

QIN YUE has no choice but to leave with the bodyguards.

JIANG YAO watches them go, then begins to pack up her stall. She picks up an exquisitely wrapped pink gift box, a happy smile on her face.

JIANG YAO (V.O.)
Tomorrow I tell him everything. Three years of secrets end at our anniversary.

EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

A Rolls-Royce drives down the road.

JIANG YAO, holding the gift box, stands by the roadside, full of joy and anticipation.

The Rolls-Royce makes a beautiful drift and stops in front of JIANG YAO. The door opens, and a handsome man in a black coat with an extraordinary air steps out. This is HUI ZHOU.

HUI ZHOU looks at JIANG YAO, his eyes complex.

title: Getting Rich After Divorce
description: A gambling addict loses everything including his family in pursuit of a big win, only to face devastating consequences.
context:
Title: Getting Rich After Divorce
Description: A gambling addict loses everything including his family in pursuit of a big win, only to face devastating consequences.

INT. ONLINE CASINO - DAY

A DEALER (30s, polished, professional) faces the camera with a practiced smile.

DEALER
Hello, sir. I am your exclusive dealer. I will now deal the cards. Please place your bets.

INT. YE CHEN'S APARTMENT - DAY

SMASH CUT TO:

YE CHEN (40s, unshaven, eyes bloodshot) wears a stained tank top, frantically clicking his mouse. The laptop screen reflects cards being dealt.

LI MEIYUN (30s, exhausted, clutching medical bills) enters with their daughter, TONGTONG (7, frail, with a hospital bracelet).

LI MEIYUN
Ye Chen. The deed—where is it?

YE CHEN
(not turning)
Safe. Don't worry about it.

LI MEIYUN
You didn't.

YE CHEN
It's a concrete box. I'll buy you a real home.

LI MEIYUN
Tongtong's fever spiked again. They won't treat her without today's deposit.

TONGTONG
(weakly)
Daddy... my head hurts.

She touches his arm. Ye Chen flinches.

YE CHEN
(shrugging her off)
Not now. I'm close.

TONGTONG stumbles back, clips the table edge. Falls.

LI MEIYUN
Tongtong!

She rushes over. Blood seeps from the girl's temple.

LI MEIYUN
(quietly)
She needs you.

YE CHEN
I'm making the money you need!

LI MEIYUN
This is how?

YE CHEN
Insider information. This hand—then we're free.

LI MEIYUN stares at him, sees a stranger.

LI MEIYUN
You're already gone.

She scoops up Tongtong and leaves. The door slams.
continuation:
INT. YE CHEN'S APARTMENT - LATER

Ye Chen hunches closer to the screen, surrounded by takeout containers and cigarette butts.

DEALER (V.O.)
Banker nine points, player eight points. Banker wins.

YE CHEN
(wiping sweat)
Again. One more.

He types frantically to "Customer Service Wenwen." Messages bounce back: "User not found."

YE CHEN
No... Wenwen, the tip—why?

His phone RINGS—UNKNOWN NUMBER.

YE CHEN
(answering)
What?

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Mr. Ye? This is City Central. We called your wife's phone—yours was listed as emergency contact.

YE CHEN
Is she—

DOCTOR (V.O.)
About Tongtong. The fall caused a hemorrhage. We did everything we could.

The phone slips. Ye Chen stares at nothing. A laugh escapes—small, involuntary. He clamps a hand over his mouth. Tears fall. He laughs again, choking on it, collapsing into a sound that isn't quite human.

END SCENE

title: Dragon Abyss
description: A delivery man named Lin Yang, betrayed and left for dead by his wife, returns after three years of mastering divine martial arts, seeking revenge with the power of dragon blood and the authority of Haotian Hall.
context:
Title: Dragon Abyss
Description: A delivery man named Lin Yang, betrayed and left for dead by his wife, returns after three years of mastering divine martial arts, seeking revenge with the power of dragon blood and the authority of Haotian Hall.

EXT. BUSINESS CENTER EXTERIOR - DAY

Two delivery workers, LIN YANG and his COLLEAGUE, sit on the steps outside a building eating boxed lunches.

COLLEAGUE
You barely touched your food. Third day in a row.

(beat)
Your ex... she's not worth destroying yourself over.

The COLLEAGUE offers a boiled egg. LIN YANG's knuckles whiten around his chopsticks.

A SECURITY GUARD approaches, his radio crackling with static.

SECURITY GUARD
Delivery guys can't loiter here. Event prep starts tonight.

The GUARD's boot "accidentally" catches LIN YANG's lunch box, spilling it down the steps.

SECURITY GUARD
(tight smile)
Oops. These steps are for tenants. Not sewer rats who can't read signs.

LIN YANG rises slowly, his breathing measured. The air seems to grow heavier.

LIN YANG
You wear a uniform. Does it make you forget you're also just a man?

The GUARD's hand drifts toward his baton. LIN YANG's eyes fix on a spot over the guard's shoulder—seeing something else.

LIN YANG's mind flashes back to his master's teachings.

MASTER (V.O.)
The mountain teaches patience. The world will test it.

FLASHBACK BEGINS:
continuation:
EXT. MOUNTAIN PAVILION - DAY

On a misty mountaintop, LIN YANG sits cross-legged in white robes, meditating. Energy ripples distort the air around him.

MASTER (V.O.)
Three winters. Three summers. You rebuilt yourself from nothing.

The MASTER, an elderly man with white hair and a long beard, materializes from the mist. LIN YANG's eyes snap open—solid gold pupils that fade back to brown.

LIN YANG
Master... the visions won't stop.

MASTER
They are not visions. They are memories your body refuses to release.

The MASTER places a hand on LIN YANG's shoulder. Ancient scars beneath the fabric pulse with faint light.

MASTER
She took your marrow. The mountain gave you something... else. Something that hasn't walked this earth in five dynasties.

The MASTER removes a dragon-shaped ring from his finger. It seems carved from solid twilight.

MASTER
Haotian Hall waits for one who can carry its weight without being crushed. Show me you are that man.

LIN YANG accepts the ring. The metal burns cold against his skin.

MASTER
The silver needles. The technique I taught you... it wasn't for healing. It was to teach you control. Dragon blood doesn't obey those ruled by rage.

LIN YANG's jaw tightens. When he speaks, his voice carries an undercurrent that makes the mist recede.

LIN YANG
Then what obeys?

MASTER
Purpose.

END FLASHBACK.

EXT. BUSINESS CENTER EXTERIOR - DAY

The scene cuts back to reality. The SECURITY GUARD is sweating now, though he doesn't know why.

SECURITY GUARD
Tomorrow... the Song family marries off their daughter here. Miss Song Wan'er. Xiao family. Biggest event of the year. I'm not losing my job because some delivery trash—

The name hits LIN YANG like a physical blow. His COLLEAGUE notices Lin's stillness—the dangerous kind.

LIN YANG
(VO)
Wan'er. Here. So close I can taste the irony.

The ring on his finger—drab, unremarkable—catches a sliver of sunlight. For an instant, it gleams like a predator's eye.

LIN YANG's fingers flex. Somewhere in the business center, every light bulb flickers.

LIN YANG
(softly, to the guard)
You should leave now.

The GUARD hesitates, sensing something fundamentally wrong, but his pride won't let him retreat.

SECURITY GUARD
Or what?

LIN YANG smiles. It's not a pleasant expression.

LIN YANG
Or you'll learn what happens when dragon blood remembers.

title: The Empress of Great Zhou
description: An empress discovers her husband the emperor in bed with her own sister and confronts them, only to be betrayed and poisoned.
context:
Title: The Empress of Great Zhou
Description: An empress discovers her husband the emperor in bed with her own sister and confronts them, only to be betrayed and poisoned.

INT. PALACE CORRIDOR - NIGHT

Empress JIANG XUE, dressed in magnificent robes, walks briskly toward the Emperor's bedchamber, surrounded by a group of PALACE MAIDS and EUNUCHS.

EUNUCH
Your Majesty the Empress, entering the Emperor's bedchamber without his summons is a capital offense.

JIANG XUE
He hasn't attended court for days. I must see what he's doing.

JIANG XUE ignores the obstruction and continues forward.

INT. EMPEROR'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

JIANG XUE kicks open the bedchamber door with one foot. The door shatters. She walks into the incense-filled chamber with anger.

On the dragon bed, Emperor LI QINGXUAN is startled awake.

LI QINGXUAN
Who?

JIANG XUE walks into the inner chamber and sees clearly what is before her. Emperor LI QINGXUAN sits on the bed in disheveled clothing, and behind him is none other than her own sister, JIANG YING.

JIANG XUE
(shocked)
Li Qingxuan... Jiang Ying... You two!

LI QINGXUAN
(coldly)
Empress, you have intruded into the bedchamber. That is a capital offense.

JIANG XUE
(questioning)
Then what crime is it for the Emperor to casually bed an unwed woman from outside the palace and neglect state affairs?

LI QINGXUAN
(sneering)
Ridiculous! I am the Emperor. What crime is it to favor a woman? Let me tell you, today I will make her Empress! And you, for intruding and disturbing me, shall be executed on the spot!

LI QINGXUAN
(shouting)
Guards!
continuation:
A group of GUARDS rush into the bedchamber, drawing their swords and surrounding JIANG XUE.

GUARDS
Ha!

The GUARDS swing their swords at JIANG XUE. She dodges easily, grabs one GUARD by the neck, and throws him out, knocking down another GUARD.

Her movements are fluid. Within a few moves, she has defeated all the GUARDS.

The GUARDS struggle to their feet, looking at her in terror.

LI QINGXUAN
(furious)
Capture Jiang Xue! Ten thousand taels of gold as reward! Anyone who retreats will have nine generations of their family executed!

Spurred by the reward and punishment, the GUARDS roar and charge at JIANG XUE again.

GUARDS
Yah!

JIANG XUE crouches down, placing both hands on the luxurious carpet and channeling her internal energy. The carpet instantly shatters, and a powerful wave of force sends all the GUARDS flying backward. They crash heavily to the ground, unconscious.

JIANG XUE
(contemptuously)
You cannot kill me.

As soon as she finishes speaking, JIANG XUE suddenly feels a sharp pain. She falls to her knees and violently coughs up blood.

JIANG YING on the bed reveals a triumphant smile.

JIANG YING
The incense, sister. It was laced with poison from the moment you entered.

JIANG YING rises from the bed, draping herself in imperial robes.

JIANG YING
The Jiang clan grows tired of warrior Empresses. We prefer puppet rulers.

JIANG XUE collapses, her eyes locked on the dragon emblem above. A final smile frozen on her lips.

JIANG YING
(whisper)
Why do you smile?

Silence. JIANG XUE is still.

title: Eight Years Later
description: A woman secretly posing as the righteous thief Jade Hero to aid the poor discovers her husband, comatose for eight years, has finally awakened.
context:
Title: Eight Years Later
Description: A woman secretly posing as the righteous thief Jade Hero to aid the poor discovers her husband, comatose for eight years, has finally awakened.

INT. OUTSIDE GOVERNMENT OFFICE - DAY

An OFFICIAL rides his horse, shouting angrily.

OFFICIAL
Sealed! Every road out of the province!
I want Jade Hero's head by dawn!

A masked figure, JADE HERO, leaps across rooftops above a bamboo forest. The OFFICIAL's guards rampage through an impoverished village, and VILLAGERS scatter to avoid them.

VILLAGER (V.O.)
(whispered)
Bless you, Jade Hero...

INT. DILAPIDATED SHACK - DAY

A LITTLE GIRL sits by the bed, caring for her seriously ill MOTHER.

LITTLE GIRL
(quietly desperate)
I'll find a way. The apothecary said three days—

MOTHER
(weakly)
No, child. Let me go.

A cloth pouch lands in the doorway. The LITTLE GIRL retrieves it, revealing silver taels.

LITTLE GIRL
(breathless)
Mother... it's from Jade Hero.

MOTHER
(tearfully)
Then I can die in peace... May heaven guard that noble soul.
continuation:
EXT. VILLAGE - DAY

JADE HERO rides into a stable. Dismounting, QIN XIANGYU removes her mask, revealing her face.

TITLE CARD: CHEN HEMEI'S WIFE - QIN XIANGYU

She stuffs her black cloak into a feed sack, rubbing dirt onto the horse's distinctive markings.

SOLDIERS (O.S.)
The horse came this way! Search every stall!

SOLDIERS rush toward QIN XIANGYU but see only a woman in plain clothes with a common nag.

SOLDIER
You—see anyone in black?

QIN XIANGYU
(shakes head)
Only my husband's horse, sir.

The soldiers charge past. Qin Xiangyu exhales.

EXT. VILLAGE MARKET - DAY

AUNT WANG tends her bun stall.

AUNT WANG
Two steamed, coming up!

QIN XIANGYU walks over carrying a basket.

QIN XIANGYU
Aunt Wang.

AUNT WANG
Yu'er, you're finally here. Take these.

AUNT WANG stuffs two steaming buns into QIN XIANGYU's hands.

QIN XIANGYU
Auntie, I can't—

AUNT WANG
You saved Xiao Hu. Let an old woman help.

(beat)
Still tending his horse?

QIN XIANGYU
(nods)
He'll want it waiting.

AUNT WANG
(sighs)
Top scholar... what a waste.

Qin Xiangyu's expression darkens. Her daughter, CHEN YUEPING, runs over.

CHEN YUEPING
(shouting)
Mother!

CHEN YUEPING
(out of breath)
Father's eyes... they opened!

QIN XIANGYU lifts her head in shock, the buns falling from her hands to the ground.

title: Love at First Sight, Destined to Be Together
description: A Taoist disciple with a rare constitution must find her destined partner before her twentieth birthday or face certain death. She falls from the sky into the arms of her betrothed.
context:
Title: Love at First Sight, Destined to Be Together
Description: A Taoist disciple with a rare constitution must find her destined partner before her twentieth birthday or face certain death. She falls from the sky into the arms of her betrothed.

INT. ANCIENT COURTYARD - DAY

Golden light flashes. JIANG YI descends from the sky, silk robes fluttering as she lands.

JIANG YI
(laughing breathlessly)
Little Phoenix, your feathers can't hide you forever!

XUAN WUMING sits at a stone table, pouring tea.

LITTLE PHOENIX darts from behind his robes, tail feathers looking ragged.

LITTLE PHOENIX
Master, she'll pluck me bare!

JIANG YI chases LITTLE PHOENIX around XUAN WUMING.

JIANG YI
Just one! For my calligraphy!

XUAN WUMING flicks his fan. Invisible force lifts JIANG YI, suspending her.

JIANG YI
(surprised)
Master!

XUAN WUMING
(eyes sharp)
The winter solstice approaches. Your twentieth birthday with it. Do you feel the cold deepening?

JIANG YI
In my bones. Every night.

XUAN WUMING
Then you know what comes next.

He releases her. She lands, face serious. From his sleeve, a red silk scroll materializes.

JIANG YI takes it, unrolling it with trembling fingers.

JIANG YI
Fu Chengyan. The name means nothing.

XUAN WUMING
His chi burns with Mystic Yang fire. Only his flame can thaw the ice in your veins. But he burns too bright—without balance, he'll be ash before the moon turns.

Wind swirls. JIANG YI's satchel floats into her hands.

XUAN WUMING (V.O.)
Your senior sister waits in the mortal realm. Silk pouch for emergencies, paper for pride. I depart at dawn. Do not seek me.

JIANG YI
(calling into the wind)
Master—what if he refuses?
continuation:
INT. HOT SPRING POOL - DAY

Scalding mist rises. FU CHENGYAN floats in the center, silver-streaked hair clinging to his neck. Iron chains glow with sealing runes. Each breath makes the water hiss.

ELDER HEALER (V.O.)
The Yang fever rages. Seven days, perhaps eight, before his own life force turns to ash. Only Clear Spring Mountain's recluse might temper this fire—but he vanished into mist a decade past.

EXT. EDGE OF HOT SPRING POOL - DAY

ASSISTANT XU addresses a line of veiled women, each bearing medicinal herbs.

ASSISTANT XU
The matriarch offers sanctuary and honor to any woman who can quell Young Master Fu's affliction. Her gratitude would know no bounds.

WOMEN
(whispering)
A chance to save him...

ASSISTANT XU
Please. He suffers.

The women approach the pool with hesitant reverence, extending lotus leaves with cooling salves.

FU CHENGYAN
(voice hoarse but commanding)
Withdraw. This burden is not yours.

They retreat with respect. One woman pauses.

WOMAN
(gently)
We meant no offense, Young Master. Only... your clan needs you.

They depart. ASSISTANT XU wrings his hands.

ASSISTANT XU
Young Master, your betrothed from the Jiang family delays again. Your uncle moves in the shadows. If you cannot be saved, at least let the line continue...

FU CHENGYAN
Dismissed. Seal the spring.

He coughs. Blood drips into the water, hissing like molten metal.

ASSISTANT XU
But--

FU CHENGYAN
Seal it.

ASSISTANT XU bows and retreats. The chain runes glow brighter.

Suddenly, a cry echoes from above.

JIANG YI (O.S.)
Below! Clear the--

JIANG YI crashes through the canopy and plunges into the spring.

She surfaces, sputtering—and locks eyes with FU CHENGYAN.

The phoenix feather in her hair glows. The chain on his wrist pulses.

Both still. Both seeing.

The water around them begins to shimmer—not with heat, but with something else entirely.
group_id: love at first sight, destined to be together

title: After Descending the Mountain, A Peerless Beauty Insists on Becoming My Disciple
description: A powerful cultivator is hunted by celestial forces after defying the heavens and avenging his master.
context:
Title: After Descending the Mountain, A Peerless Beauty Insists on Becoming My Disciple
Description: A powerful cultivator is hunted by celestial forces after defying the heavens and avenging his master.

EXT. SNOWY MOUNTAIN WILDERNESS - DAY

A fractured solar halo stains the heavens.

ANCESTOR (V.O.)
Jiang Wuqi! You shattered the Heavenly Court's edict and slew your own ancestor! Ten thousand deaths cannot atone for this sin!

JIANG WUQI crashes from the sky, slamming into the frozen earth. Blood sprays across the snow.

JIANG WUQI struggles to rise, violet light flickering beneath his skin. Blood drips from his mouth.

Three IMMORTALS descend from the sky, hovering in the air, surrounding JIANG WUQI—IMMORTAL A, IMMORTAL B, IMMORTAL C.

IMMORTAL A
Surrender the Samsara Codex, Jiang Wuqi. Return to the Immortal Court in chains, and we might spare a fragment of your soul.

JIANG WUQI
The same court that watched my master shatter into soul-dust? The same ancestor who sent my senior sister into the Demonic Abyss? Come then. Take me.

IMMORTAL C
Insolence!

The three IMMORTALS attack simultaneously. JIANG WUQI forms a violet lotus seal, and a barrier appears, blocking the attack.

The barrier shatters instantly. JIANG WUQI is sent flying.

JIANG WUQI rolls on the ground dodging wave after wave of attacks, but is eventually hit by several energy blasts and falls motionless.

The three IMMORTALS slowly land and walk toward JIANG WUQI lying on the ground.

IMMORTAL B
With injuries like these, how did you ever break the Ancestor's Nine Heavens Seal?

Suddenly, the sound of clapping comes from behind them. The three turn around in shock.
continuation:
JIANG WUQI's true body appears behind them at some point, looking composed but pale.

JIANG WUQI
A decent effort. You nearly destroyed my blood puppet.

The "JIANG WUQI" on the ground dissolves into motes of violet light, leaving only a bloodstained talisman.

IMMORTAL A
Blood puppetry? That art was lost with the ancient immortals—

JIANG WUQI
Let me show you what else was lost.

JIANG WUQI gathers powerful violet lightning energy spheres in both hands. His hands tremble slightly.

IMMORTAL A (terrified)
He's channeling Primordial Lightning...

JIANG WUQI slams the lightning spheres into the ground. Countless bolts of lightning instantly engulf the three IMMORTALS.

The three IMMORTALS are blasted away by the electric light, falling to the ground in disarray, severely injured.

IMMORTAL B (struggling)
You're no mere cultivator... Who are you?

JIANG WUQI (bitter smile)
Just a disciple who buried his master.

The sky tears open, and a massive figure formed of storm clouds appears above.

ANCESTOR
Will you bury your sect next, traitor?

JIANG WUQI looks up at the ANCESTOR in the sky, his expression grave. For a heartbeat, grief crosses his face.

JIANG WUQI
If I must.

In the treeline, a PEERLESS BEAUTY in white watches, her eyes reflecting starlight.

title: The Sales Champion's Layoff

context:
Title: The Sales Champion's Layoff
Description: A veteran employee's celebration of his third consecutive sales championship shatters when his name appears on the company's layoff list.

INT. COMPANY CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

Fluorescent lights hum over a polished conference table. JIANG JIANGUO (52) sits with a quiet smile, polishing a small "SALES CHAMPION" trophy with his thumb. Nearby COLLEAGUES murmur appreciatively.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
Third month in a row, Old Jiang? You're making us look bad.

JIANG JIANGUO
(soft laugh)
Just lucky.

MALE COLLEAGUE
Li's wallet is gonna feel this one.

BOSS LI raps his Montblanc pen on the table. The chatter dies.

BOSS LI
Monthly numbers. Excellent work.

His eyes scan the room, resting on Jiang for half a second too long.

BOSS LI
However. "Strategic optimization" requires... difficult decisions.

He nods to ASSISTANT WANG, who distributes single sheets—face down.

BOSS LI
Marked papers. HR after the meeting.

Jiang turns his sheet over. A RED LINE slashes through his name. The trophy slips—CLATTERS on the table.

JIANG JIANGUO
...what?

WHISPERS ripple. Colleagues stare at their clean sheets, then at Jiang.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
continuation:
(to herself)
No.

ANOTHER COLLEAGUE
(quiet)
Cost-cutting.

BOSS LI gathers his tablet.

BOSS LI
Meeting adjourned--

JIANG JIANGUO
Wait.

Boss Li pauses.

JIANG JIANGUO stands, holding the paper.

JIANG JIANGUO
My clients. Eight years I've built this.

BOSS LI
The company appreciates that. But we need "fresh energy" in market development.

JIANG JIANGUO
Fresh energy.

He touches the trophy on the table.

JIANG JIANGUO
So the twelve-hour days. The clients who call me at midnight. That's just... outdated?

BOSS LI
Don't make this difficult. Be a team player.

Jiang's jaw tightens. He picks up the trophy. SLAMS it down.

CRYSTAL SHATTERS. A woman GASPS. Silence.

Jiang stares at his hand. Blood wells from a deep cut. He looks at Boss Li, breathing hard, the broken trophy glittering between them.

title: Biological Daughter Xia Tian vs Adopted Daughter Yin Hong
description: A story of jealousy and resentment between a biological daughter and an adopted daughter in rural China, as one gets the chance to return to the city while the other is left behind.
context:
Title: Biological Daughter Xia Tian vs Adopted Daughter Yin Hong
Description: A story of jealousy and resentment between a biological daughter and an adopted daughter in rural China, as one gets the chance to return to the city while the other is left behind.

INT. PEACH ORCHARD - DAY

Sunlight filters through the leaves.

XIA TIAN stands on a simple wooden ladder, wearing a white dress, happily picking peaches.

Adopted daughter YIN HONG, wearing a red floral shirt, stands below the ladder, looking up at XIA TIAN.

XIA TIAN
Yin Hong, we'll have peaches to eat with Mom tonight.

YIN HONG
Sister Xia Tian, there are a few more peaches over there.

XIA TIAN turns to reach for the peaches farther away. YIN HONG watches her back, her envy gradually turning to jealousy. Her hand grips the ladder leg.

The ladder wobbles. XIA TIAN screams and falls from the ladder. Peaches roll everywhere.

XIA TIAN
Ah!

YIN HONG runs forward and helps XIA TIAN up. XIA TIAN's knee is scraped, blood flowing.

YIN HONG
Sister Xia Tian, are you okay? I lost my grip.

XIA TIAN
(enduring the pain)
Just a scrape, it's fine.

YIN HONG
(staring at the wound)
Falling from that height and not breaking your leg. You're lucky.

THREE DAYS LATER
continuation:
INT. SIMPLE HOUSE - NIGHT

A table is set with a few simple dishes and a cake with "Happy Birthday" written on it, with a single candle on top.

TEACHER MENG helps XIA TIAN, whose knee is bandaged, sit at the table. YIN HONG is already seated there.

XIA TIAN
Wow!

TEACHER MENG
Make a wish.

XIA TIAN and YIN HONG both close their eyes and clasp their hands together to make wishes.

XIA TIAN (V.O.)
I hope we can always be together.

YIN HONG (V.O.)
I hope she never leaves this place.

After making wishes, everyone prepares to eat.

TEACHER MENG
(to YIN HONG)
Yin Hong, actually there's something...

XIA TIAN
(interrupting)
Mom, we're going back to the city tomorrow night. Village Chief Uncle said the bus will wait for us at the east end of the village at seven tomorrow night. When should we pack our luggage?

YIN HONG
(turning to XIA TIAN, quiet)
You're leaving... together?

TEACHER MENG looks troubled and remains silent.

XIA TIAN
(pulling TEACHER MENG's hand, anxiously)
Teacher Meng, please take her with us.

TEACHER MENG
(stroking YIN HONG's shoulder, with difficulty)
Yin Hong, the work assignment only covers biological children. If anyone finds a discrepancy, none of us can leave.

TEACHER MENG
(guiltily)
Yin Hong, I'm sorry. When the roster was made, only Xia Tian's name was listed.

XIA TIAN
(angrily)
If Sister Yin Hong isn't going, then I'm not going either!

TEACHER MENG
Let's do this: we'll go back to the city and get settled first, then we'll find a way to bring Yin Hong back, okay?

XIA TIAN
(with tears)
Then we have to bring Sister Yin Hong back before autumn, okay?

TEACHER MENG hugs XIA TIAN to comfort her. YIN HONG sits to the side, watching them with cold eyes.

YIN HONG (V.O.)
It's all because of you. If it weren't for you, I could go to the city with Teacher Meng and live a good life.
group_id: biological daughter xia tian vs adopted daughter yin hong

title: Sweet Little Village Wife
description: A CEO is abandoned in a rural village by his assistant on his father's orders, where he encounters a young woman being mistreated by her ex-boyfriend.
context:
Title: Sweet Little Village Wife
Description: A CEO is abandoned in a rural village by his assistant on his father's orders, where he encounters a young woman being mistreated by her ex-boyfriend.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

A black sedan navigates potholes on a rural highway, flanked by lush green rice paddies. The car jerks violently.

INT. SEDAN - DAY

XIAO YI, CEO of Xiao Corporation, mid-30s, wearing a rumpled suit, jolts awake. Dark circles under his eyes. Coffee stains his shirt cuff. He checks his watch, then his phone—no signal.

XIAO YI
(quietly)
We should've been at the Imperial Hotel two hours ago. Ake, where are we?

The driver, AKE, 40s, grizzled hands on the wheel, avoids the rearview mirror. His knuckles are white.

AKE
Mr. Xiao... your father called again this morning.

XIAO YI
(rubbing his temples)
The Bai family merger. I told him—no marriage meetings during the quarterly reviews.

AKE
Chairman's consolidating his holdings. He said... he said if you won't consider Miss Bai seriously, you're to spend time in Xu Family Village. Without corporate resources.

The car hits another pothole. XIAO YI's coffee cup tips. He catches it, but hot liquid splashes his shirt.

XIAO YI
(ice in his voice)
You diverted my car. Based on a threat.

AKE
I have a daughter starting university. The Chairman's been... generous with the staff investment program.

A long beat. XIAO YI looks out at the endless fields.

XIAO YI
Pull over.
continuation:
EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

The sedan stops. AKE pops the trunk, removes a duffel bag.

AKE
I keep spare clothes for village visits. Fresher uniform than that stained suit.

From the bag: a simple button-down shirt, work pants, sturdy boots. Practical. Not a uniform.

XIAO YI
(taking the clothes)
You're not coming back.

AKE
Chairman's tracking the car GPS. I need to drive around two hours. Then... I don't know.

XIAO YI studies his assistant—ten years of loyalty, now this.

XIAO YI
Make sure your daughter gets her tuition.

AKE nods, throat tight. XIAO YI changes beside the car, methodical. The CEO disappears; a regular man remains.

XIAO YI
When my father asks—tell him I said the Bai family bleeds companies dry. I'd dissolve Xiao Corp before merging with parasites.

AKE
He won't listen.

XIAO YI
Then he'll learn what happens when you corner someone.

AKE gets in the car. The engine starts. XIAO YI turns away, not watching it leave.

The car reverses, turns, and speeds back the way it came. Dust settles.

XIAO YI stands alone. He checks his pockets—wallet, dead phone, keys to apartments and offices that mean nothing here. He begins walking.

A worn stone marker: "Xu Family Village - 3 Li."

XIAO YI (V.O.)
Xu Family Village. Mother's hometown. Before grandfather disowned her.

In the distance: voices. A man's slurred shouting. A woman's sharp retort. XIAO YI's head lifts. He changes direction toward the sound.

EXT. XU FAMILY VILLAGE ENTRANCE - DAY

Village youth XU SHENG, 20s, blocks LIU MINGZHU's path. He reeks of cheap alcohol. She's steady, holding a canvas grocery bag.

XU SHENG
Two nights at Er Niu's place. Nothing happened. You're being dramatic.

LIU MINGZHU
Step aside. We're done.

XU SHENG
(venom building)
Done? Your grandma's medical bills last month—who helped? You think some stranger's gonna—

XIAO YI (O.S.)
Is there a problem here?

XIAO YI appears from around the corner. He doesn't approach directly. He leans against a tree, casual but present. His gaze settles on Xu Sheng.

XU SHENG
(challenging)
Mind your business, outsider.

LIU MINGZHU
(quietly fierce)
I paid back every cent you lent me. With interest. Now get out of my way.

She steps forward. Xu Sheng grabs her wrist. The grocery bag falls—apples roll in the dirt.

XIAO YI
(repeating, softer)
I said. Is there a problem?

Xiao Yi straightens. The tree no longer supports him. He is very still.

title: Five Treasures Unite: Daddy Chases Mommy
description: A young woman's desperate night leads to an unexpected encounter with a mysterious man, resulting in quintuplets that will change both their lives forever.
context:
Title: Five Treasures Unite: Daddy Chases Mommy
Description: A young woman's desperate night leads to an unexpected encounter with a mysterious man, resulting in quintuplets that will change both their lives forever.

INT. NIGHTCLUB - NIGHT

SU XIWEI balances a champagne tray, her mother's bracelet catching the strobe lights.

SU XIWEI (V.O.)
That night, I thought I was fighting for my diploma. Turns out, I was fighting for five.

BOSS FU leers from his VIP sofa. BAI YAN corners SU XIWEI near the bar.

BAI YAN
Last chance. Thirty thousand yuan for one hour with Boss Fu. Or you're deported tomorrow.

SU XIWEI
I said no. I'll find another way.

She spins away—and collides with FU JINGSHEN. Champagne soaks his shirt.

FU JINGSHEN
(steadying her)
Usually people apologize first.

SU XIWEI
I'm sorry! I'll pay for—wait, your bracelet—

Their identical prayer bead bracelets clink together.

FU JINGSHEN
My mother's. She said I'd know my destiny when I saw its match.

ASSISTANT ZHU appears, whispering urgently. FU JINGSHEN's jaw tightens.

FU JINGSHEN
(to SU XIWEI)
Thirty thousand yuan. Marry me tonight. Save your visa. Save my company from my grandmother's ultimatum.

SU XIWEI searches his face. Desperation meets desperation.

SU XIWEI
Just for show?

FU JINGSHEN
Just business. One year. Our secret.

He removes his bracelet, clasping it around her wrist.

FU JINGSHEN
Now we match.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL DELIVERY ROOM - DAY

FADE IN:

TEXT ON SCREEN: NINE MONTHS LATER

SU XIWEI screams, gripping the bracelet. A hidden LED pulses with her heartbeat.

SU XIWEI
(between contractions)
You said you'd find me...

DOCTOR
First baby's out! Wait—this is impossible. It's... quintuplets?

SU XIWEI
(shocked)
What?

She faints. Five nurses hold five newborns. One has a blue birthmark.

ASSISTANT ZHU (V.O.)
Boss Fu, the tracker in her bracelet just went active. She's at City Hospital—

FU JINGSHEN (O.S.)
I'm already in the elevator.

FADE OUT.

title: Life Upgrade Guide
description: A man who became a villain's pawn is given a second chance when a game of Russian roulette miraculously sends him back ten years to correct his mistakes.
context:
Title: Life Upgrade Guide
Description: A man who became a villain's pawn is given a second chance when a game of Russian roulette miraculously sends him back ten years to correct his mistakes.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

JIANG MING, in a suit, stands at the edge of the rooftop, holding a revolver.

JIANG MING (V.O.)
My name is Jiang Ming. My business cards say I'm a real estate executive.

JIANG MING points the gun at his temple.

JIANG MING (V.O.)
One bullet. Five pulls. 16.67% survival. Better odds than I've given my victims.

JIANG MING (V.O.)
In this life, I've perfected the art of looking away.

JIANG MING pulls the trigger. It clicks empty.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Young JIANG MING wears work clothes. A CONTRACTOR hands him a red safety helmet filled with money.

CONTRACTOR
Xiao Jiang, Li Yong was your brother. But brothers don't bankrupt projects. One accident, and this development becomes a ghost property.

JIANG MING
The pit wasn't marked. We both knew the sign was missing.

CONTRACTOR
(interrupting)
What sign? The only sign that matters is the one you didn't give—the warning he never heard. From now on, Li Yong never existed.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

Back on the rooftop, JIANG MING's eyes are filled with pain.

JIANG MING (V.O.)
I'm sorry, Yongzi. If I had another chance, I would definitely save you.

JIANG MING pulls the trigger again. Another empty click. He moves the gun to his chin.

JIANG MING
Dad, forgive me.
continuation:
INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

JIANG MING's FATHER grabs his arm, emotional.

JIANG MING'S FATHER
Jiang Ming, do you know what that means? Prison!

JIANG MING
Dad, that's the boss of Hengyuan Real Estate. If I take the fall for him for three years, I can get five hundred thousand! Only a fool would refuse!

JIANG MING shakes off his father and walks toward the door.

JIANG MING'S FATHER
Jiang Ming! If you walk out that door today, don't call me your father anymore!

JIANG MING leaves without looking back. His FATHER clutches his chest and collapses painfully onto the sofa.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

JIANG MING (V.O.)
Dad, Yongzi, give me one more chance, I will definitely be a good person!

JIANG MING
(shouting)
Do you know what happened to me after that?

INT. OFFICE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

XU HENGYUAN, the boss of Hengyuan Real Estate, pats JIANG MING on the shoulder.

XU HENGYUAN
Jiang Ming, from today on, you are Hengyuan Real Estate's top enforcer!

JIANG MING
(smiling obsequiously)
Thank you, Brother.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

LI YONG'S MOTHER kneels on the ground, crying and grabbing JIANG MING's pant leg.

LI YONG'S MOTHER
Jiang Ming! Your housing project, they just stopped building it! This money is my life savings!

INT. OFFICE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

JIANG MING is tied with rope, kneeling before XU HENGYUAN.

XU HENGYUAN
Jiang Ming, you're nothing but a dog by my side, and you dare to report Hengyuan Group? Even though I did all the bad things, the public will think it was Jiang Ming who owes them billions in relocation funds!

XU HENGYUAN laughs maniacally.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

JIANG MING (V.O.)
I became exactly what they needed: a scapegoat with a name and face. I, Jiang Ming, am nothing but debt.

JIANG MING shoves the gun in his mouth and frantically pulls the trigger. Another empty click.

JIANG MING
(desperately)
Four shots.

JIANG MING
(roaring at the sky)
Heaven! Are you trying to let me live again?

Past scenes flash rapidly. JIANG MING's emotions collapse. He points the gun at his temple again and roars as he pulls the trigger for the fifth time.

SOUND: A gunshot rings out.

INT. DORM ROOM - DAY

JIANG MING jolts awake from a crude bed, screaming frantically.

JIANG MING
(touching his head, in disbelief)
I'm not dead? I'm not dead!

He looks around and realizes he's in the construction site dormitory from ten years ago.

JIANG MING
I've been reborn!

JIANG MING clasps his hands together, excited and grateful.

JIANG MING
Thank you, Heaven! In this life, I will never go down the wrong path again! I will definitely be a good person!

He sees a calendar on the wall showing April 2nd.

JIANG MING
April 2nd... I will never forget this day. This is the day Li Yong fell into the pit.

AMING'S GIRLFRIEND (O.S.)
Aming, you're awake.

A pretty girl wearing a white top and plaid skirt walks in.

title: Temptation by Design (Episode 51)
description: A woman wakes up in a hospital to find herself recruited into a revenge scheme by her enemy's adoptive brother, who offers her a new identity as his deceased sister.
context:
Title: Temptation by Design (Episode 51)
Description: A woman wakes up in a hospital to find herself recruited into a revenge scheme by her enemy's adoptive brother, who offers her a new identity as his deceased sister.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Sunlight cuts through blinds, striping the sterile room. The FEMALE LEAD stirs, her fingers twitching against white sheets. A heartbeat monitor beeps steadily.

GU SHIYAN sits in shadows, his face half-lit. He leans forward as her eyes flutter open.

GU SHIYAN
(gently)
Welcome back.

The FEMALE LEAD jolts upright, pain flashing across her features. Her hand flies to her bandaged ribs.

FEMALE LEAD
(her voice raw)
Did they—

GU SHIYAN
(interrupting)
He thinks you're dead. The river current helped.

She studies him, her gaze sharpening despite the drugs. She notices his expensive watch, the way he doesn't quite sit like a worried relative.

FEMALE LEAD
You're not a doctor.

GU SHIYAN
(observing her closely)
No. I'm the man who pulled you out. And the man who can put you back in.

A beat. She understands.

FEMALE LEAD
Gu Ruosheng's brother.

GU SHIYAN
(slight nod)
Gu Shiyan. You've done your homework.

FEMALE LEAD
(defensive edge)
When your husband tries to kill you, you learn his enemies.

She winces, touching her throat—fingerprint bruises still visible.

GU SHIYAN
(quietly)
My adopted sister Gu Yan spent twenty-three years in a private facility. Three days ago, she died during an "experimental therapy" session. Her death certificate is still warm.

He slides a leather folder onto her lap. She doesn't open it.

GU SHIYAN
Gu Ruosheng signed the transfer papers himself. Another loose end tied.

FEMALE LEAD
(whisper)
Why would I become someone else's ghost?

GU SHIYAN
Because Gu Yan was heir to fifteen percent of Gu Group shares. Because as her, you can walk into any room. Because I saw your face in the water—calm. Like someone who'd already died and decided to come back anyway.

She finally opens the folder. A photo: a fragile girl with her same build, similar eyes.

FEMALE LEAD
(softly)
I don't know how to be her.

GU SHIYAN
You don't have to. You just have to be angry enough to pretend.

He places a small keycard on the file.

GU SHIYAN
Room 314. Her personal effects. I'll give you tonight to decide if you want to keep breathing as a corpse... or start living as a weapon.

He leaves. She stares at the photo—at the girl who could be her sister, her mirror. Her hands tremble.
continuation:
INT. PRESS CONFERENCE VENUE - DAY

The ballroom hums with camera clicks and hushed greed. The backdrop looms: "Lin-Fu Group Merger."

CEO FU adjusts his black mourning armband, playing the grieving widower. His smile is carefully broken.

Below, GUEST 1 checks his phone, leaning to his companion.

GUEST 1
(quietly)
Lin's stock dropped forty percent since the "accident." Efficient way to clear a boardroom.

GUEST 2
Still. Killing your wife? That's—

GUEST 1
That's what happens when you marry your accountant's daughter.

At the podium, CEO FU taps the microphone. The room hushes.

CEO FU
(voice cracking)
My beloved wife lost her battle with depression. In her memory, I've chosen to merge Lin Group—her family's legacy—with Fu Group. Together, we will honor her by building something stronger.

A FEMALE REPORTER stands, her press badge catching light.

FEMALE REPORTER
CEO Fu, sources claim Fu Group's debt load exceeds assets by three hundred million. They allege this "merger" is asset stripping, and your wife discovered the scheme before her death.

The room holds its breath.

A COLD VOICE cuts through from the back row.

GU YAN (O.S.)
She discovered more than that.

Heads turn. GU YAN rises, wearing Gu Yan's signature ivory blazer. She walks with a limp—the real Gu Yan's childhood injury. CEO FU's face drains.

GU YAN
(approaching slowly)
She discovered the offshore accounts. The falsified therapy records. TheDates. She found out you were going to kill her three weeks before the wedding.

She stops ten feet from the stage, her eyes locked on his.

GU YAN
You even asked if I'd be your maid of honor. Remember?

CEO FU
(stammering)
Gu Yan is—that's impossible, she's—

Suddenly, the projectors flicker. Documents, signatures, therapy dates flash across the backdrop. The flyers aren't thrown—they cascade from the ceiling like judgment.

CLOSE-UP: A photo floats down—CEO FU and a doctor exchanging money outside a psychiatric facility.

GUEST 3
(catching one)
My god. That's his signature on the commitment papers.

GUEST 4
He committed his own sister-in-law?

CEO FU stumbles backward as the papers rain down. One sticks to his shoe: "Patient Gu Yan: Termination Authorization."

GU YAN
(her voice carrying)
You wanted a merger? Here's your paperwork.

Camera flashes strobe like lightning. CEO FU clutches the podium, his ashen face reflecting in the dying projector light.

title: Switched at Birth
description: A vengeful servant switches two newborns during a stormy night at a rural hospital, setting in motion a tale of mistaken identities and separated families.
context:
Title: Switched at Birth
Description: A vengeful servant switches two newborns during a stormy night at a rural hospital, setting in motion a tale of mistaken identities and separated families.

INT. VILLAGE HOSPITAL - NIGHT

Rain lashes a dark window. HE XI runs beside her HUSBAND as he pushes a hospital bed. On it, ZHAO WANRU, 25, writhes in advanced labor.

HE XI
(shouting)
Doctor! My mistress—she's breech!

ZHAO WANRU
(screaming through contraction)
Don't let me die in this filth!

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

Narrow, dimly lit. The HUSBAND swerves to avoid a water bucket—COLLIDES with SU SHANHE, 40s, on crutches. Both men crash down.

HE XI
Clumsy oaf!

HUSBAND
(struggling up)
Do you know whose child that is? One word from her and we—

SU YUQIAO'S ADOPTIVE MOTHER stumbles from a doorway, clutching her belly.

SU YUQIAO'S ADOPTIVE MOTHER
You maniac! You could've killed him!

She shoves He Xi. He Xi recoils, knocking the woman against the wall. She doubles over, gasping, water soaking her dress.

SU SHANHE
No— the baby! It's too soon!

He hammers on a supply closet.

SU SHANHE
Nurse! My wife—she's bleeding!

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - LATER

He Xi and her Husband slump against opposite walls, soaked in rain and dread.

HUSBAND
(soft)
Flash flood on the main road. We had no choice.

HE XI
(whisper)
If she blames us... Mingming pays the price.

The DELIVERY ROOM DOOR opens. A NURSE steps out.

NURSE
Zhao Wanru? Mother and daughter are stable.

He Xi's breath hitches—relief and something darker.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - NIGHT

Lightning flickers. ZHAO WANRU lies on starched sheets, already scrolling on her phone, untouched water beside her.

ZHAO WANRU
(without looking up)
Where is it?

HE XI enters, clipboard in hand.

HE XI
The nurse will bring her soon. You should—

ZHAO WANRU
(razor-sharp)
Should? I should be in a private suite, not this sewer. She kicks the bedframe. He Xi flinches.

ZHAO WANRU
My daughter deserves a proper welcome. Not whatever diseases linger in your poverty. Fetch her. And pray she's perfect.

INT. NURSERY - NIGHT

He Xi stands before two cribs. Storm knocked out half the lights. One card: "MOTHER: ZHAO WANRU." The other: "MOTHER: SU YUQIAO'S MOTHER."

Zhao's baby sleeps fitfully. The Su baby is calm, thumb in mouth.

HE XI
(whisper)
You'd be her mirror. Her little monster.

Her hand strays to her knee—old pain.

FLASHBACK

INT. MANSION - DAY

One month ago. He Xi scrubs marble floors. ZHAO WANRU glides past. He Xi shifts the bucket—too slow. Water darkens silk hem.

SECOND MAID
Mistress! It won't happen again!

HE XI
(whisper)
My son needs this job. Please.

ZHAO WANRU
(cold)
My Mingming fell because of you. He still has the scar.

She lifts a crystal bowl—drops it. SHATTER.

ZHAO WANRU
Kneel.

HE XI
Mistress—

ZHAO WANRU
Or I call the authorities. Your boy becomes a ward of the state.

He Xi kneels. Glass bites through fabric. Blood pools.

ZHAO WANRU
Some people are born to serve. Some are born to be served.

She nods. The Second Maid slaps He Xi—once, twice. Mechanically. Ashamed.

HE XI
(soft)
Mingming... forgive me...

END FLASHBACK

INT. NURSERY - NIGHT

Back to the present. HE XI looks at ZHAO WANRU's crying baby daughter. Her hand trembles above the crib.

The Su infant stirs, opens eyes—dark, like her son's. He Xi notices a strawberry birthmark on the girl's wrist. Identical to Mingming's.

HE XI
(whisper)
God forgive me.

She lifts the Su baby. The child nuzzles into her neck, trusting. He Xi holds her close—one moment of tenderness.

Then, trembling, she places the Su baby in Zhao's crib. Lifts Zhao's daughter.

HE XI
(to the baby girl)
She'll never know you. And you'll never know her poison.

HE XI cradles the infant, her face a mask of pain and fierce possession. She disappears into the thunder.

Title: You Are the Mantis, I Am the Sparrow (Episode 41)
Description: A woman is nearly killed by her brother-in-law after her sister's miscarriage, only to be reborn and given a second chance to change her fate.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

WANG HU (O.S.)
You think you can erase her child with a single mistake?

SONG NUAN lies on the stone floor, gasping. WANG HU, in ceremonial armor, towers over her. LI QING stands in the shadows, avoiding her gaze.

SONG NUAN (V.O.)
They blame me for my sister's fall. For the life inside her. For the heir they would have killed me to protect.

WANG HU's boot presses down on her throat.

INT. THEATER - DAY (FLASHBACK)

SONG YUN YAN clutches the second-floor railing, eight months swollen. Her foot catches on a loose board. She tumbles forward, silk dress catching air.

SONG YUN YAN
(scream cuts short)

She lands at the bottom. Crimson spreads across marble.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

LI QING
You think I didn't see your relief when she fell? This was always about envy.

SONG NUAN
(strangled)
I loved her. I would never—

LI QING
You kept her in the heat. You watched her beg. The seat I gave you became her death sentence.
continuation:
INT. ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

LI QING drapes a mink stole over SONG NUAN's shoulders.

LI QING
First row. Just for you. I bribed three officials for this view.

SONG NUAN
But Yun Yan is with child. The second floor is so hot—

LI QING
She wanted to come. Let her appreciate the gesture.

INT. THEATER - DAY (FLASHBACK)

SONG YUN YAN leans over the second-floor railing, pale and sweating.

SONG YUN YAN
Sister, please. I feel faint.

SONG NUAN
(stares at her velvet seat)
This was his gift to me.

SONG YUN YAN
Just for the first act. Please.

SONG NUAN turns away.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

LI QING draws his sword. The blade sings.

LI QING
Brother Wang. The family justice is yours to deliver.

He offers the hilt. WANG HU takes it.

The candlelight catches the steel as it rises.

EXT. THEATER ENTRANCE - NIGHT

Snow falls like ash. The opera's aria spills into the street:

OPERA SINGER (O.S.)
One life ends, another begins... the wheel turns blind...

SONG NUAN stands in the snow, looking bewildered. SONG YUN YAN walks up to her, eight months pregnant, very much alive.

SONG YUN YAN
Sister, why are you standing there in a daze? Let's go in and watch the opera.

SONG NUAN looks around, then at the Buddhist prayer beads in her hand—one bead is cracked, leaking faint golden light.

SONG NUAN (V.O.)
This is... I've been reborn. Reborn one hour before the fall.

title: You Said You'd Find Me
description: In 2009, a CEO mother and her young daughter are hunted through the mountains in a storm. The daughter sacrifices herself to save her mother.
context:
Title: You Said You'd Find Me
Description: In 2009, a CEO mother and her young daughter are hunted through the mountains in a storm. The daughter sacrifices herself to save her mother.

INT. JIANG FAMILY BACK MOUNTAIN - NIGHT

Torrential rain pours down, thunder rumbles. JIANG SHU (38, sharp features now haggard) runs frantically along a muddy mountain path in a torn black suit, soaked through. She clutches her daughter JIANG XIA (7, small but fierce).

PURSUER (O.S.)
Hurry up and find those two! If the Jiang family finds them first, we're finished!

Jiang Shu slips, slamming into a puddle with Jiang Xia. Her temple strikes a rock. Blood mixes with rainwater. Her grip loosens.

JIANG XIA
(anxious)
Mom! Your head--

Jiang Shu blinks hard, fighting unconsciousness.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - DAY

FLASHBACK. Jiang Shu and Jiang Xia cower against a concrete wall as kidnappers close in. SCARFACE (40s, brutal, calculating) cracks his knuckles. Rain hammers a distant window.

SCARFACE
The boss says you don't leave here alive. Nothing personal—just business.

JIANG SHU
(angry and terrified)
I'm CEO of Jiang Corporation. My family will pay triple whatever you're getting.

SCARFACE
(leaning in)
Your own brother hired us, Mrs. CEO. Said you and the brat are blocking his inheritance.

He signals his men. They advance.

SCARFACE (CONT'D)
Take them to the mountain. Make it look like an accident.

INT. JIANG FAMILY BACK MOUNTAIN - NIGHT

Back to reality. Scarface leads several THUGS through the storm, flashlights cutting through the downpour.

THUG
(excitedly)
Two million! Boss promised two million for the Jiang heir and her kid!

SCARFACE
Shut up and search!
continuation:
INT. CAVE - NIGHT

Jiang Shu lies unconscious in a dark cave. Blood flows from her temple. Jiang Xia rips fabric from her own shirt, pressing it to her mother's wound.

JIANG XIA
(crying quietly)
Mommy... please...

Jiang Shu's eyes flutter open, unfocused.

JIANG SHU
(whispering)
Pain pain fly away... Mommy doesn't hurt anymore...

Her eyes roll back. She goes limp.

JIANG XIA
(crying louder)
Mom! Wake up! You promised you'd find me!

FOOTSTEPS approach outside. Flashlight beams dance near the entrance.

JIANG XIA (CONT'D)
(whispering)
You have to hide. Don't move.

She covers her mother with dry leaves and branches, then kisses her forehead.

EXT. MOUNTAIN ROAD - NIGHT

Three black sedans skid to a halt. JIANG FAMILY BODYGUARDS leap out, weapons drawn.

CHIEF BODYGUARD
(into walkie-talkie)
Fan out! Find them before the kidnappers do! Move!

The bodyguards storm up the mountain.

INT. CAVE - NIGHT

FLASHLIGHT beams pierce the darkness. Scarface's silhouette looms.

SCARFACE (O.S.)
Check every hole. They can't be far.

Jiang Xia's eyes widen. She looks at her unconscious mother, then at the jade pendant around her own neck—a family heirloom.

EXT. JIANG FAMILY BACK MOUNTAIN - NIGHT

Jiang Xia bursts from the cave, running perpendicular to her mother's location.

JIANG XIA
(shouting)
I'm here! Come get me!

Scarface and the Thugs wheel around. Rain drenches them all.

SCARFACE
(grinning viciously)
Smart little brat. But not smart enough.

He lunges, grabbing her neck. He rips the jade pendant from her, then throws her down a steep slope. She vanishes into the darkness with a scream.

SCARFACE (CONT'D)
She's gone. Find the mother—fast!

A THUG
(panicked)
Boss! Jiang family guards!

Flashlight beams sweep from another ridge—fifty yards away.

INT. CAVE - NIGHT

Jiang Shu's eyes snap open. She hears the commotion. Her fingers find the spot where Jiang Xia hid her. Empty. She sees light—her bodyguards.

She also sees something glinting in the mud near the cave entrance: the jade pendant.

CLOSE ON: Jiang Shu's bloodied hand clutching the pendant. Her face crumples.

JIANG SHU
(whispered)
You said you'd hide... not run.

She struggles to her feet, staring at where her daughter disappeared.

JIANG SHU (CONT'D)
(weak but determined)
You said you'd find me. Now I'll find you.

She staggers toward the slope as bodyguards rush in.

FADE OUT.

title: Phoenix Cry in the Palace
description: A concubine is murdered for her unborn child by a scheming imperial consort, but vows revenge as she dies and is mysteriously reborn.
context:
Title: Phoenix Cry in the Palace
Description: A concubine is murdered for her unborn child by a scheming imperial consort, but vows revenge as she dies and is mysteriously reborn.

INT. YIXIU PALACE - NIGHT

Thunder rattles the lattice windows. Palace lanterns sway.

GAO YAOFENG, Imperial Noble Consort, cradles a voodoo doll. A needle glints in her hand. Her smile is measured.

GAO YAOFENG
(softly)
Almost done.

INT. ANNEX CHAMBER - NIGHT

SU YUNROU lies bound to a birthing bed, full-term and struggling.

NANNY LI arranges surgical blades with cold precision.

NANNY LI
Early, but the method is sound. I've done it before.

INT. CORRIDOR - NIGHT

XIAO TAO thrashes between two GUARDS.

XIAO TAO
She's not even due yet—

NANNY LI appears, backhanding Xiao Tao across the mouth. The maid crumples.
continuation:
INT. ANNEX CHAMBER - NIGHT

Su Yunrou's eyes snap to the slamming door.

SU YUNROU
(to Gaoyaofeng)
The Emperor's heir—he'll know!

GAO YAOFENG glides forward, silk robes whispering.

GAO YAOFENG
Know what? That you died in childbirth? Tragic. But common.

GAO YAOFENG
(to Nanny Li)
Bring me the child. If it's a girl—you know what to do.

SU YUNROU
Elder sister, we share blood—

GAO YAOFENG seizes Su Yunrou's jaw, forcing cloth into her mouth.

GAO YAOFENG
Blood? You're father's shame. I brought you here because you reminded me of her. The late Empress. You dared to carry what I could not.

SU YUNROU
(sobbing)
I never wanted—

GAO YAOFENG
You have it. And now I do.

CONSORT SUN enters with a lacquered bowl.

CONSORT SUN
Kindness is just another word for blind here, Su Yunrou.

NANNY LI's blade rises. Falls.

A muffled scream——

A baby's thin cry.

NANNY LI wraps the infant in imperial yellow.

NANNY LI
A prince, Your Ladyship.

GAO YAOFENG takes the child. Su Yunrou reaches weakly.

SU YUNROU
My son...

CONSORT SUN forces the poison down. Su Yunrou convulses, blood on her lips. A final, bitter laugh.

EUNUCH (O.S.)
Concubine Su is gone. Prepare the rites.

SU YUNROU (V.O.)
I was clay. You fired me into porcelain. Next life, I will be the hammer.

EXT. PALACE ROOFTOP - NIGHT

Lightning forks. The palace glows white.

INT. GARDEN PAVILION - DAY

SU YUNROU, now thirteen, awakens with a gasp. She touches her flat stomach. Remembers.

SU YUNROU
(voice hardening)
Clay remembers the kiln.

She rises.

Title: The Misogynist Heartthrob Clings to Me
Description: A desperate young woman faces rejection from her family after discovering she's pregnant, leading her to the edge, but a chance encounter with a powerful CEO two months earlier may have changed her fate.

ZHAO ZHAODI stands at the edge of the rooftop, her expression full of despair, clutching a medical test report in her hand.

MOTHER (V.O.)
Your brother's surgery is in two weeks. All that tuition money... it was our only choice.

FATHER (V.O.)
We'd have nothing left. You understand, don't you?

ZHAO ZHAODI walks step by step toward the edge of the rooftop railing, tears streaming down her face.

ZHAO ZHAODI
(choking up)
Why is survival always someone else's price to pay?

She clutches the test report tightly to her chest, closing her eyes in pain. The report slips from her hand and falls to the ground.

ON SCREEN: TWO MONTHS AGO
continuation:
EXT. UNIVERSITY ENTRANCE - DAY

The campus is bustling with people coming and going. ZHAO ZHAODI pulls her suitcase, wearing a backpack, and walks into the campus.

INT. SCHOOL LOBBY - DAY

YAN SHIHAO, wearing a black suit, walks through the lobby surrounded by a group of people. ZHAO ZHAODI happens to enter from the doorway. They pass each other, their eyes meeting briefly.

ON SCREEN: YAN SHIHAO, CHAIRMAN OF GU CORPORATION

YAN SHIHAO and his entourage walk out the door.

INT. NEW STUDENT REGISTRATION DESK - DAY

ZHAO ZHAODI waits in line at the registration desk. When it's her turn, she hands a bank card to the REGISTRATION TEACHER.

REGISTRATION TEACHER
(looking at the computer)
I'm showing insufficient funds on this card.

ZHAO ZHAODI
(surprised)
That's impossible. I deposited four thousand seven hundred myself. Could you try once more?

The REGISTRATION TEACHER takes the card and swipes it again.

REGISTRATION TEACHER
The balance is zero. The account was cleared out yesterday.

ZHAO ZHAODI
(whispering)
She promised she wouldn't. Not after I earned that scholarship...

MALE STUDENT
(waiting in line behind her)
You're Zhao Zhaodi, right? The scholarship poster girl? Thought your education was paid for.

FEMALE STUDENT
(next to the male student)
Maybe scholarships don't cover everything these days. Some of us have to work for it.

ZHAO ZHAODI lowers her head in embarrassment, picks up her belongings, and prepares to leave.

REGISTRATION TEACHER
Student, if you can provide proof of financial hardship by Friday, we have an emergency fund. Don't lose hope.

ZHAO ZHAODI turns back, tears in her eyes, a flicker of something other than despair on her face.

title: Another Year of Soul-Breaking Night
description: A top AI scientist faces a massive cyber attack threatening her nation's technological sovereignty, forcing her to make an impossible choice between years of research and protecting core technology.
context:
Title: Another Year of Soul-Breaking Night
Description: A top AI scientist faces a massive cyber attack threatening her nation's technological sovereignty, forcing her to make an impossible choice between years of research and protecting core technology.

INT. HIGH-TECH LABORATORY - DAY

Red alarm lights flash urgently. Screens display red "ACCESS DENIED" messages.

FAST CUTS:
Scientists frantically typing on keyboards.
Green code scrolling rapidly on screens.
The entire laboratory in a state of high tension.

ON SCREEN: ZHENG NIANJIA, Chief Scientist, appears on monitor composed amidst chaos.

A MALE COLLEAGUE stands up from his seat in panic, rushing toward ZHENG NIANJIA, who studies a tablet.

MALE COLLEAGUE
(anxiously)
Chief Engineer Zheng, we can't hold on much longer! Eighty hours now, this exceeds normal human physiological limits! The attack—230 million requests per second. This is nation-state level. If they breach the kernel...

ZHENG NIANJIA
(coldly)
Return to your station.

The MALE COLLEAGUE looks reluctant but turns back.

ZHENG NIANJIA stands, tablet pressed to her chest, addresses the room.

ZHENG NIANJIA
Everyone. My father bled out in a lab in '03 building the prototype you're using. The WestTech embargo took his arm, not his work.

(beat)
This isn't about data. They want the skeleton—how our AI thinks. If they get that, we become obsolete.

She holds up her tablet. On it: a photo of her father, sleeves pinned, before a whiteboard.

ZHENG NIANJIA
We protect the method. Not the files.

The MALE COLLEAGUE and other colleagues are inspired, eyes becoming determined.

COLLEAGUES (V.O.)
The method. The method.

MONTAGE:
Team members working day and night, clock shadows spinning rapidly across the screen.

ZHENG NIANJIA looks exhausted, pressing her temples, frowning tightly.

ZHENG NIANJIA looks at the tablet in her hand, the screen showing the same photo.

FLASHBACK - INT. HUMBLE HOME - DAY

Young Nianjia sits at the table, looking at her FATHER with an injured arm in a bandage.

YOUNG NIANJIA
Dad, can't you rest?

FATHER takes out a notebook, pushes it toward her.

FATHER
The algorithm's yours now. Make it so they can't take it away.

Young Nianjia opens it, sees his handwriting.

YOUNG NIANJIA (V.O.)
Make it mine.

FATHER smiles with relief.

END FLASHBACK.
continuation:
INT. HIGH-TECH LABORATORY - DAY

Back to reality, ZHENG NIANJIA looks at the photo on the tablet, silently wipes away a nosebleed, her eyes even more resolute.

The alarm sounds again, more piercing.

MALE COLLEAGUE
(terrified)
Chief Engineer Zheng, our server, even the IP address has been locked!

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
(desperate)
The neural weights—five years of training. If we cut power, we lose everything!

ZHENG NIANJIA stands, expression resolute.

ZHENG NIANJIA
Cut the power.

She walks toward the emergency power cut button.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
(turning around emotionally)
No, we can't cut the power! The server can't stop! Otherwise all our results will be destroyed! This is five years of our work!

ZHENG NIANJIA
(shouting)
Cut the power!

ZHENG NIANJIA
(calmly but firmly)
The architecture is in our heads. The data is just practice. We start over.

ZHENG NIANJIA walks to the emergency button, colleagues watching her in horror.

Tears in her eyes but expression resolute, she presses the red emergency stop button.

Colleagues' expressions are painful, desperate.

ZHENG NIANJIA closes her eyes, a tear falls.

VOICE (O.S.)
Chief Zheng. The Vice Minister is holding.

Zheng opens her eyes, already moving toward exit.

ZHENG NIANJIA
Tell him: the method is secure. Send whoever's still standing to the backup facility.

She exits. The dead lab behind her.

FADE OUT.

title: Return of the Phoenix Daughter
description: Eighteen years after a prophecy, a young woman discovers her true identity as the lost heiress of the powerful Tuoba family on the day her husband returns to the village in glory.

Title: Return of the Phoenix Daughter
Description: Eighteen years after a prophecy, a young woman discovers her true identity as the lost heiress of the powerful Tuoba family on the day her husband returns to the village in glory.

INT. TEMPLE - DAY

EIGHTEEN YEARS AGO

A MASTER in traditional robes clasps a young girl's jade pendant, his thumb pressing the phoenix seal.

MASTER
When the dragon returns, the phoenix will remember her wings.

The Master ties the pendant around the girl's neck with a red thread.

EXT. COMPANY BUILDING - DAY

EIGHTEEN YEARS LATER

A black Maybach stops. TUOBA AN, with silver temples, exits. BODYGUARDS bow.

BODYGUARDS
(in unison)
Chairman.

The MASTER, in plain modern clothes, holds a leather journal.

MASTER
Chairman Tuoba. Eighteen years I've searched our temple records.

He opens the journal to a sketch of the pendant.

TUOBA AN
The missing Miss Xiaoxiao...

MASTER
She's in Ye Family Village. Your demolition order includes her house.

The Master reveals three photos: a child's back with a butterfly birthmark, a young woman's neck wearing the pendant, a wedding photo.

TUOBA AN
(stunned)
She married? Who—

MASTER
The man returning there today as a 'big boss.' He left her behind.

ON SCREEN: TUOBA AN - ELDEST OF THE TUOBA FAMILY
continuation:
INT. OFFICE - DAY

TUOBA AN pours tea with trembling hands. An ASSISTANT proffers documents.

ASSISTANT
The village contracts are ready to sign.

TUOBA AN
Hold them. No one touches that land until I say so.

INT. CONCERT STAGE - NIGHT

TUOBA YUAN, leather jacket and shades, finishes a song. His phone buzzes—"XIAOXIAO FOUND"—he drops his mic.

ON SCREEN: TUOBA YUAN - THIRD OF THE TUOBA FAMILY

EXT. COMPANY BUILDING - DAY

TUOBA AN at the window, phone to his ear. The screen splits: TUOBA YUAN on his tour bus, TUOBA JIN in a boardroom.

TUOBA AN
We found her. In a village we were going to erase.

TUOBA YUAN
(furious)
Erase? That's our sister's home!

TUOBA JIN
(calm, dangerous)
Who kept her there?

INT. TUNNEL - NIGHT

Sports cars speed through, sirens wailing.

EXT. YE FAMILY VILLAGE STREET - DAY

ON SCREEN: YE FAMILY VILLAGE

Firecrackers pop. Drums thunder. Banner: "Welcome Big Boss Ye Zihao's Triumphant Return Home."

VILLAGERS surround WANG XIULI in a too-tight qipao.

NEIGHBOR
Auntie Xiuli, when you're riding in limousines, don't forget us!

WANG XIULI
(laughing too loud)
Forget? I'll send postcards from the penthouse! My son owns the factory that makes the cars!

EXT. YE FAMILY COURTYARD - DAY

ON SCREEN: WEN CHUXIA - ADOPTED DAUGHTER OF THE WEN FAMILY

WEN CHUXIA scrubs clothes, her hands raw. The pendant slips out—she tucks it back in fast.

A VILLAGE GIRL runs in.

VILLAGE GIRL
Sister Chuxia! Brother Zihao's here—at the village entrance!

WEN CHUXIA
(quietly)
Eighteen years... the Master said when the dragon returns—

She looks at the wedding qipao drying on the line.

EXT. VILLAGE ENTRANCE - DAY

Villagers cheer. WEN CHUXIA pushes through to WANG XIULI's side.

WANG XIULI's smile vanishes.

WEN CHUXIA
Mom.

WANG XIULI
(harshly)
Today is my son's victory. Not your place to stand here.

WEN CHUXIA
(quiet but firm)
My husband came home. Should I hide in the kitchen?

WANG XIULI
Know your place. He married you for luck before he left. Now his luck is made.

title: Reborn Heiress Seeks Revenge
description: After dying in a car accident orchestrated by her father and his mistress, a young woman is given a chance to return by a mysterious resurrection system to seek vengeance.
context:
Title: Reborn Heiress Seeks Revenge
Description: After dying in a car accident orchestrated by her father and his mistress, a young woman is given a chance to return by a mysterious resurrection system to seek vengeance.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

A young man clutches the unconscious WEN YAN (22) against his chest, sprinting through fluorescent-lit corridors. His dress shirt is soaked crimson. Nurses scramble.

YOUNG MAN
Doctor! She's crashing!

CLOSE-UP - WEN YAN's face: blood trickles from her temple, her lips parted in a silent gasp.

YOUNG MAN (V.O.)
(whispered, desperate)
Not like this. Not you too.

INT. PURE WHITE SPACE - DAY

WEN YAN lies on a seamless white platform, her hospital gown pristine. She jolts awake, gasping. No wound. No pain. Just endless white.

She touches her temple—finds only smooth skin.

WEN YAN (V.O.)
Mom... the brakes...

WEN YAN
(looking around, disoriented)
Hello?

A FIGURE materializes—TWELVE, wearing a featureless white suit, his face obscured by a shifting digital mask.

TWELVE
(hostile detected)

WEN YAN
What is this place?

TWELVE
A threshold. You're dead, Wen Yan. Three minutes ago, clinically. Your mother's been gone for seven.

WEN YAN
(staggering to her feet)
No. We were just in the car...

TWELVE
Your father's Mercedes T-boned you at the intersection. He'd cut your brake lines. The same accident is being reported as a tragic loss—mother and daughter—leaving him sole heir.

Wen Yan's breath hitches. She doesn't cry—yet. She goes very still.

WEN YAN
(quiet, dangerous)
Liang Mei.

TWELVE
And her children. Your stepbrother now runs Wen Corporation. Your stepsister is auctioning your mother's art collection tonight.

A tremor runs through Wen Yan's hands. She clenches them into fists.

WEN YAN
Then send me back.

TWELVE
I can't. You're legally deceased. Court approved. Burial plot selected.

WEN YAN
(frustrated)
continuation:
You're a resurrection system. Find a loophole.

TWELVE
Exactly. I don't resurrect bodies. I transplant consciousness. A new host. Someone recently deceased. Someone with access.

WEN YAN
(access?)

TWELVE
Liang Mei's daughter. Liang Xue'er. Overdose. Thirty minutes ago. They haven't found her body yet.

WEN YAN
(eyes narrowing)
Her daughter...

TWELVE
Host compatibility: 97%. Her social circle puts you at the auction tonight. At your father's side. But there's a cost.

WEN YAN
Anything.

TWELVE
You inherit her memories. Her guilt. Her addiction. The system suppresses it, but it's there. And if you fail—if they discover you—true death. For both of us.

Wen Yan looks down at her hands. They shimmer, becoming translucent.

WEN YAN
(softly)
Mom wanted me to live.

She looks up, and for the first time, her eyes are dry. Clear. Focused.

WEN YAN
Let's make them pay for both of us.

TWELVE
Transfer initiating. Don't forget—I'm in your head now. Your only ally.

Twelve's mask dissolves into a cascade of code that swirls around Wen Yan. The white space fractures.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY [MEMORY]

Wen Yan's POV: The young man from before—her fiancé, SHENG—holding her dying body. His tears fall on her face.

SHENG (V.O.)
I'll find who did this. I swear.

The memory shatters. The white space implodes.

INT. LUXURY PENTHOUSE - NIGHT

WEN YAN'S EYES snap open. But they're not her eyes anymore. She looks at her reflection in a mirrored ceiling—Liang Xue'er's face, pale, with a fading foam at the corner of her mouth.

WEN YAN (V.O.)
(holding back panic)
Mom... give me strength.

She wipes the foam away. Stands. In the penthouse around her: designer clothes, a family photo—Liang Mei smiling with Chen Dongjie, their perfect family.

WEN YAN
(to herself, testing the voice)
Time for introductions.

She smiles. It's Liang Xue'er's smile. But the hatred behind it is pure Wen Yan.

FADE OUT.

title: The Genius Painter is Not to Be Trifled With
description: A talented young painter is reborn after being betrayed by her junior sister who stole her masterpiece and claimed it as her own, leading to her downfall and death.
context:
Title: The Genius Painter is Not to Be Trifled With
Description: A talented young painter is reborn after being betrayed by her junior sister who stole her masterpiece and claimed it as her own, leading to her downfall and death.

EXT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

AN YIRUO, a young woman in a white dress, sits with her back to the camera in front of a blank easel. In the distance, a brightly lit cross-sea bridge spans the horizon.

ON SCREEN: AN YIRUO - A genius young woman with exceptional painting skills

AN YIRUO suddenly wakes with a start, her expression filled with terror.

AN YIRUO (V.O.)
I've been reborn. But the canvas is still empty.

AN YIRUO looks at her hands as memories flood back.

AN YIRUO (V.O.)
Seven days and nights. Every brushstroke, a piece of my soul. She took it while I blinked.

FLASHBACK:

EXT. STREET - DAY

AN YIRUO, wearing period costume, runs through the rain and gets into a taxi.

A large truck collides with the taxi.

AN YIRUO, blood covering her face, loses consciousness inside the car.

AN YIRUO (V.O.)
The rain was so loud. I never got to say goodbye.
continuation:
INT. AWARD CEREMONY - DAY

SU WANXIAO, a young woman with exquisite makeup, smiles on stage holding up a first-place certificate and trophy. The audience applauds below.

AN YIRUO (V.O.)
While she held my trophy, they applauded my downfall.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. AWARD CEREMONY - DAY

The HOST stands next to SU WANXIAO, holding a microphone to interview her.

HOST
Miss Su, as Master An's final disciple, you've won the championship at such a young age. Truly remarkable. By the way, why didn't your senior sister An Yiruo come to compete?

SU WANXIAO
(smiling)
My senior sister... the genius painter...

SU WANXIAO suddenly leans closer to the microphone, her expression becoming subtle.

SU WANXIAO
(in a whisper)
I hope she finds her own inspiration someday.

In the audience seats below, a MAN and WOMAN are discussing.

MALE AUDIENCE MEMBER
That's the third time she's hinted at it. Poor Master An's daughter...

FEMALE AUDIENCE MEMBER
Where there's smoke...

EXT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

AN YIRUO stands before the easel, her expression filled with pain and unwillingness.

AN YIRUO (V.O.)
The contempt, the disdain... that honor was mine to claim.

AN YIRUO turns around, her eyes becoming determined.

AN YIRUO (V.O.)
This time, I'll paint a truth she can't steal.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

AN YIRUO is painting in front of an easel in her studio. Her phone rings, the caller ID shows "AN HONGSHAN."

She picks up the phone to answer.

AN HONGSHAN (V.O.)
Your mother understands if you withdraw. She's making your favorite soup.

A beat.

AN HONGSHAN (V.O.)
(coldly)
Xiaoxiao's work is already in the gallery. Don't make this harder than it needs to be.

AN YIRUO listens to the phone, her expression firm, her eyes revealing confidence. She ends the call, picks up her brush.
