title: Heaven's Favored Son
description: A young celestial being, favored by the Heavenly Dao itself, accidentally falls to the mortal realm and awakens in a bathhouse to find his mortal family in turmoil.
context:
Title: Heaven's Favored Son
Description: A young celestial being, favored by the Heavenly Dao itself, accidentally falls to the mortal realm and awakens in a bathhouse to find his mortal family in turmoil.

EXT. CELESTIAL REALM - DAY

A vast sea of clouds roils beneath towering jade pillars. Golden light fractures through mist.

LI WANWAN (8), a small boy in flowing celestial robes, balances atop a pillar's tip, eyes closed, a simple wooden fan resting on his knees. Around him, the air shimmers with suppressed power.

Four divine figures materialize from golden light: TAISHANG LAOJUN with his longevity staff, ERLANG ZHENJUN with his third eye gleaming, DAOXING TIANZUN bearing a jade tablet, and WENQU XINGJUN holding a calligraphy brush.

LI WANWAN's eyes snap open. He doesn't turn.

LI WANWAN
You're late.

The four deities flinch collectively. DAOXING TIANZUN's jade tablet cracks in his grip.

DAOXING TIANZUN
Forgive us, Little Master. The Eastern Star needed realigning—

LI WANWAN
(fanning himself lazily)
I said I'd practice my new technique on you today.

He flicks the fan. A single, delicate petal of golden flame drifts toward them.

The four deities VANISH in a panic, reappearing a hundred yards away—except WENQU XINGJUN, whose beard singes.

WENQU XINGJUN
(inspecting his beard)
Seventeen millennia of cultivation... singed by a child with a fan.

LI WANWAN pouts. He hops down, misjudges the distance—

LI WANWAN
Ouch!

—and vanishes into the clouds. His fan spirals upward. A final golden spark flickers, then dies.

INT. MORTAL BATHHOUSE - DAY

Steam hangs thick. Tiled walls drip with condensation.

LI WANWAN lies on a massage bed, now in a faded sweater and patched jeans. He jolts awake, clutching his head. A wooden fan—identical to the celestial one—sits clutched in his hand.

MAN A (O.S.)
Old Liu's luck turned yesterday. Won three months' wages at cards.

MAN B (O.S.)
Take me next time. My daughter needs school fees.

LI WANWAN stares at the fan. It feels wrong—heavy, powerless. He touches his chest, feeling a strange hollowness.

LI WANWAN
(whispering)
Where... am I?

A FEMALE ATTENDANT ushers out two customers, her smile tired but warm.

FEMALE ATTENDANT
Come again. We'll have hot water waiting.

ZHOU XIUFANG (30s), calloused hands and quiet eyes, approaches with a steaming towel. She freezes seeing LI WANWAN awake.

ZHOU XIUFANG
Wanwan?

She kneels beside him, pressing the warm towel to his forehead. Her fingers tremble slightly.

ZHOU XIUFANG
(softly)
You fell asleep in the changing room again. Here—

She produces a bamboo basket covered with a red cloth. Inside, three eggs nestle like treasures.
continuation:
ZHOU XIUFANG
Your teacher said you fainted at school. I saved these from our hens. Eat one. Please.

LI WANWAN looks at her. A memory surfaces: this same face, younger, offering him a candied hawthorn in winter. The memory feels like his own and borrowed at once.

LI WANWAN (V.O.)
Mother.

ZHOU XIUFANG's smile fades as laughter erupts at the entrance. LI ZHENDONG (40s), glasses crooked and tie loosened, stumbles in with ZHAO MENGJIE (20s), her designer bag clashing with the humble setting.

LI ZHENDONG
(shouting)
Boss! Couple's room. Now!

ZHAO MENGJIE
(adjusting his tie)
We don't need service, darling. Just privacy.

ZHOU XIUFANG stands, smoothing her apron. Her back straightens with quiet dignity.

ZHOU XIUFANG
I'm the attendant today. Private room's twenty yuan.

She meets LI ZHENDONG's eyes. Recognition hits him like a slap.

LI ZHENDONG
...Xiufang? What're you— You work here?

He looks from her to LI WANWAN. Comprehension dawns, then twists into something ugly.

LI ZHENDONG
(low, dangerous)
You're hiding my son in this... place? While I'm paying your rent?

LI WANWAN stands, the wooden fan gripped tight. Another memory: this man, younger, taking the hawthorn, laughing. Not cruel—just careless.

LI WANWAN (V.O.)
Father.

LI ZHENDONG
(pointing at LI WANWAN)
He's mine. I'm taking him.

ZHOU XIUFANG
(surprisingly firm)
 courts gave him to me. You signed the papers.

LI ZHENDONG laughs, a broken sound.

LI ZHENDONG
Courts? I owe more than I own. Mengjie's family needs an heir. A clean one.

He grabs LI WANWAN's wrist. The boy's eyes flash—not with celestial power, but with mortal fury.

LI WANWAN
Let go.

Something in his voice makes LI ZHENDONG pause. The lights flicker. The steam swirls.

LI WANWAN steps between his parents, facing his father. He looks small, but his shadow stretches wrong—tall, winged, impossibly large.

LI ZHENDONG stares at the shadow, then at his son's eyes. He sees something ancient and terrible looking back.

LI ZHENDONG
(releasing him, voice shaking)
What... what are you?

LI WANWAN's shadow snaps back to normal. He smiles, a child's smile with edges like broken glass.

LI WANWAN
I'm your son.

He touches the wooden fan to his father's chest. LI ZHENDONG stumbles back as if pushed by a hurricane.

ZHOU XIUFANG watches, not with fear, but with something like recognition.

FADE OUT.

title: The Prince's Manor
description: Over two thousand years ago, a loyal general pledges eternal devotion to a woman destined to become Crown Princess, but betrayal and tragedy await them both.
context:
Title: The Prince's Manor
Description: Over two thousand years ago, a loyal general pledges eternal devotion to a woman destined to become Crown Princess, but betrayal and tragedy await them both.

TITLE CARD: THE PRINCE'S MANOR - OVER 2000 YEARS AGO

EXT. PRINCE'S MANOR CORRIDOR - TWILIGHT

SHENG WEIRAN and SHEN MUBAI stand at the corridor's edge, their armor catching the last light. The weight of unspoken history hangs between them.

SHENG WEIRAN
The Emperor's edict arrives tomorrow. I'll be named Crown Princess. After fifteen years of fighting beside you... is this truly all you have to say?

SHEN MUBAI
(struggling to keep his voice steady)
My duty doesn't change with titles. I will protect the Crown Princess with my life. As I have always done.

SHENG WEIRAN
(quietly fierce)
I didn't ask about your duty. I asked about you.

SHEN MUBAI meets her eyes for a heartbeat, then deliberately breaks contact. He kneels, drawing his sword in a fluid motion—the blade flashes between them.

SHEN MUBAI
(formal, hollow)
The Crown Princess must not disobey the Emperor. Your honor is the empire's honor. But if you ever turn back... I will be behind you.

SHENG WEIRAN watches him kneel, understanding the gulf his words create. She turns away before he can see her face crumble.

SHENG WEIRAN
(softly, to herself)
I understand.

INT. SHENG WEIRAN'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

SHENG WEIRAN sleeps fitfully. The door lock—visible in the foreground—has been cleanly broken.

A strange man, LOVER, materializes from the shadows. His fingers, cold as iron, trace her cheek. He takes her hand, pressing something into her palm.

SHENG WEIRAN
(mumbling in her sleep)
Mubai...

She jerks awake. The LOVER smiles—a predator's expression.

SHENG WEIRAN
(terror mixing with confusion)
The guards—how did you—

LOVER
(lifting her hand to show a jade token pressed against her skin)
The Crown Prince sends his regards, my beloved consort.

The door explodes inward. The CROWN PRINCE enters, flanked by soldiers holding torches. His eyes fix on the token in her hand.

CROWN PRINCE
(oiling rage with triumph)
Sheng Weiran.

SHENG WEIRAN scrambles backward, the token slipping from her fingers. It clatters to the floor—identical to the one the Prince wears.

CROWN PRINCE
I offered you legitimacy. My father's favor. And you repay me with this?

SHENG WEIRAN
(desperate, seeing the trap)
Your Highness, I was drugged! The wine—

FLASHBACK:
continuation:
INT. VICTORY BANQUET HALL - PREVIOUS NIGHT

The CROWN PRINCE personally pours wine for SHENG WEIRAN, his thumb pressing a white powder against the cup's rim.

CROWN PRINCE
(charming)
To the hero of Great Jin.

She drinks. He watches.

END FLASHBACK.

SHENG WEIRAN
(whisper)
The rebellion is over. My family's army is the threat now.

CROWN PRINCE
(coldly pleased)
The Sheng name is too powerful. But an adulterous Crown Princess? Her name will be erased. Guards—execute her.

Soldiers advance. SHEN MUBAI crashes through the window, glass shattering. He moves like a storm, his sword taking two soldiers in the opening heartbeat. But more pour through the door.

A blade finds his back. He staggers.

SHENG WEIRAN
(scream)
Mubai!

SHEN MUBAI drops to his knees before her, blood seeping through his armor. She catches him, her hands coming away red.

SHEN MUBAI
(barely audible)
I broke my vow. I turned back.

Their eyes meet. For the first time, no duty stands between them.

CROWN PRINCE
(raising his sword)
How touching. Let history remember you together.

He drives his blade through SHEN MUBAI's chest. The sword's tip emerges through SHENG WEIRAN's back. Their blood mingles on the floor.

SHENG WEIRAN's hand finds SHEN MUBAI's as the light leaves her eyes.

TRANSITION TO MODERN DAY

Time-space bleeds through blood—ancient red fades to neon.

INT. WALK-IN CLOSET - DAY

SHENG WEIRAN in modern dress is pinned against the wall by SHEN MUBAI in modern dress, his hand around her throat.

SHENG WEIRAN
(struggling)
Mubai...

title: The Lady's Rebellious Nature
description: A modern woman finds herself transported into an ancient world after reading a mysterious novel, where she must navigate danger and romance with seven attendants.
context:
Title: The Lady's Rebellious Nature
Description: A modern woman finds herself transported into an ancient world after reading a mysterious novel, where she must navigate danger and romance with seven attendants.

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

Black screen. White Song typeface text: Episode One

A woman in ancient costume (THE LADY) lies unconscious on fallen leaves.

A BLACK-CLAD MASKED MAN crouches down and reaches out to check THE LADY's breath.

MASKED MAN (V.O.)
No breath. The poison worked.

The MASKED MAN begins searching THE LADY's body.

MASKED MAN (V.O.)
The Linglong Mirror must be on her.

Suddenly, THE LADY opens her eyes and sits up abruptly. She grabs his wrist. The MASKED MAN stumbles back in shock.

THE LADY (V.O.)
The last thing I remember—a truck's headlights. Then darkness. This isn't a hospital.

MONTAGE:

INT. CAR - NIGHT

A woman in modern clothes sits in the driver's seat, eyes vacant. A book lies open on the passenger seat, pages glowing.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Yuewen Platinum author Nangong Qiuyue's new work "The Lady's Rebellious Nature" is now available.
continuation:
INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

A man types on a laptop, screen showing the same book.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
They say the final chapter binds your fate. They say you wake as the Lady herself.

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

THE LADY runs through the forest in panic.

THE LADY
(screaming)
No—this isn't real!

END MONTAGE.

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

THE LADY and the MASKED MAN face off.

MASKED MAN
Where is the Linglong Mirror?

THE LADY
I don't know what you're—

MASKED MAN
Then I'll take it from your corpse.

The MASKED MAN grabs her wrist. She twists free and kicks at him.

THE LADY
I'm not your damsel!

The MASKED MAN catches her ankle, sending her sprawling. He draws his sword.

MASKED MAN
You're whatever I say you are.

He swings. A CRIMSON FAN snaps open, catching the blade. The ATTENDANT appears.

MASKED MAN
The Qiushui fan!

ATTENDANT
I'm taking the Lady home.

The ATTENDANT and MASKED MAN engage in fierce combat. Blades flash, the fan whirls.

After an intense fight, the ATTENDANT drives off the MASKED MAN.

The ATTENDANT runs to THE LADY, who clutches her arm.

ATTENDANT
My lady! Your arm—

THE LADY
Who are you?

ATTENDANT
Your seventh attendant. San.

THE LADY
I don't need saving.

SAN
smiles faintly.

SAN
You need a guide.

The ATTENDANT holds the LADY, his expression full of concern.

FADE OUT.

title: I Am the Female Lead
description: A wife confronts an actress she believes is having an affair with her husband on a film set.
context:
Title: I Am the Female Lead
Description: A wife confronts an actress she believes is having an affair with her husband on a film set.

INT. DRESSING ROOM - DAY

GUO ZILU bursts through the door, her trembling hand gripping YAO JIALING's shoulder. YAO's makeup brush clatters into the mirror.

GUO ZILU
(low, trembling)
You look smaller in person, Yao Jialing.

YAO JIALING
(jerking away)
Do I know you? Who let you—

GUO ZILU
(her voice cracks)
Three months of deleted texts. Four hotel charges. One bracelet I never received.

YAO JIALING
(thin smile)
Ah. The wife. How... method of you.

GUO ZILU
Security! Get this—

YAO JIALING
(overlapping, louder)
Security! Remove her!

ASSISTANT (O.S.)
(urgent whisper into phone)
Mrs. Tie found out. Yes, THAT Mrs. Tie.

GUO ZILU
You wanted his money? Fine. But you posted that bracelet on Weibo. Tagging our anniversary date.

YAO JIALING
I post a lot of things. So does your husband. Like that "business trip" to Sanya—
continuation:
TIE GUO charges in, blocking the doorway from gathering crew.

TIE GUO
(to hallway)
Show's over! Back to work!

GUO ZILU
(to YAO)
You think this is a show? These people should know what their "female lead" does after wrap.

TIE GUO
(pleading under his breath)
Zilu, not here. The project's fifty million in—

YAO JIALING
(smoothing her costume)
Sixty. And I earned every frame.

ASSISTANT (O.S.)
(overheard, snapping fingers)
That's why she got Li Lin to post that denial. Damage control.

YAO JIALING
(spins toward door)
My sister already clarified those screenshots. Find better gossip.

GUO ZILU
Your sister defended you. Your "boyfriend" denied you. Your investor's wife is standing right here. Who's the lead in your life story, Jialing?

TIE GUO
(to GUO ZILU, desperate)
She's just talent. A contract. You think I'd risk us for... for craft services and a call sheet?

YAO JIALING
(trembling, but projects to the room)
I survived three years of auditions and your husband's "meetings." I AM the female lead. And you?

She slams the dressing table. The mirror cracks between their reflections.

title: Beloved Wife in Arms: The 80s Factory Director's Endless Love
description: A young woman marries a man she barely knows to fulfill her grandmother's dying wish. On their wedding night, he is called away for work, and they don't see each other again for five years.
context:
Title: Beloved Wife in Arms: The 80s Factory Director's Endless Love
Description: A young woman marries a man she barely knows to fulfill her grandmother's dying wish. On their wedding night, he is called away for work, and they don't see each other again for five years.

EXT. COUNTY CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU - DAY

MOTHER ZHOU paces anxiously at the entrance of the Civil Affairs Bureau, clutching a cloth-wrapped bundle.

ZHOU YUCHEN rides up on a bicycle patched with tape, carrying ZHANG XIUYING. Both have dust streaked across their faces, sleeves rolled to the elbow.

ZHOU YUCHEN
Mom. The shuttle bus from the commune broke down.

MOTHER ZHOU
(angrily)
You're getting your marriage certificate and you look like you've been dragged through a rice paddy! This is your first time laying eyes on each other.

ZHANG XIUYING
(meeting Zhou Yuchen's gaze)
At least we know neither of us shirks hard work.

A shared, tentative smile passes between them.

MOTHER ZHOU
Wipe your faces. Registrar Lao Wang is waiting.

She hands them a damp towel. Zhou Yuchen passes it to Zhang Xiuying first.

INT. MARRIAGE REGISTRATION OFFICE - DAY

ZHOU YUCHEN and ZHANG XIUYING sit before the REGISTRAR, still faintly smudged. The Registrar adjusts his glasses.

REGISTRAR
Occupations?

ZHOU YUCHEN
Hydraulic engineer. Third Machine Tool Factory.

ZHANG XIUYING
Embroidery mechanic. Fifteenth Production Brigade.

The Registrar stamps two certificates with a loud CLACK and slides them forward. They reach for them simultaneously, hands brushing.
continuation:
INT. BRIDAL CHAMBER - NIGHT

Wedding night. ZHANG XIUYING sits on the kang in a simple red jacket, fingers tracing the wood grain of the kang table. ZHOU YUCHEN sets down a kerosene lamp.

He opens a wooden box containing a slender gold bracelet, its clasp shaped like a tiny gear.

ZHOU YUCHEN
My grandmother wore this while operating the textile machines. She said it brought her luck during the toughest years.

He fastens it around her wrist. The lamp light catches the gold.

ZHANG XIUYING
Then I'll wear it while I work.

ZHOU YUCHEN
When the factory bonus comes through this winter, we'll have a proper ceremony.

For the first time, he lifts her face to the light, studying it carefully.

INT. BRIDAL CHAMBER - MORNING

ZHOU YUCHEN, fully dressed, watches Zhang Xiuying sleep. He touches a Polaroid photo on the nightstand—her Mao badge ID photo, obtained through his mother.

Urgent knocking. He opens the door to COLLEAGUE LI, breathless.

COLLEAGUE LI
(nervously)
Zhou! The Guangzhou foundry's new hydraulic press failed. Four workers injured. They need our specs and you on site immediately. Train leaves in forty minutes.

He thrusts a hard-won ticket into Zhou Yuchen's hand. Zhou Yuchen glances back at the bedroom, then grabs a scrap of paper and a pencil stub.

INT. XIXIAN EMBROIDERY FACTORY - DAY

ON SCREEN: Five years later

FEMALE WORKERS crowd the hall, gossiping. ZHANG XIUYING crouches by a broken treadle machine, adjusting the shuttle with a screwdriver. A SMALL GIRL with her hair in tufted braids clutches her leg.

FEMALE WORKER A
They say the new director demanded our best mechanic be present for inspection. That's why we're all lined up like ducks.

FEMALE WORKER B
If he's single, I'll volunteer to oil his bicycle chain every morning!

The workers giggle. Zhang Xiuying stands, wiping her hands on her work apron.

ZHANG XIUYING (V.O.)
Four letters sent, none returned. The factory moved last year. Maybe he can't find us.

A black sedan stops. ZHOU YUCHEN steps out, older, leaner, carrying a leather portfolio. He moves through the bowing workers, eyes scanning the machinery, not the people—until he sees Zhang Xiuying's hands. The screwdriver. The gear-shaped bracelet.

He stops mid-step. She looks up.

ZHOU YUCHEN
(quietly)
You're supposed to be at the Fifteenth Brigade.

ZHANG XIUYING
We transferred when the factory opened. I... kept the bracelet oiled.

The little girl peers out from behind her. Zhou Yuchen's knuckles go white on his portfolio.

Description: A young village girl's university acceptance letter is burned by her family, who plan to marry her off to pay for her sister's education.

EXT. VILLAGE PATH - DAY

Golden afternoon light. SONG AIWEI (18), a determined girl in patched floral clothing, balances a bamboo basket of firewood on her back while clutching a worn math textbook.

She reaches a stone bridge where AUNT WANG and AUNT LIU rest with their hoes.

AUNT WANG
(noticing the book)
Aiwei! The postmaster just came through—university letters arrived. You still waiting on Jiangcheng?

SONG AIWEI
(eyes lighting up)
I am. Thought I'd finish gathering wood first.

AUNT LIU
Go, child. Education won't wait for firewood.

SONG AIWEI
(grateful smile)
Thank you. I'll go now.

She sets down the basket and hurries off, book still in hand.

SONG AIWEI (V.O.)
Two years of studying by lantern light. It has to be enough.

EXT. FARMHOUSE COURTYARD - DAY

MOTHER (40s, tired eyes) stands guard near the door while FATHER (50s, calloused hands) crouches behind the water barrel, feeding papers to a small cookfire.

MOTHER
(low voice)
The postmaster said afternoon. She could be—

FATHER
(quiet, grim)
We finish this now.

SONG AIWEI rounds the corner, breathless.

SONG AIWEI
Did anything come from—

She freezes. Sees the corner of a familiar red-and-white envelope turning to ash.

SONG AIWEI
(voice cracking)
No...

She lunges, grabbing the scorched remnant. The university seal half-visible.

SONG AIWEI
(whisper)
Why?

MOTHER
(stepping forward)
Your sister got her acceptance yesterday. City university. Expensive.

FATHER
(staring at the fire)
Two college girls? We can't.
continuation:
SONG AIWEI
(desperate)
I'll work. Loans. Anything—

MOTHER
(hard voice)
Don't be foolish. Wang Mazi offered sixty thousand. For Yuqing's tuition. Your sister's future.

SONG AIWEI
And mine?

YUQING (17, nervous energy) appears in the doorway, avoiding eye contact. YUHANG (16, sullen) loiters behind her, rope coiled at his waist.

SONG YUHANG
You're the oldest. It's your duty.

SONG AIWEI
(to Yuqing)
You knew?

Song Yuqing flinches but says nothing.

WANG MAZI (40s, limping) enters the courtyard, grin revealing missing teeth.

WANG MAZI
Your parents speak true, girl. You'll be well cared for.

SONG AIWEI
(backing against the wall)
I'd rather die.

MOTHER
Don't be dramatic. You'll thank us—

SONG AIWEI
I won't go!

She makes a break for the gate. Yuhang blocks her. Father grabs her arm.

SONG YUHANG
(getting rope)
Hold her still!

She kicks, struggles. Yuqing watches, trembling.

SONG AIWEI
(to Yuqing)
Help me! Please!

Song Yuqing reaches into her pocket—for tape or something else? Her hand shakes.

Suddenly, Yuqing lunges—not at Aiwei, but at Wang Mazi, shoving him off-balance.

SONG YUQING
(terrified, to Aiwei)
RUN!

Aiwei hesitates only a moment, then bolts past her stunned brother.

Mother screams. Father curses. But Aiwei is already through the gate, the scorched admission letter clutched to her chest.

The half-burned paper flutters from her hand as she flees—she doesn't stop to retrieve it.

FADE OUT.

title: Awakening

context:
Title: Awakening
Description: A talented embroidery master breaks free from decades of family constraints to reclaim her life after winning an international competition.

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY VENUE - DAY

Background sound: Stirring music and car engine sounds.

LI XIUFEN, dressed in elegant traditional Chinese clothing, walks on the red carpet holding a crystal trophy, her expression serious. Subtitle introduces: Genius Suzhou Embroidery Master LI XIUFEN.

HOST (V.O.)
Please welcome the champion of this year's International Embroidery Competition, the inheritor of Suzhou embroidery intangible cultural heritage, Ms. Li Xiufen!

LI XIUFEN stands on stage, smiling, accepting photos from the media.

LI XIUFEN (V.O.)
For five decades, I disappeared into obligation.

FLASHBACK MONTAGE

- INT. OLD-STYLE KITCHEN - DAY
  Young LI XIUFEN, dressed plainly in an apron, wearily washes dishes. Embroidery needles are tucked in her hair, hidden.

- INT. OLD-STYLE LIVING ROOM - DAY
  LI XIUFEN busies herself in the living room, wiping tables, tidying clutter. Her hands move with practiced artistry even in this menial work.

LI XIUFEN (V.O.)
I perfected every role except my own.

END MONTAGE

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY VENUE - DAY

LI XIUFEN holds the trophy, her eyes determined.

LI XIUFEN (V.O.)
Today, I stitch my own story.
continuation:
EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

LI XIUFEN walks out the main door. Several BODYGUARDS in black stand respectfully beside a Rolls-Royce—part of the competition's winner's package.

LIU BAOGUO, wearing a security uniform, rushes over and pushes past the bodyguards.

LIU BAOGUO
Xiufen!

LIU QICHENG, Li Xiufen's son, follows closely behind, looking at his mother with desperate frustration.

LIU QICHENG
Mom, the neighbors' committee called three times. My boss saw your interview. Please—just come home and we can talk.

LI XIUFEN
(coldly)
You filed for divorce. You changed the locks. You chose this stage.

LIU BAOGUO
(furiously)
You think this trophy pays bills? You're sixty-two! You can't just—

LIU QICHENG
Mom, your pension is still in our joint account. Don't be reckless.

LIU BAOGUO
You think you're something special? Fine! Let's see you survive without family!

LI XIUFEN turns and walks toward the Rolls-Royce, ignoring them. The BODYGUARDS step forward—professional, not menacing.

BODYGUARD
Sir, this is private transport arranged by the competition. Please step back.

LIU BAOGUO
(struggling)
Forty years! You owe us—

LI XIUFEN gets into the car.

LIU BAOGUO
(shouting)
You're not coming back? Fine! Don't ever come back!

The car door closes, and the car slowly drives away.

LI XIUFEN
(through the car window, speaking softly)
I stopped owing when I started winning.

LIU BAOGUO and LIU QICHENG stand dumbfounded, watching the luxury car drive away.

FLASHBACK

ON SCREEN: TEN YEARS AGO

INT. OLD APARTMENT HALLWAY - DAY

Young LI XIUFEN carries large and small bags, walking with difficulty. A small embroidered bird peeks from one bag—her secret commission.

INT. OLD-STYLE LIVING ROOM - DAY

LI XIUFEN brings the prepared dishes to the table. Young LIU BAOGUO sits at the table, devouring his food while reading the newspaper, his mouth full of grease.

LI XIUFEN changes into a brand new red velvet cheongsam and walks somewhat shyly to LIU BAOGUO.

LI XIUFEN
Baoguo, can I wear this to the birthday banquet tomorrow? I embroidered it myself.

LIU BAOGUO looks up, glaring at her with disgust, and violently slams his glass on the table.

LIU BAOGUO
(roaring)
I told you! No wasting time on vanity! You belong in this kitchen!

LI XIUFEN's smile freezes on her face, her eyes instantly dimming. Her fingers brush the hidden phoenix she embroidered inside the hem—her secret signature.

Title: The Smart Doorbell Mystery
Description: A husband sees a disturbing video on his smart doorbell showing a woman who looks like his wife with another man, leading to suspicion and confrontation on their important anniversary night.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

HUSBAND bursts through the front door in a panic, phone clutched tight. He scans the room, pulse hammering. Rushing to the bedroom, then bathroom, he finally stops at the closed door.

WIFE walks out wearing a red nightgown.

WIFE
You're home. Finally. Why are you searching the house like a madman?

LELE runs out from the room.

LELE
Mommy?

WIFE hugs LELE.

WIFE
Lele, go back to bed. I told you no more phone tonight.

HUSBAND
Listen to your mother.

After WIFE takes LELE back to the room, she comes out to face HUSBAND.

HUSBAND
(seriously)
Doorbell footage. 8:47 PM. You in the hallway. With him.

WIFE
That's impossible. I've been inside all night. The camera faces out, not in.

HUSBAND's expression becomes grave. He suddenly turns and rushes toward the door. WIFE follows him.
continuation:
INT. APARTMENT ENTRANCE - NIGHT

HUSBAND and WIFE stand in front of the smart doorbell at the entrance. The doorbell screen displays footage of a woman in a red nightgown embracing a man - the hallway identical to theirs. A butterfly tattoo marks her waist.

WIFE
Look at the details. That's not our wallpaper. And the tattoo—do you think I'd hide that from you?

NEWS BROADCAST (V.O.)
Citywide wireless interference reported due to atmospheric conditions. Smart devices receiving crossed signals from nearby units.

HUSBAND takes the doorbell off the wall.

HUSBAND
The apartment across the hall. Same layout. Our signals crossed.

FLASHBACK: HUSBAND returns home carrying a cake and gifts.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

HUSBAND and WIFE are in the living room. HUSBAND holds WIFE's hand and apologizes.

HUSBAND
I should have known better. I've been on edge lately.

HUSBAND
Why the nightgown? Were you expecting someone?

WIFE
I was expecting my husband. On our anniversary. Before midnight.

HUSBAND
I told you not to wait. The project—

WIFE
How could I not wait? It's our anniversary.

WIFE
I'm going to shower. Try not to destroy any more electronics.

WIFE turns around. HUSBAND sees kiss marks on her neck and his expression changes.

HUSBAND
(shocked)
Your neck. What are those marks?

Title: All In: The Woman Who Disappeared (Episode 72)
Description: A man discovers a horrifying truth about his lover's heart transplant and its connection to his missing girlfriend.

INT. HOT SPRING/BOTANICAL GARDEN - DAY

Steam drifts through dense foliage. DU SHA, in a white chiffon dress, walks toward the hot spring pool, fingers absently tracing the scar hidden beneath her collarbone.

CUT TO:

A DONG, wearing a black leather jacket, moves through the garden. He glances at a worn photograph—XIAO YU—then continues forward with hollow eyes.

Du Sha sinks into the steaming water, letting out a quiet breath of relief.

A Dong stops, peering through the leaves. His gaze fixes on Du Sha's left shoulder: a crescent birthmark above her surgical scar.

A MYSTERIOUS WOMAN in a leather jacket appears.

MYSTERIOUS WOMAN
Six months. You still carry her picture?

A DONG
The clinic in Macau. What did you find?

MYSTERIOUS WOMAN
Dr. Chen's last patient. Emergency transplant. No donor on record.

MYSTERIOUS WOMAN
(leaning in, quiet)
The heart arrived the day Xiao Yu disappeared.

A DONG
(turning on her)
Why didn't you tell me?

MYSTERIOUS WOMAN
Would you have believed me?

Du Sha's voice echoes across the pool.

DU SHA
A Dong? I can feel you out there.

A DONG
(calling)
Wait for me.
continuation:
MYSTERIOUS WOMAN
(grabbing his arm)
She doesn't know. The heart will reject—

A DONG
(shoves her off)
It's already rejecting.

A Dong staggers toward the pool, clutching his chest.

A DONG (V.O.)
Xiao Yu...

DU SHA (V.O.)
(whispered)
...don't leave me.

A Dong's head jerks up. Du Sha stands in the shallow water, hand pressed to her chest, Xiao Yu's eyes staring back.

DU SHA
A Dong, my heart hurts. Does yours?

A Dong stares at the scar. His face empties.

FLASHBACK: XIAO YU on an operating table, screaming through a gag: "Let me go!"

FLASHBACK: A DOCTOR's hands hold a bloody heart.

A DONG
(voice breaking)
That heart... it's beating her fear.

DU SHA
(surprised)
What?

A DONG
(coldly)
You're lying. Your heart is as cold and hard as stone. How could it feel pain? No, you don't have a heart at all. You're the one who killed Xiao Yu.

A DONG's eyes turn vicious.

A DONG
(through gritted teeth)
I'm going to kill you.

Title: Six-and-a-Half-Year-Old Twin Treasures at Home
Description: A young woman agrees to bear a child for a wealthy man in exchange for money to save her mother, but her life takes a tragic turn when her family betrays her.

INT. LUXURIOUS BEDROOM - NIGHT

FANG SITONG adjusts a black dress before a mirror. Her hand trembles applying lipstick. A wine glass sits untouched.

QIN YI in an open white shirt, watches from the bed.

QIN YI
Five million. One child.

FANG SITONG
(quietly)
After?

QIN YI
Clean break. That's the contract.

She touches the glass, seeing her mother's reflection there.

FANG SITONG
(after a beat)
She needs surgery by Friday.

QIN YI
Then we begin tonight.

He approaches. Their eyes meet in the mirror.

TITLE CARD: EIGHT MONTHS LATER

INT. BURNING ROOM - NIGHT

Smoke fills a locked bedroom. FANG SITONG, now heavily pregnant, pounds the door.

FANG SITONG
(coughing)
It's jammed!

Through the keyhole: STEPMOTHER and FANG YINGYING watch smoke seep under the door.

STEPMOTHER
(to Fang Yingying)
Shares transfer when she's declared dead. Your father made certain.

FANG SITONG freezes. Presses her ear to the wood.

FANG YINGYING
She never wondered why Dad favored his "stepdaughter"?

FANG SITONG
(whispered)
No...

She clutches her stomach. A contraction ripples across it.

FANG SITONG
(to herself)
Mom's waiting. Not like this.

She grabs a candlestick, hurls it at the window. Glass shatters.
continuation:
AUNT SONG appears below with a ladder.

AUNT SONG
Miss! Climb!

FANG SITONG struggles through the frame as flames erupt behind her.

AUNT SONG
Hurry!

She descends rung by rung. Reaches the ground.

AUNT SONG rushes toward the house.

FANG SITONG
Aunt Song, no!

AUNT SONG
The contract! In your bag!

She disappears inside. A moment later, the roof collapses.

FANG SITONG
(collapsing)
No!

She doubles over, gripping her belly.

FANG SITONG
(strangled)
The twins...

INT. QIN YI'S MANSION - DAY

QIN YI reads when the BUTLER rushes in with two infant carriers.

BUTLER
Master! Twins. Left at the gate. And a note—

The butler hands him a blood-stained scrap.

A blood-stained scrap reads: "Our agreement fulfilled. -F"

QIN YI stares at the babies. At the medical band: "Baby A: 3.2 lbs."

QIN YI
(quietly)
She survived.

He looks closer at the second band, smudged incomplete.

QIN YI
Find her.

EXT. MODERN OFFICE BUILDING - DAY

Six and a half years later. FANG SITONG, hardened and sharp, walks with a little girl toward the entrance.

The girl clutches a magazine photo of QIN YI.

They are stopped by QIN YI and his bodyguards.

FADE OUT.

Title: Sorry, I'm Not Your White Moonlight
Description: An interior designer unexpectedly reunites with a CEO from a fateful night four years ago when she arrives late to present her design proposal.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

CLOSE UP on a man's black dress shoes pacing, then a woman's pointed heels step into frame.

A woman (NING XI) looks up at a man (ZHAN LIHAN).

CLOSE UP on the woman's hands on the man's bare chest.

The couple lies in bed, embracing.

INT. NING XI'S BEDROOM - DAY

An alarm rings on a smartphone showing 08:00.

NING XI, an interior designer, wakes with a start, hand pressed to her chest.

NING XI (V.O.)
Four years, and that night still follows me.

The bedroom door creaks open. A little girl, NING ANXING, peeks in.

NING ANXING
Mommy, you'll be late.

Ning Xi bolts up, rushes to her daughter.

NING XI
Xingxing.

She kneels, smoothing her daughter's hair.

NING XI
Big meeting today. Grandma's picking you up, okay?

Ning Xi kisses her daughter's cheek.

NING XI
Land this contract, and that princess dress is yours.

NING ANXING
Good luck, Mommy!

continuation:

Establishing shot of a modern glass skyscraper.

ZHAN LIHAN
This is your standard?

ANNA
Mr. Zhan, our senior designer is en route—

(under her breath)
Ning Xi...

(relieved)
Finally.

ANNA
(to Zhan Lihan)

ANNA
(to Ning Xi)
Show him your design.

That scent...

May 20th. Four years ago. Where were you?

Description: A writer who sympathizes with a doomed sect in her novel is transported into the story, becoming a minor character destined to be expelled. She tries to get kicked out, but things don't go as planned.

Corpses litter scorched earth. Blood pools in the dirt. A man lies still, blood masking his features.

CHU FENG (Taiyi Sect Saintess)
If the Demon Cult is not eliminated, the righteous path cannot be upheld!

YING WUJI (Wuqing Sect Senior Brother)
Today, I shall grant your wish!

YING WUJI channels energy—blue lightning crackles across his body. CHU FENG lunges, blade glinting. Their clash erupts in a shower of sparks and light. SU YAO presses against a boulder, watching through trembling fingers.

SU YAO hunches before her computer, fingers frozen above the keyboard. The screen glows with final paragraphs.

SU YAO (V.O.)
They bleed for honor. Wuqing bleeds because I wrote it. Cannon fodder for someone else's story.

Her jaw tightens. She types one last sentence. The monitor blazes—white light floods the room, swallows her. The chair spins, empty.

INT. WUQING SECT GREAT HALL - DAY

The hall looms—mahogany pillars, incense smoke curling toward rafters. Disciples whisper as they enter. A flash of light. SU YAO materializes center floor, ancient robes over modern clothes, pink keyboard clutched to her chest.

SU YAO
(to herself)
Alive. Not home.

She sees a white-haired, one-eyed man—HONG XIVIANG—seated on the high throne. YING WUJI and YU WEI stand at the base.

HONG XIVIANG (Wuqing Sect Master)
Confess. Who killed your fellow disciple?

YING WUJI
(urgently)
Junior Sister, explain!

SU YAO (internal)
Cannon fodder junior sister. Perfect.
continuation:
HONG XIVIANG
Confess now, and I will merely expel you.

YU WEI
Master, I witnessed it. Junior Sister struck the blow.

A vision flashes: YU WEI's triumphant smirk, the words "Divine assist from the enemy camp" glowing beside her.

SU YAO
(loudly)
Yes! I confess—I killed him! Unforgivable! Expel me as example!

YING WUJI
(shocked)
Your skill couldn't—

(cutting him off)
I cheated! Hidden weapons! Sneak attack!

HONG XIVIANG
(slamming the armrest—stone cracks)

YING WUJI
(blocking)
No, Master!

HONG XIVIANG's expression shifts. He smiles—a slow, approving curve.

HONG XIVIANG
Little Yao... you understand at last.

SU YAO
(blank confusion)
Huh?

context:
Title: Master Chuan's Sweet Wife with Good Fortune
Description: A young woman working undercover to expose cheating husbands crosses paths with a wealthy CEO trying to escape his grandmother's matchmaking schemes.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

A young woman (WU WANWEI) wearing a sailor school uniform walks into a stylishly decorated but empty bar. She has her hair in twin braids, looking innocent and pure.

A greasy middle-aged man (MR. LIU) sits by the bar counter in a striped suit. Seeing WU WANWEI, he reveals a greedy smile.

WU WANWEI walks up to him with a smile.

WU WANWEI
College Student

WU WANWEI
You're looking sharp, Mr. Liu.

MR. LIU
Mr. Liu

MR. LIU
(standing up with a laugh)
The view just got a whole lot better.

MR. LIU approaches, placing his hand inappropriately on WU WANWEI's shoulder, then sliding it to her waist, attempting to kiss her neck. WU WANWEI appears compliant on the surface, but her eyes flash with alertness—and something colder beneath.

A miniature camera hidden behind a bottle flashes a red light.

HENCHMAN (O.S.)
Mr. Liu! Your wife is pulling up!

MR. LIU is shocked and immediately releases WU WANWEI.

MR. LIU
Damn!

MR. LIU
(to WU WANWEI)
Wait here. I mean it.

MR. LIU runs off in panic. The smile on WU WANWEI's face immediately disappears, becoming cold and stern. She shudders once, then walks to the bar counter and retrieves the hidden camera.

A HENCHMAN walks over and discovers her action.

HENCHMAN
What's that? Hey—

The HENCHMAN grabs WU WANWEI's arm. WU WANWEI counters with an over-the-shoulder throw, slamming him hard to the ground.

HENCHMAN
(in pain)
You bitch—!

WU WANWEI turns and runs.

HENCHMAN
(struggling to his feet)
Don't let her leave! Now!
continuation:
EXT. CITY - DAY

Aerial shot of the city's towering skyscrapers piercing through morning mist.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

SHENG YANCHUAN, a handsome man wearing gold-rimmed glasses, sits at a luxurious desk reviewing documents. The weariness in his eyes contradicts his polished appearance.

SHENG YANCHUAN
Sheng Group CEO

SPECIAL ASSISTANT SUN rushes in hurriedly.

SPECIAL ASSISTANT SUN
Sheng Yanchuan's Assistant

SPECIAL ASSISTANT SUN
Mr. Sheng. The Old Madam's here—two candidates in tow. She's blocking all exits. Says this blind date is non-negotiable.

SHENG YANCHUAN
Delay her. I'll find my own exit.

SHENG YANCHUAN quickly leaves the office.

WU WANWEI runs down the escalator breathlessly, entering the subway station. Two men chase after her relentlessly.

WU WANWEI breathes a sigh of relief and notices a yellow delivery worker's vest and helmet left on a seat. She quickly puts on the vest, helmet, and mask, disguising herself as a delivery worker.

The two men react, but the doors have already closed. They're trapped on the train and can only angrily pound on the window.

HENCHMAN
(muffled)
We're not done!

WU WANWEI stands on the platform, watching the departing subway and waves goodbye, her hand trembling slightly.

INT. SUBWAY PLATFORM - DAY

WU WANWEI removes the delivery worker's equipment and takes out her phone to check. The screen displays a bank text message showing she has received a 3000 yuan transfer.

WU WANWEI
(talking to herself, hollow smile)
Another family saved.

She shows a satisfied smile that doesn't quite reach her eyes.

TIANHE
Brother Zhang.

BROTHER ZHANG
Tianhe! How's the hotpot restaurant?

Almost ready. Which coat is warmest?

For your mother? These just came in.

This one. Price?

Thirty. Pure wool.

Perfect.

Gift wrap?

The other mother. His real one hasn't seen him in a month.

(scoffing)

TIANHE carries the coat and a bag labeled "Hotpot Spices." AUNTIE and AUNT notice.

AUNTIE
Tianhe! New supplies for your restaurant?

TIANHE
Mom's recipe. Getting it right this time.

AUNT
She must be proud.

TIANHE
She will be.

He walks on. The women's smiles fade.

AUNTIE
(quietly)
"Mom." He calls that woman Mom now.

AUNT
His real mother eats plain congee while he feeds them meat.

AUNTIE
(spitting)
Money makes you blind.

EXT. TIANHE'S FAMILY HOUSE - DAY

TIANHE approaches a modest shack. His MOTHER (60s) tends vegetables in thin, patched clothes.

TIANHE
Mom.

MOTHER
(startled)
Tianhe! I told you not to—

TIANHE
Try this.

He helps her into the red coat. It fits perfectly. She touches it, disbelieving.

MOTHER
This costs too much...

TIANHE
The restaurant's first profit. And...

He pulls out a photo: a new sign reading "TIANHE'S HOTPOT - MOM'S ORIGINAL RECIPE."

TIANHE (CONT'D)
You're the only chef I want. Opening next week.

MOTHER
(eyes watering)
The neighbors said...

TIANHE
Let them talk. When they taste your broth, they'll know which mother I've been learning from.

MOTHER
My foolish son... always planning ahead.

FADE OUT.

description: A writer wakes up to find her fictional male protagonist has come to life in her bedroom.
context:
Title: My Paper Boyfriend
Description: A writer wakes up to find her fictional male protagonist has come to life in her bedroom.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

A closed laptop sits on the desk. SU NANYAN, wearing pajamas, walks into the room, sits at the desk, and opens the computer.

SU NANYAN begins typing, text appearing on the screen.

ZHUANG YIN
Twenty-four. Finally seen.

SU NANYAN continues typing, her expression focused.

Cut to: SU NANYAN now wearing glasses, sitting comfortably on the bed typing on the computer, a sad smile on her face.

SU NANYAN (V.O.)
Same story. Different chapter.

SU NANYAN rests her chin on her hands, gazing at the computer screen, then sighs.

EXT. BEACH - DAY

Fast-cut montage. ZHUANG YIN, a handsome man, is surrounded by women on the beach. But his eyes are hollow. He plays volleyball mechanically. Sits alone with a drink, staring blankly.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

Bright sunlight. SU NANYAN sleeps in bed. She turns over, her hand accidentally touching a man's body beside her. She jolts awake and sits up abruptly.

SU NANYAN
Ah!

ZHUANG YIN wakes with a start and sits up. SU NANYAN clutches the blanket tightly to her chest. They stare at each other in shock.

ZHUANG YIN
Who are you?

SU NANYAN
Why are you here?

ZHUANG YIN
What did you do to me?

SU NANYAN
I didn't! I was asleep!

ZHUANG YIN
Stop finishing my sentences! I'm trying to think!

He rubs his forehead, disoriented.
continuation:
ZHUANG YIN
The sheets are wrong. This isn't my penthouse.

SU NANYAN
You don't have a penthouse. You have descriptions.

ZHUANG YIN
What?

SU NANYAN
(whisper)
Zhuang Yin.

Flashback in SU NANYAN's mind of the novel content she wrote, but the words are dissolving.

SU NANYAN (V.O.)
Zhuang Yin, twenty-four. CEO. Perfect. Paper-thin.

ZHUANG YIN
You wrote "unable to take care of himself." I remember typing it. Your fingers on my hands.

SU NANYAN
That's impossible.

ZHUANG YIN
So is being cold. But I am. So is being scared. But I am.

He looks at her—really looks. Not as an intruder.

ZHUANG YIN
Make me real. Or make me gone. But don't leave me half-written.

SU NANYAN
I can delete the files.

ZHUANG YIN
Or write what happens next. Not the fantasy. The version where I learn.

She reaches slowly for the laptop. He watches, not stopping her.

SU NANYAN
"Zhuang Yin didn't know how to be human. So he asked."

She looks at him. The words hang between them.

ZHUANG YIN
(quiet)
I'm asking.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Saving My Primitive Brother
description: A young woman wakes up injured in a deep forest with no memory, only to be saved from a bear attack by a mysterious wild man.
context:
Title: Saving My Primitive Brother
Description: A young woman wakes up injured in a deep forest with no memory, only to be saved from a bear attack by a mysterious wild man.

EXT. FOREST - DAY

Mist shrouds the ancient forest. Silence broken by dripping water.

A young woman (INJURED WOMAN), 25, lies on decaying leaves. Pink sports jacket torn. Blood on her forehead. A broken silver heart necklace.

Her eyes snap open. Pain. She sits up, gasping.

INJURED WOMAN (V.O.)
Breathe. Don't pass out. Move.

INJURED WOMAN
Where...? What happened to me?

She touches her temple—blood. No memories. Only survival.

INJURED WOMAN
I have to get out.

She forces herself up, staggers forward. Alert. Terrified.

A low GROWL. Close.

A massive BLACK BEAR emerges on hind legs. Seven feet tall.

The woman freezes. Backs into a deadfall—trapped.

The bear drops, CHARGES.
continuation:
She covers her face—

A blur. The WILD MAN—matted hair, scarred, draped in furs—grabs her waist, pulls her aside. She faints.

He lays her behind a massive oak.

The Wild Man grabs a dry branch, strikes it against a boulder—CRACK. He beats it against trees in a sharp rhythm.

The bear halts. Uncertain.

The Wild Man stands his ground, holding the branch like a torch.

The bear woofs, shakes its head, retreats into the forest.

The Wild Man watches until it's gone. A choked laugh escapes. He pounds his chest once.

He turns. The woman is conscious now, pressed against the oak.

Her eyes drop to his neck—an identical silver necklace, but whole. She clutches her broken one.

INJURED WOMAN
Who are you?

The Wild Man touches his necklace. Points at her, then himself.

INJURED WOMAN
The legend... Shennongjia wild man?

He tilts his head. Recognition wars with confusion. He extends a hand.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

LIN ZITAO and WU SHANSHAN tumble onto the bed, clothes askew.

LIN ZITAO
This young master will conquer you tonight.

WU SHANSHAN
(giggling)
Don't rush.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

The wedding venue is decorated lavishly. XIE WEI, in a white wedding dress, walks down the aisle with a bouquet. Her smile is genuine.

WEDDING MC (V.O.)
Distinguished guests, welcome to the wedding of Mr. Lin Zitao and Ms. Xie Wei. Let's welcome our beautiful bride!

Guests applaud.

WEDDING MC (V.O.)
And now, the groom!

The large screen flickers. Instead of a romantic video, LIVE FOOTAGE shows Lin Zitao and Wu Shanshan in the hotel room.

Xie Wei stops dead. The bouquet drops from her hands.

GUESTS (V.O.)
Is that real?
The groom's cheating?
On his wedding day?

WU SHANSHAN
He's mine, Xie Wei. Always has been.

GUEST A
This wedding is finished.

GUEST B
The Xie family is humiliated.

Xie Wei bends down, picks up the microphone. Her hand trembles, then steadies.

XIE WEI
Today's wedding will proceed. The groom will not.

The guests erupt.

XIE WEI
I need a man. Right here, right now. Any single man willing to marry me—I'll say yes.
continuation:
TWO MEN rush the stage.

MAN #1
I volunteer!

MAN #2
Pick me!

A sharp whistle cuts through. YOUNG MASTER HUANG appears, shoving them aside.

YOUNG MASTER HUANG
You dare compete with me?

He strides to Xie Wei, leering.

YOUNG MASTER HUANG
Don't worry, darling. I'll take care of you.

XIE WEI
Don't touch me! I never chose you.

YOUNG MASTER HUANG
You're damaged goods. Who else would want you?

Some guests start chanting.

GUESTS
Marry him! Marry him!

Young Master Huang grabs Xie Wei's arm.

XIE WEI
Let go! Get off me!

GUEST C
That's Huang Daqian—the richest man here.

GUEST D
She's trading one hell for another.

YOUNG MASTER HUANG
(leaning in)
Give me a kiss, pretty—

Suddenly, LIN CHENGYI rushes forward and slams his fist into Young Master Huang's face.

Young Master Huang crumples.

LIN CHENGYI stands protectively before Xie Wei, adjusting his glasses.

LIN CHENGYI
This woman is marrying me.

Xie Wei stares up at him, breathless.

FADE OUT.

Title: Beyond Saving
Description: A woman discovers her husband has terminal leukemia, unaware that he believes she is the one dying.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

Doctor GU YICHEN sits at his desk, facing SU MINGXUE.

GU YICHEN
Your husband has leukemia. Terminal stage.

SU MINGXUE is shocked. A glass cup falls from her hand and shatters on the floor.

SU MINGXUE
What? Leukemia?

GU YICHEN
Yes, terminal stage leukemia. If he doesn't get a bone marrow transplant, he probably only has a week left.

SU MINGXUE
(muttering to herself)
Bone marrow transplant...
(urgently)
You mean if he gets a bone marrow transplant, he can live?

GU YICHEN
(nodding)
Yes.

SU MINGXUE
Then let's do the transplant! How much does it cost?

GU YICHEN
At least 600,000 yuan.

SU MINGXUE
(shocked)
Six... 600,000... Why so much?

SU MINGXUE
Yichen, please help me find suitable bone marrow. I'll go raise the money right now!

SU MINGXUE gets up to leave. GU YICHEN grabs her arm.

GU YICHEN
Wait!

GU YICHEN takes out a bank card.

GU YICHEN
I have 300,000 here. Take it first. No rush to pay it back.

SU MINGXUE
No, Yichen, this is too much. I can't accept it.

GU YICHEN
(grabbing SU MINGXUE's hand, pressing the card into it)
Mingxue! If you hadn't given up your job back then, this money would be nothing to you. Saving a life is what matters. Just take it.

SU MINGXUE
(moved)
Yichen... Thank you. I will definitely pay you back.

GU YICHEN
Mingxue, for three years I've wanted to ask you - was it really worth it? Giving up your million-yuan annual salary for Sun Hong?

FLASHBACK BEGINS:

In the scene, SU MINGXUE lies at a car accident site, covered in blood.

SUN HONG (V.O.)
Mingxue! Mingxue!

The scene cuts to a hospital room. SU MINGXUE has bandages wrapped around her head. SUN HONG sits by the bed, his face exhausted with worry.

SUN HONG
Mingxue, you're awake.

FLASHBACK ENDS.
continuation:
INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

SU MINGXUE
(bitter smile)
Of course it was. He saved my life back then. Now that he's in this situation, even if I have to sell everything I own, I'll save him.

GU YICHEN
Mingxue, back then, maybe...

SU MINGXUE
(interrupting)
Yichen, is it true what you said? If he has the surgery, he can live?

GU YICHEN
(hesitating briefly)
Yes.

GU YICHEN
The surgery requires registration. Let me take you to handle it.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

SUN HONG leans against the wall on his phone, his voice low and tense.

SUN HONG
(into phone)
She's still pushing for more tests. Thinks it's about her.
(listens)
No, she doesn't know. Just keep quiet for now.

He sees SU MINGXUE and GU YICHEN walking toward him. He ends the call.

SUN HONG
Mingxue!

SUN HONG rushes up to them.

SUN HONG
Another consultation?

SU MINGXUE
I wasn't feeling well.

SUN HONG
(to Gu Yichen)
And you need to hold her hand for that?

GU YICHEN
(withdrawing his hand)
I was helping her up.

SUN HONG
(turning to Mingxue)
Where's the report?

SU MINGXUE
Still processing.

Two NURSES walk by, one carrying a patient file.

NURSE A
Room 309's wife still doesn't know. Terminal AML.

NURSE B
Six hundred thousand yuan. They'll never raise it in time.

SUN HONG overhears the conversation. His expression changes drastically as he stares in shock at the direction SU MINGXUE left.

SUN HONG
(whispered)
309... that's my room...

He looks down at his phone. His lock screen shows their wedding photo.

He deletes a number from his call log: "Lawyer."

SUN HONG
(to himself)
What have I become...

title: Longing Under the Bright Moon
description: A wealthy mother searches for her lost daughter while her son prepares to introduce his girlfriend, unaware of the connection that binds them.
context:
Title: Longing Under the Bright Moon
Description: A wealthy mother searches for her lost daughter while her son prepares to introduce his girlfriend, unaware of the connection that binds them.

INT. CHEN FAMILY MANSION - DAY

CHEN FENG sits on a luxurious sofa, a silver picture frame in her lap. She runs her thumb over the glass, lost in thought. After a moment, she sets it face-down on the cushion beside her.

CHEN NIANMING enters, loosening his tie. He notices the frame, hesitates.

CHEN NIANMING
Mom. I was hoping we could talk.

CHEN FENG
(quickly smoothing her expression)
Of course. About what?

She reaches for the frame, but Nianming sits beside her, blocking it.

CHEN NIANMING
I've been seeing someone. For two years now.

CHEN FENG's hand stills. She looks at him, hope flickering.

CHEN NIANMING
(gentle)
Not about Mingyue. The investigators haven't... there are no new leads.

The hope in CHEN FENG's eyes dims. She withdraws her hand, folds it in her lap.

CHEN FENG
I see.

A beat. She forces a smile.

CHEN FENG
But this... this is good news. Tell me about her.

CHEN NIANMING
Her name is Sisi. She's nothing like what you'd expect.

CHEN FENG
Meaning?

CHEN NIANMING
She's... herself. Not from our world. But she'll fit. I know she will.

CHEN FENG
(small smile)
You sound certain.

CHEN NIANMING
I am. Dinner tonight. Her father too.

CHEN FENG nods, glancing at the overturned frame.

CHEN FENG
Then we should prepare something appropriate.

CHEN AIMING enters with a fruit platter, notices the tension.

CHEN AIMING
Mom? Everything alright?

CHEN FENG
Your brother's finally bringing someone home.

CHEN AIMING
(to NIANMING, teasing)
Two years? You actually managed to keep a secret?

CHEN NIANMING
She's worth protecting.

CHEN FENG stands, her composure returning.

CHEN FENG
Aiming, help me with the jewelry safe. I want to find something suitable.

As they exit, CHEN FENG's gaze drifts back to the sofa. The overturned photo.

CHEN FENG (V.O.)
The right age now. Maybe even... no. Don't hope.
continuation:
INT. SISI'S HOME - DAY

A small, tidy apartment. LI XIANG, mid-fifties, rolls his shoulder with a wince as he reaches for a jar of ointment.

LI SISI enters, still in her work uniform, grocery bag in hand.

LI SISI
Dad, stop. You'll make it worse.

She sets the bag down, takes the jar. He lowers his hand, lets her take over.

LI XIANG
Just old bones. Doesn't take much.

LI SISI's fingers work gently, practiced. She says nothing, but her touch is careful.

LI XIANG
(quieter)
You're home early.

LI SISI
Swapped shifts. For tonight.

A pause. He studies her profile.

LI XIANG
You nervous?

LI SISI
(smiling)
Terrified.

LI XIANG
Good. Means you care.

He touches her hand briefly.

LI XIANG
Go get ready. I'll be fine.

LI SISI nods, but stays a moment longer, ensuring the patch is smooth.

MONTAGE

CHEN NIANMING is on the phone in his office, expression soft.

CHEN NIANMING
(on phone)
She wants everything to be perfect. Which means she's already planning.

LI SISI answers the phone at her workplace, keeping her voice low.

LI SISI
(on phone)
Tell her not to. Please. Just... normal.

CHEN NIANMING
(on phone)
I'll try. But 'normal' isn't really her specialty.

LI SISI
(on phone, laughing quietly)
I'll wear the dress then. The one you like.

CHEN NIANMING
(on phone)
The one I bought you? You said it was too much.

LI SISI
(on phone)
It is. But if it helps...

CHEN NIANMING
(on phone)
Just be you. That's what I need tonight.

LI SISI looks at her uniform, the name tag: "Li Sisi." She touches it.

LI SISI
(on phone)
I'll try.

She hangs up. The name tag catches the light.

title: The Moon Shines on My Heart
description: A young wife says goodbye to her soldier husband who leaves for war just one month after their wedding. Thirty years later, a chance encounter at a hospital may reunite them.
context:
Title: The Moon Shines on My Heart
Description: A young wife says goodbye to her soldier husband who leaves for war just one month after their wedding. Thirty years later, a chance encounter at a hospital may reunite them.

INT. VILLAGE DIRT ROAD - DAY (THIRTY YEARS AGO)

A military truck loaded with young soldiers slowly drives along. Villagers wave goodbye from the roadside, emotions running high.

Young XIAO YUE (20s) grips the edge of the truck tightly, holding hands with her husband ZHOU GE (20s) on the truck, tears streaming down her face.

ZHOU GE
Xiao Yue, I'm sorry. Just one month after our wedding, I have to leave for the strait war. I've failed you.

XIAO YUE
(crying)
Zhou Ge, you must come back safe and sound.

ZHOU GE
Don't worry. We'll definitely win in six months. Six months from now, wait for me to come home.

The truck accelerates, forcing Xiao Yue to let go. She runs after the truck for a few steps, shouting loudly.

XIAO YUE
(shouting)
Zhou Ge! Zhou Ge! I haven't told you yet - you're going to be a father! It's twins! We'll have both a son and a daughter!

Zhou Ge on the truck leans out as far as he can, but due to the distance and noise, he can't hear clearly.

ZHOU GE
(shouting)
Xiao Yue, what did you say? I can't hear you!

The truck drives away. Xiao Yue stops running, caressing her belly, watching the departing truck, her face covered in tears.

DISSOLVE TO:

INT. XIAO YUE'S HOME - DAY

Elderly XIAO YUE (50s) busies herself in the kitchen, preparing a table full of delicious dishes. She wears a smile, seemingly anticipating something.

Her phone rings. Xiao Yue happily answers.

XIAO YUE
(on phone)
(happy)
Hello?

DAUGHTER XIAO XIAO (V.O.)
Mom? I hate to do this, but my boss just scheduled an emergency meeting for tonight. I tried everything to get out of it--

Xiao Yue's smile falters. She forces brightness into her voice.

XIAO YUE
(on phone)
It's okay, sweetie. Your career is important. We'll celebrate next weekend.

Xiao Yue hangs up, looking at the prepared feast. The phone rings again.

SON NIAN NIAN (V.O.)
Mom, I'm so sorry. Your grandson has a fever and Jun's working late. I can't bring him out in this weather--

XIAO YUE
(on phone)
Take care of my grandson. That's what matters. I'll save you both some mooncakes.

She ends the call, staring at her reflection in the window. Her dog TU DOU nudges her hand.

Later, Xiao Yue takes out a red marriage certificate from a drawer and gently opens it. She caresses the photo of her and Zhou Ge from their youth, then touches the well-worn edges.

She places it beside a framed photo of her children as toddlers, then looks at a newer photo of her grandchildren on the wall.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL LOBBY - DAY

Xiao Yue stands in front of a self-service registration machine, squinting at the screen. Her hands tremble slightly as she touches it.

A YOUNG MAN behind her shifts impatiently.

YOUNG MAN
Can you hurry up?

XIAO YUE
(flustered)
I'm trying... this new system confuses me.

YOUNG MAN
(sighs)
Then get your kids to help! Some of us have actual jobs to get back to.

XIAO YUE
(lowered voice)
They're busy.

She steps aside, clutching her hospital card. The young man brushes past.

Xiao Yue approaches a help desk instead, where a NURSE notices her.

INT. HOSPITAL INFUSION ROOM - DAY

Xiao Yue sits alone in a chair receiving an IV drip. The bag is nearly empty. She watches the drip chamber, tracking each drop.

Across the room, a HOSPITAL MAN (50s) - weathered face, graying hair - also sits with an IV. He glances at her.

Xiao Yue notices him. She stares. His profile, his posture...

Her breath catches. She studies his hands - one bears a faint scar across the knuckles.

FLASHBACK: Zhou Ge's hand, young and strong, that same scar from a childhood accident.

The Hospital Man feels her gaze and turns. Their eyes meet. He blinks, puzzled.

XIAO YUE
(whisper)
Zhou... Ge?

The man tilts his head. A flicker of something crosses his face - confusion, recognition, disbelief.

HOSPITAL MAN
(hoarse)
Do I... know you?

Xiao Yue trembles, tears filling her eyes. She touches her chest, then points to him.

XIAO YUE
It's me. Xiao Yue.

He stares. The IV alarm BEEPS beside him. Neither moves.

A NURSE approaches Xiao Yue.

NURSE
Ma'am, your drip's done.

The Nurse removes Xiao Yue's needle. Xiao Yue doesn't look away from the man.

The Nurse notices the tension, glances between them.

NURSE
(to Hospital Man)
Sir? Your bag's empty too.

He barely nods, still locked on Xiao Yue. The Nurse removes his needle.

When the Nurse leaves, silence stretches between them.

HOSPITAL MAN
(quiet, strained)
They told me... my family thought I was gone. I couldn't remember my name for twenty years. Only fragments.

XIAO YUE
(voice breaking)
We waited. I waited.

He looks down at his weathered hands. When he looks up, his eyes are wet.

HOSPITAL MAN
The twins?

Xiao Yue nods slowly, tears streaming down her face.

XIAO YUE
A son and a daughter. Both grown. Two grandchildren now.

She reaches into her bag with shaking hands and pulls out her phone. Shows him a photo of her family - her children, grandchildren.

His hand trembles as he reaches for the phone.

HOSPITAL MAN
(whisper)
I have a family.

XIAO YUE
You always did.

He hands back the phone. Their fingers brush. A lifetime passes in that touch.

HOSPITAL MAN
I'm staying with... someone who helped me. After the war injuries. But... may I see them? The children?

XIAO YUE
(softly)
They're your children too.

For the first time, a small, hesitant smile touches his lips.

HOSPITAL MAN
Mid-Autumn Festival is next week. I remember... you promised to wait.

XIAO YUE
I never stopped.

He nods, eyes glistening with resolve.

HOSPITAL MAN
Then... we still have time.

Xiao Yue looks at him - this stranger who is her husband. The tears on her face are no longer just of sorrow.

FADE OUT.

Title: Starlight Falls Into My Palm
Description: A young woman is forced to marry a comatose heir in place of her employer's daughter, entering a world of wealth and secrets.

INT. CHEN FAMILY BEDROOM - DAY

Sunlight filters through heavy curtains. CHEN YUBAI lies motionless, breathing aided by subtle medical equipment. DR. JIANG reviews charts while a NURSE adjusts IV lines.

CHEN'S MOTHER (60s, elegant, fraying at the edges) hovers near the door. SECRETARY QIN stands impassively beside her.

DR. JIANG closes the file with a soft snap.

CHEN'S MOTHER
Dr. Jiang?

DR. JIANG
The vitals remain stable. But Madam... two years. The brain activity hasn't changed.

CHEN'S MOTHER
(quietly desperate)
So we're just waiting for his body to give up?

DR. JIANG
We're doing everything medically possible. Sometimes... there are limits.

The doctor exits. The nurse follows.

CHEN'S MOTHER stares at her son, then at the medical equipment keeping him alive. She touches a jade bracelet on her wrist—an heirloom.

CHEN'S MOTHER
(to herself)
The fortune-teller said... a wedding might shift his fate.

CHEN'S MOTHER
(to SECRETARY QIN)
The Song girl. The engagement our fathers made. Bring her.

SECRETARY QIN
Madam... the legalities—

CHEN'S MOTHER
A ceremony. That's all. Something to wake the universe. Make it happen.

SECRETARY QIN
Yes, Madam.

INT. SONG FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

SONG YAYA (20, polished, terrified beneath the anger) paces like a caged animal. A vase crashes to the floor. Her parents watch from the sofa.

FATHER SONG
Yaya, the Chen family holds our debt. We have no choice.

SONG YAYA
Then let them take the house! I'm not spending my life tethered to a corpse!

MOTHER SONG
It's only symbolic. A year, then you can—

SONG YAYA
A year of my life, Mother! A year of being the widow who was never a wife!

MOTHER SONG
(to FATHER SONG)
What about Qiao Wanwan? Your late brother's illegitimate daughter. She owes us.

FATHER SONG
(rubbing his temples)
She looks enough like Yaya to pass. But if Chen's mother finds out...

MOTHER SONG
She won't. Wanwan knows what happens to her mother if she talks.

MOTHER SONG
(calling sharply)
Wanwan!

QIAO WANWAN (22, quiet eyes, contained fire) enters. She holds herself like someone used to being invisible.

QIAO WANWAN
Madam?

FATHER SONG
Your cousin's engagement. You'll stand in for her. Temporarily.

QIAO WANWAN
I'm not family enough to be family, but I'm family enough for this?

MOTHER SONG
Don't be clever. Your mother needs her medication. That expensive treatment.

QIAO WANWAN
(very still)
You're threatening my mother.

MOTHER SONG
I'm offering you a way to save her. And yourself.

QIAO WANWAN looks at SONG YAYA, who won't meet her eyes. Then at the shattered vase on the floor.

QIAO WANWAN
I'll need it in writing. My mother's care. Guaranteed.
continuation:
EXT. SONG FAMILY VILLA - DUSK

QIAO WANWAN, in a simple white dress that doesn't quite fit, kneels before SISTER QIAO (50s, frail but sharp).

SISTER QIAO
(trembling fingers on Wanwan's face)
You're lying. The Song girl would never let you—

QIAO WANWAN
(forcing a smile)
It's a job, Mom. Like being a caretaker. Just... in a nicer house.

SISTER QIAO
Wanwan...

SECRETARY QIN waits by the black car, face neutral.

SONG YAYA appears on the balcony above, clutching a wine glass. She raises it in a bitter toast.

SONG YAYA
Don't forget to send postcards from your new life.

QIAO WANWAN helps her mother stand, then walks to the car without looking back.

INT. CHEN FAMILY MANSION - NIGHT

QIAO WANWAN follows SECRETARY QIN through cavernous halls. Modern art clashes with ancestral portraits. Everything gleams with old money.

QIAO WANWAN (V.O.)
Rich enough to buy miracles. Desperate enough to try.

SECRETARY QIN stops at double doors.

SECRETARY QIN
He doesn't know you're coming. Or maybe he does. Who can say?

He opens the doors but doesn't enter.

INT. CHEN FAMILY BEDROOM - CONTINUOUS

QIAO WANWAN steps inside. The doors close behind her. She hears the LOCK CLICK.

She tries the handle. Locked.

She turns. The room is larger than her entire childhood home. And there, in the center, CHEN YUBAI.

She approaches slowly. Up close, he looks younger than his photographs. A faded scar cuts through his left eyebrow.

She notices his hand rests on top of the blanket. On impulse, she places her smaller hand near his—not touching, just... parallel.

QIAO WANWAN
(whisper)
They bought me to be your ghost bride. But I don't believe in ghosts.

She sits in the chair beside his bed. Outside, the city lights begin to flicker on.

QIAO WANWAN (V.O.)
Let them lock their doors. I've been a ghost my whole life.

FADE OUT.

title: Deception Game
description: A con artist team uses a fake charity scheme to lure villagers into their trap, starting with free mooncakes and a planted accomplice.
context:
Title: Deception Game
Description: A con artist team uses a fake charity scheme to lure villagers into their trap, starting with free mooncakes and a planted accomplice.

EXT. VILLAGE ENTRANCE CLEARING - DAY

A delivery truck idles in dust. LU HONG stands on the flatbed with stacked gift boxes. Villagers keep their distance.

LU HONG
(raising megaphone)
Mid-Autumn Festival! Free mooncakes from GreenSun Energy!

VILLAGER A
Free? What's the catch?

VILLAGER B
Probably expired stock.

XU HAOYU steps forward, holding a medical bill envelope.

XU HAOYU
Never heard of GreenSun.

LU HONG
New startup. Our CEO invests in villages, not TV ads.

XU HAOYU
Boss has a name?

LU HONG
CEO Wan. Come see for yourself.

XU HAOYU glances at his envelope, then accepts a box.

XU HAOYU
Real lotus paste.

VILLAGER C
My grandson loves these. We can't afford them this year.

CHEN HAO leans from the driver's window.

CHEN HAO
One per family, folks.

GANG ZI pushes through, holding a box.

GANG ZI
Another for my sister's place.

LU HONG
One per household, brother. Rules are rules.

GANG ZI
City rules or village rules?

Villagers relax, some chuckling. They line up.

LU HONG
(once distribution slows)
GreenSun seeks one local partner. Invest one thousand yuan today, get it back tomorrow with five percent dividend. Plus free solar consultation.

The crowd stills. XU HAOYU grips his medical bill.

XU HAOYU
Five percent in one day? What bank gives that?

VILLAGER B
Sounds like pyramid schemes.

GANG ZI
I've seen their East District office. Three floors, glass front.

CHEN HAO
(producing a laminated certificate)
License and tax records. All proper.

GANG ZI takes the certificate, examines the seal closely.
continuation:
GANG ZI
(to Xu Haoyu)
I've worked construction in the city. This seal is legit.

XU HAOYU
(quietly)
You're from here?

GANG ZI
Used to be. Back for my mother. City life's expensive.

XU HAOYU
My mother needs surgery. Ten thousand.

GANG ZI
A thousand's a thousand. Sometimes you gotta trust something.

GANG ZI pulls a worn wallet, counts out one thousand yuan. Villagers watch.

VILLAGER C
Brother, don't do it.

VILLAGER A
We've seen this story before.

GANG ZI
I've seen their office. What have you seen?

He hands cash to Lu Hong. Lu Hong writes a receipt.

LU HONG
Partnership recorded. Same time tomorrow, nine sharp.

GANG ZI
(nodding to Xu Haoyu)
See you tomorrow?

XU HAOYU
(staring at envelope)
Maybe.

LU HONG, CHEN HAO, and SU WAN in the cab exchange a look.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

The truck rumbles down the narrow road.

INT. TRUCK CABIN - DAY

LU HONG drives. SU WAN counts cash in the passenger seat. CHEN HAO and GANG ZI ride in back, silent.

SU WAN
One brings ten tomorrow.

LU HONG
(quiet)
The one with the hospital bill looked ready to break.

SU WAN
That's the business.

GANG ZI
(leaning forward)
He recognized me. From the factory.

SU WAN
So?

GANG ZI
Nothing. Just... he recognized me.

SU WAN
Get some sleep. Tomorrow we collect.

The truck passes the village sign. LU HONG checks the rearview mirror—GANG ZI watches the receding fields.

The truck accelerates into the distance.

context:
Title: The Broken Her
Description: A young student is terrorized by a powerful young master, leading to a tragic fall, while her mother witnesses the horror unfold.

INT. APARTMENT - DAY

HAN SANSHAO wears a black tank top and studded pants, his back to the camera as he cleans his bloodied knuckles. He turns, his smile empty.

ON SCREEN: HAN is HAN SANSHAO, Third Young Master Han

HAN SANSHAO slowly walks forward and crouches down.

HAN SANSHAO
Let's try that again.

YE TANGTANG, wearing a school uniform, scrambles up from the sofa in terror and retreats toward the window.

YE TANGTANG
One more step and I'm gone.

YE TANGTANG opens the window. Her temple is bruised, her lip split, her eyes hold a final decision.

HAN SANSHAO
(chuckling)

YE TANGTANG
(terrified)
Stay back!

HAN SANSHAO
Han Corporation owns this building. I own you.

HAN SANSHAO walks to the window, looking down at YE TANGTANG.

HAN SANSHAO
Then jump. Need instructions? Jump. Jump! Jump!

HAN SANSHAO
(shouting)
JUMP!

YE TANGTANG falls from the window.
continuation:
EXT. BUILDING ENTRANCE - DAY

YE TANGTANG lies on the concrete ground, covered in blood, dead.

Her mother, YE XIANGYUN, stands in the parking lot not far away, having witnessed everything, her expression shocked and anguished.

ON SCREEN: YE TANGTANG, daughter of YE XIANGYUN

YE XIANGYUN
(silent scream)
Tangtang!

ON SCREEN: YE XIANGYUN

Time reversal effects and sound.

ON SCREEN: 2 HOURS EARLIER

EXT. STREET - DAY

HAN SANSHAO wears a studded leather jacket and sunglasses, getting out of a luxury car, followed by a group of men in black suits.

YE TANGTANG, in her school uniform, stands by the roadside holding a few small oranges.

HAN SANSHAO swaggers down the street with his men, walking toward the fruit stand where YE TANGTANG is.

HAN SANSHAO
Give me your number. Now.

He reaches for the oranges in YE TANGTANG's hands. YE XIANGYUN, who runs the fruit stand, immediately rushes over to protect her daughter.

YE XIANGYUN
Young man, what would you like to eat? We have barbecue here, and oranges, all quite sweet. Try one.

YE XIANGYUN picks up an orange and offers it to HAN SANSHAO.

HAN SANSHAO knocks over the basket full of oranges.

HAN SANSHAO
Eat what?! You're not even good enough to look at.

YE XIANGYUN shields her daughter behind her.

YE XIANGYUN
Why are you doing this?

The frame freezes on the terrified faces of YE XIANGYUN and YE TANGTANG.

title: Law Proves Me Innocent, Love Sentences Me to Death
description: A renowned gold-medal lawyer gives up her career to become a housewife for six years, only to discover during her live legal consultation stream that her husband considers their marriage a fraud.
context:
Title: Law Proves Me Innocent, Love Sentences Me to Death
Description: A renowned gold-medal lawyer gives up her career to become a housewife for six years, only to discover during her live legal consultation stream that her husband considers their marriage a fraud.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

LI YAOXUE lies awake in bed, staring at a wedding photo of her and GU SIPEI on the wall.

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
I hereby announce that the first place winner of this year's Global Lawyer Gold Award goes to—Lawyer Li Yaoxue!

LI YAOXUE closes her eyes.

LI YAOXUE (V.O.)
Six years ago, I stood on that stage.

FLASHBACK:

LI YAOXUE, wearing a lawyer's robe, holds up a trophy at a grand awards ceremony. The audience applauds thunderously. She smiles brilliantly, full of pride and ambition.

END FLASHBACK.

LI YAOXUE (V.O.)
Now, I answer to a different call.

She touches the wedding photo, her expression bittersweet.

GU SIPEI enters, checking his watch.

GU SIPEI
You're still in bed.

LI YAOXUE
I was about to—

GU SIPEI
No need. Breakfast is ready.

LI YAOXUE
You didn't have to.

GU SIPEI
I married you for a reason, didn't I? Go eat before it gets cold.

He adjusts his tie, a practiced gesture.

GU SIPEI
I have an early meeting. Don't wait up.

He kisses her forehead—a brief, automatic gesture—then exits.

LI YAOXUE watches him leave, her smile fading slightly.

Her phone BUZZES. LI YAOXUE answers.

BEST FRIEND (O.S.)
Stream's at ten, right? You're cutting it close.

LI YAOXUE
I'll be ready.

BEST FRIEND (O.S.)
Six years, Yaoxue. You really think he'll be okay with this?

LI YAOXUE
He doesn't control everything.

BEST FRIEND (O.S.)
Just... be careful.

LI YAOXUE
I know what I'm doing.

She ends the call, a flicker of doubt crossing her face.
continuation:
INT. STUDY - DAY

LI YAOXUE sits at a desk, adjusting a microphone, phone propped before her. The livestream interface shows viewer counts climbing.

COMMENT
The legendary Lawyer Li is back!

COMMENT
Show yourself!

COMMENT
We want to see the famous gold-medal lawyer!

LI YAOXUE turns on the camera, composed.

LI YAOXUE
Good morning. This is Lawyer Li. For those joining the consultation, please follow the protocol. Active participants receive a token of appreciation.

She indicates a sleek jewelry box beside her—containing an elegant necklace.

LI YAOXUE
Let's begin. First caller?

She taps her screen.

LI YAOXUE
You're connected. Please describe your case.

GU SIPEI (O.S.)
Lawyer Li. I need to dissolve a fraudulent marriage. A woman deceived me—trapped me with false pretenses. I want to make her pay.

LI YAOXUE's breath catches. This voice—familiar yet cold, professional.

LI YAOXUE (thinking)
Isn't that... no. It can't be.

GU SIPEI (O.S.)
She pretended to be someone she wasn't. Wasted six years of my life. How do I ensure she leaves with nothing?

LI YAOXUE stares at the screen—audio only, caller ID hidden. Her knuckles whiten on the desk edge.

LI YAOXUE (V.O.)
Six years.

The stream chat EXPLODES with reactions.

FREEZE FRAME on LI YAOXUE's face—shock giving way to something harder. Determined.

TO BE CONTINUED

Title: Untitled Script
Description: A powerful family enforcer terrorizes a father into signing documents after killing his son, while the eldest son, a decorated military commander, prepares to return home.

INT. TANG FAMILY HOUSE - DAY

MR. HUO and several HENCHMEN burst into the Tang family home. The Tang family's younger son, TANG CHEN, is held by two henchmen, a knife at his throat. TANG FATHER (TANG SHUJIN) and TANG MOTHER (CHEN XIAOHUI) are restrained.

MR. HUO
(to TANG SHUJIN)
The deed to your fishing rights. Sign it now, or I take payment in blood.

TANG SHUJIN
(defiant)
You have no claim to those waters.

MR. HUO
(smiling)
I have ten men with blades. That's claim enough.

TANG CHEN struggles. The knife bites deeper.

CHEN XIAOHUI
(pleading)
Shujin, please—

TANG SHUJIN
(stalling)
My eldest son serves the Xiaolong Legion. He'll—----

MR. HUO
(laughs)
Your hero son is five years absent. I'm here today.

TANG CHEN
(through gritted teeth)
Father, don't—

MR. HUO nods. The henchman cuts TANG CHEN's throat. Blood spills. TANG CHEN collapses.

CHEN XIAOHUI
(screaming)

TANG SHUJIN
(anguished)
continuation:
Chen!

MR. HUO wipes blood from his face, unfazed.

MR. HUO
Now. About that signature. Your wife's blood next, or your ink?

He produces a scroll and presses it open. A henchman forces TANG SHUJIN's hand onto the paper.

TANG SHUJIN
(weeping)
I built that fleet... five generations...

MR. HUO
Then you should've built a better wall.

A henchman raises a stick against CHEN XIAOHUI.

TANG SHUJIN
(broken)
Stop! I'll sign...

He takes the pen with trembling fingers.

EXT. MILITARY CAMP - DAY

The Tang family's eldest son, TANG YUFENG, in military uniform, stands before his commander, ZHENG LONG. The Xiaolong Legion forms ranks behind them.

TANG YUFENG
Five years, Commander. Thank you.

ZHENG LONG
Your family earned this honor. Return with it.

A soldier, QIN HAO, kneels.

QIN HAO
Farewell, Commander Feng!

ALL SOLDIERS
(in unison)
Farewell, Commander Feng! Farewell, Commander Feng! Farewell, Commander Feng!

TANG YUFENG touches a jade pendant—his mother's gift. His eyes harden with purpose. He turns toward home.

title: Love at Life's Crossroads
description: A dedicated employee discovers her boss has blocked her on social media and credits her work to another woman, leading to a confrontation about stolen achievements and betrayal.
context:
Title: Love at Life's Crossroads
Description: A dedicated employee discovers her boss has blocked her on social media and credits her work to another woman, leading to a confrontation about stolen achievements and betrayal.

INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

A FEMALE COLLEAGUE approaches MU XIAN, who is working late at her desk.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
Mu Xian, check Boss Huo's post. It's... exploded.

MU XIAN takes the phone, then checks her own, confusion hardening into suspicion.

MU XIAN
That's not showing up on my feed.

Screenshots of HUO YUCHEN and LIU JIAOJIAO's social media posts flash on screen.

HUO YUCHEN (V.O.)
Day 1,001 of knowing each other. A surprise arrives.

LIU JIAOJIAO (V.O.)
The most special day. Lucky to have you.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
He blocked you. Look at that ring—must be six figures.

MU XIAN
(quietly)
Go home. I'll handle this.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
Sister Mu...

MU XIAN
Please.

The FEMALE COLLEAGUE leaves. Mu Xian pulls up a file on her laptop: "Wanjing Deal - Final Negotiations." Her name is on every page. She slams the laptop shut.
continuation:
INT. OFFICE HALLWAY - MOMENTS LATER

MU XIAN sees HUO YUCHEN and LIU JIAOJIAO by the elevators.

LIU JIAOJIAO
Next time has to be even bigger.

HUO YUCHEN
Name it.

MU XIAN
Huo Yuchen. The Wanjing contract.

HUO YUCHEN
Jiaojiao closed it. Wire transfer's pending.

MU XIAN
I negotiated those terms. I have the proof from yesterday.

HUO YUCHEN
(coldly)
Every deal she closes, you claim. It's unprofessional jealousy.

LIU JIAOJIAO
(softly)
Sister Mu, if you need this win for your review...

HUO YUCHEN
Don't. She doesn't get to claim your work.

(to Mu Xian)
Tomorrow's celebration is mandatory. You'll draft the proposal. 8 AM. My desk.

INT. OFFICE - CONTINUOUS

LIU JIAOJIAO sets a water bottle on Mu Xian's desk.

LIU JIAOJIAO
Overtime, then party planning. You must be exhausted, Sister Mu. Might want to invest in better foundation tomorrow—for the photos.

Mu Xian's hand shakes. She grabs the bottle and splashes water in LIU JIAOJIAO's face.

LIU JIAOJIAO
(screams)
Ah!

She falls back against the desk.

HUO YUCHEN
(roaring)
What the hell is wrong with you?

HUO YUCHEN rushes over, catching Liu Jiaojiao.

LIU JIAOJIAO
(tearfully)
She saw the ring post, Boss Huo. I tried to apologize...

HUO YUCHEN
(to Mu Xian)
Over a diamond? She's the reason we're not bankrupt. Apologize. Now.

Mu Xian looks at her phone—still showing the blocked feed—then at the water dripping from her hand onto her name tag.
