context:
Title: CEO Fu's Inescapable Love and Hate
Description: Lin Yiyi, the second daughter of Tianjin Group, watches helplessly as her sister steals her groom on what was supposed to be her wedding day.

INT. PARK - DAY

LIN YIYI sits beneath an ancient oak, her ivory wedding dress pooling around her. She stares at her phone, which displays a photo of FU JINGXUAN.

Her FRIEND, elegant in a crimson dress, kneels before her, visibly distressed.

FRIEND
Your sister's wearing your dress, marrying your man. And you're just... scrolling through memories?

LIN YIYI doesn't answer. A tear lands on her phone screen.

EXT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

An outdoor ceremony is in progress.

The bride, LIN XIAOTONG, wears Lin Yiyi's custom gown and holds a bouquet, triumph in her eyes.

The groom, FU JINGXUAN, stands on stage in a black suit, his gaze fixed on the empty seat where Lin Yiyi should be.

In the guest seating area, FU JINGXUAN'S MOTHER watches with a sharp, expectant expression.

The OFFICIANT stands before the couple.

OFFICIANT
Mr. Fu Jingxuan, do you take Miss Lin Xiaotong as your lawfully wedded wife? In sickness and in health, for richer or poorer?

FU JINGXUAN remains silent, his eyes complex. He glances at his mother.

OFFICIANT
Mr. Fu?

FU JINGXUAN turns back to face LIN XIAOTONG. She gives him an expectant smile.

FU JINGXUAN
(after a weighted pause)
I do.

LIN XIAOTONG's face lights up with a victorious smile.
continuation:
INT. PARK - DAY

LIN YIYI'S FRIEND grasps her arm emotionally.

FRIEND
She forged the paperwork, Yiyi. Your mother approved it—called it "correcting a family mistake." Are you going to let their lies become your truth?

LIN YIYI finally looks up, devastation giving way to something colder.

LIN YIYI
What truth? That I was always the expendable daughter?

EXT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

FU JINGXUAN and LIN XIAOTONG exchange rings. Petals fall from above.

The GUESTS applaud enthusiastically.

GUESTS (O.S.)
Kiss! Kiss! Kiss!

FU JINGXUAN and LIN XIAOTONG lock eyes amid the cheering, slowly leaning closer. He shuts his eyes.

EXT. ROAD - DAY

LIN YIYI breaks free and stumbles toward the road, her expression hollow.

A black sedan speeds toward her.

The piercing sound of brakes screeches.

LIN YIYI is struck and thrown into the air, landing heavily.

She lies on the asphalt, her dress stained, blood trickling from her mouth, eyes staring blankly.

FADE TO BLACK.

description: A mysterious woman named Rose arrives at an engagement party, revealing a dangerous connection to the groom that threatens to unravel everything.
context:
Title: The Secret of Rose
Description: A mysterious woman named Rose arrives at an engagement party, revealing a dangerous connection to the groom that threatens to unravel everything.

INT. UNKNOWN LOCATION - DAY

Close-up on ROSE, wearing a red dress, exquisite makeup, sharp eyes, and a mysterious smile at the corner of her mouth.

ROSE (V.O.)
Zi'an thinks he's the player. Let's see how he likes being played.

EXT. GARDEN PARTY - DAY

An outdoor engagement party is in progress. Guests chat in small groups.

MR. CHEN, wearing a black tailcoat and gold-rimmed glasses, appears restless in the crowd. He checks his phone, then spots something that makes his face pale.

MR. CHEN grabs ROSE by the arm and pulls her behind a backdrop printed with wedding photos.

MR. CHEN
(through gritted teeth)
I told you to stay away.

ROSE
(straightening his boutonniere)
And miss your big day? I'm her favorite guest.

MR. CHEN
(grabbing her hand)
Stop. Whatever you want—

In the distance, SU WANYING in a white wedding dress and her BRIDESMAIDS walk toward them.

ROSE
(leaning close, voice like honey)
She's coming. Smile, darling. Wouldn't want her to see you sweat.

MR. CHEN's expression tightens. He turns around in panic.

SU WANYING approaches.

MR. CHEN
(going to meet her, forced cheer)
Wanying.

ROSE steps forward first, embracing SU WANYING with genuine warmth.

ROSE
Finally! I almost thought you'd locked her in a tower, Zi'an.

SU WANYING
(delighted)
Rose! You made it.

ROSE
continuation:
Wouldn't miss it. Though your fiancé seems... nervous about my gift.

MR. CHEN
It's nothing, honey. Rose was just leaving.

SU WANYING
(to ROSE)
Ignore him. He's been a wreck all day. Stay—please.

ROSE
I'll be careful not to cause trouble.

MR. CHEN
(quietly desperate)
Wanying, the guests—

SU WANYING
(to MR. CHEN)
Go entertain them. We'll catch up.

MR. CHEN
It's better not to wander around, to avoid causing trouble.

ROSE
(looking at him, smile sharp)
Trouble finds me. Always has.

SU WANYING
(to ROSE)
Meet me later? There's something I want you to see.

ROSE
Wouldn't miss it.

SU WANYING and MR. CHEN leave. ROSE watches them, her smile fading. She touches a hidden object in her clutch.

INT. CORRIDOR - DAY

ROSE walks alone down a quiet corridor, her high heels clicking crisply. She stops at a door marked "STUDY."

She reaches for the handle, then hesitates. Listens.

ROSE
(under her breath)
Right on time.

As soon as the door opens a crack, a MAN WITH A KNIFE wearing a hat emerges from behind it, controls ROSE from behind, and holds a small knife to her neck.

MAN WITH A KNIFE
(whisper)
Shouldn't have come back.

ROSE's eyes become cold and alert. She doesn't struggle.

FADE OUT.

title: Are You Crazy! How Dare You Fire A Miracle Doctor
description: When Jiangzhou's richest man suffers a catastrophic stroke, a conflicted young TCM prodigy must risk his career and legacy to attempt a forbidden technique—knowing his intervention could either save a life or destroy his own.
context:
Title: Are You Crazy! How Dare You Fire A Miracle Doctor
Description: When Jiangzhou's richest man suffers a catastrophic stroke, a conflicted young TCM prodigy must risk his career and legacy to attempt a forbidden technique—knowing his intervention could either save a life or destroy his own.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

JIANG BEI (28), stethoscope around his neck, hunches over an ancient thread-bound book: "Nine Needles to Break Evil Spirits." A faded family photo peeks from the pages. 

His phone BUZZES urgently. On his computer, a news ticker scrolls silently: "BREAKING: Jiuzhou tycoon Chen Yi suffers massive stroke—critical condition."

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
...sources confirm Mr. Chen's condition is deteriorating rapidly. Our top story: Medical emergency at Huacheng Sanatorium...

Jiang Bei silences his phone, hand trembling as he touches the book.

JIANG BEI
(whispering)
Forgive me, Grandfather.

EMERGENCY RESCUE MONTAGE:

- Red ambulance lights slice through rain-soaked streets.
- CHEN YI (60s) is wheeled into trauma bay, monitors flatlining.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Chen Yi, listed in critical condition, has been admitted to Huacheng Sanatorium's elite neuro unit. Specialists have been mobilized...

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Medical staff sprint alongside the stretcher. CHEN XIAOLONG (30s), bespoke suit soaked with rain, jogs beside them.

CHEN XIAOLONG
(voice cracking, authoritative)
Save him. Whatever it costs—my father built this hospital wing. He doesn't get to die in it.

A NURSE gently restrains him as the OR doors swing shut. The "SURGERY IN PROGRESS" sign ignites.
continuation:
INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

Chaos. LEAD SURGEON (50s) studies a CT scan—white mass obscuring brain stem. Monitors chirp arrhythmically.

LEAD SURGEON
Bleed's too deep. Craniotomy's useless. Pressure's spiking—190 over 110.

FEMALE NURSE
What about thrombolytics?

LEAD SURGEON
He's already maxed. Last option is Dr. Jiang's technique, but—

The OR door hisses open.

Jiang Bei enters, shrugging on sterile scrubs, his medical box tucked under one arm. The staff part like water.

LEAD SURGEON
Dr. Jiang. We can't stabilize—

JIANG BEI
(interrupting, calm)
Vitals. CT.

He opens the red wooden box. Silver needles gleam under surgical lights. Chen Yi's monitor PINGS—pressure climbing.

Jiang Bei palpates Chen Yi's skull, eyes closed. His fingers find a point. He hesitates—a heartbeat of doubt.

FEMALE NURSE
(quietly, to colleague)
He's doing it blind?

LEAD SURGEON
(whispering)
Twenty years training. His family's technique predates this hospital.

Jiang Bei exhales. The needle sinks in—precise, surgical. A second. Third.

Monitors stabilize. Blood pressure drops: 140 over 85. Heart rate steadies.

FEMALE NURSE
(astonished)
Clot's resolving on the scan...

Jiang Bei closes his box, shoulders tight.

JIANG BEI
These needles maintain pressure equilibrium. Remove any within sixty minutes—

LEAD SURGEON
What happens?

JIANG BEI
(turning away)
Rebound hemorrhage. Instantaneous. The technique is... unforgiving.

He stops at the door, not looking back.

JIANG BEI (CONT'D)
And Doctor? My methods weren't in your protocol. If this goes wrong—I'm already fired.

The door closes. The staff stare at the needles—tiny, fragile, holding a life in balance.

Title: White Moonlight Paradox
Description: A woman is reborn and discovers her husband never loved her, but always loved Shen Zhizhi instead.

INT. LUXURY APARTMENT - NIGHT

RUAN WAN (28) sits by floor-to-ceiling windows, a fashionable denim jacket over silk pajamas. Her reflection shows a face that's died before.

RUAN WAN (V.O.)
I died screaming their names. Now I wake up three years earlier. Before Shen Zhizhi returns. Before my husband breaks me.

FLASHBACK:

Images flash: Ruan Wan crying over divorce papers. A man's hand pushing her away. Shen Zhizhi's triumphant smile. A car plunging off a cliff.

RUAN WAN (V.O.)
The clown. The placeholder. Their obstacle.

ON SCREEN: Character name - RUAN WAN.
continuation:
INT. CLUB HALLWAY - NIGHT

RUAN WAN walks expressionless, phone in hand - a photo of her husband with Shen Zhizhi. Her knuckles are white.

RICH HANDSOME MAN (O.S.)
Ignoring me now? Or did hubby finally confess?

She stops, hollow-eyed.

RICH HANDSOME MAN (O.S.)
You thought we wanted you? Every dinner, every gift - just to help Zhizhi test his devotion. And yours.

He laughs, cruel.

RICH HANDSOME MAN (O.S.)
She lands tomorrow. Your anniversary spot. You're not half what she is.

RUAN WAN closes her eyes, absorbing the insults. A tear falls.

Then she opens them, now cold and clear.

RUAN WAN
(internal monologue)
Three years head start. Let's see who laughs last.

RUAN WAN stares directly at the camera, her eyes filled with terrible clarity. She holds up her phone, deletes the contact: "Husband."

context:
Title: Waking Up Five Years Later, Married to the Richest Heir
Description: After waking from a coma, Lin Ci discovers she's lost five years of memory and is married to the powerful heir she once admired from afar.

INT. SCHOOL PLAYGROUND - DAY

LIN CI (18 years old), wearing a school uniform, nervously holds a pink love letter in both hands.

LIN CI (V.O.)
Today, eighteen-year-old Lin Ci has decided to confess her feelings to her senior, Jiang He.

LIN CI smiles, walking across the playground full of anticipation.

FLASHBACK:

JIANG HE and Lin Ci's best friend LI SIQI embrace tightly on the steps.

LIN CI (V.O.)
But Jiang He and my best friend Li Siqi were hugging each other. I was betrayed by my best friend.

Back to reality, the smile on LIN CI's face disappears, replaced by shock and pain. The love letter slips from her hand and floats to the ground. She angrily throws the letter at the embracing couple.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

LIN CI (23 years old) suddenly wakes up from the hospital bed, bandages wrapped around her head, a look of terror on her face.

A DOCTOR enters the room.

DOCTOR
Young Madam, you're awake. How are you feeling?

LIN CI
(disoriented)
Young Madam? I'm Lin Ci. What happened to me?

LIN CI sees the electronic clock on the bedside table displaying "October 9, 2024." Her eyes widen in shock.

LIN CI (V.O.)
Isn't it 2019 now? How can it be 2024?

LIN CI
(to the Doctor)
You're saying I'm twenty-three now, and I aged five years in my sleep?

DOCTOR
You were in a coma. It appears so.

LIN CI
Who did I marry?

DOCTOR
Well, that's—

At this moment, LU BOCHUAN, a handsome man wearing a white coat, walks in. SUPER: LU BOCHUAN, HEIR OF THE LU FAMILY.

DOCTOR
(to Lu Bochuan)
Mr. Lu, the Young Madam is awake.

LIN CI (V.O.)
He's so handsome.

LIN CI
(to Lu Bochuan)
Are you Lu Bochuan? You're the one treating me, right?

LU BOCHUAN
(coldly)
Lin Ci, what are you trying to pull now?

DOCTOR
(to Lu Bochuan)
Mr. Lu, she's lost five years of memory. She doesn't remember you anymore.

LIN CI points at LU BOCHUAN in disbelief.
continuation:
LIN CI
Sir... I'm your wife?

LU BOCHUAN
That's right. I'm your husband of three years, Lu Bochuan. Also the husband you've hated for three years.

FLASHBACK:

LIN CI is grabbed by the arm by LU BOCHUAN. She struggles violently.

LIN CI (in flashback)
Go away, don't touch me!

Back in the hospital room, LIN CI's expression changes from shock to secret delight.

LIN CI (V.O.)
The big boss is my husband!

LIN CI looks at LU BOCHUAN shyly and happily.

LIN CI
(bashfully)
Honey... hug me.

The DOCTOR tactfully prepares to leave.

DOCTOR
Well... I won't disturb you two then.

LU BOCHUAN (V.O.)
She's actually willing to let me touch her.

LU BOCHUAN walks toward LIN CI and extends his hand. LIN CI also reaches out to touch him.

FLASHBACK:

A WOMAN questions LU BOCHUAN.

WOMAN (in flashback)
If it weren't to repay a debt of gratitude, would you have married Lin Ci?

LU BOCHUAN (in flashback)
No.

Another flashback, the WOMAN is hit by a car on the road.

Back in the hospital room, LIN CI suddenly clutches her head in severe pain.

LIN CI
Ah!

LU BOCHUAN
(anxiously)
Headache?

LIN CI (V.O.)
(chaotic images flash through her mind)
Affair... I thought this car accident... How is he just like Jiang He, the guy I blindly had a crush on in college? They're both scumbags. How is my taste always so bad?

LIN CI
(pushing Lu Bochuan away)
Don't touch me! I'm fine, perfectly fine!

LIN CI gets out of bed herself, but her body is weak.

LU BOCHUAN (V.O.)
Sure enough, even with amnesia, she won't let me touch her.

LIN CI's legs give way, she cries out and is about to fall.

LIN CI
Ah!

LU BOCHUAN immediately turns around, his eyes full of concern.

context:
Title: Marrying Behind My Boyfriend's Back After Eight Years
Description: A woman discovers her boyfriend of eight years has grown distant with his new secretary, leading her to agree to an arranged marriage he knows nothing about.

INT. NUANNUAN'S APARTMENT - DAY

Close-up shot, a designer handbag sits on the sofa, next to an open suitcase.

NUANNUAN sits on the sofa, packing her luggage. Her phone BUZZES.

NUANNUAN picks up her phone to check.

The phone screen displays a message.

MOM (V.O.)
Nuannuan, the wedding's in two weeks. Gu Chuan sent these plans—which do you like?

NUANNUAN looks at her phone, her expression dejected.

NUANNUAN (O.S.)
I'm getting married, but my boyfriend of eight years doesn't know. He hired a new secretary last month. Yesterday, he ordered her a three-tier cream cake for her birthday. After eight years, he still "forgets" I'm allergic.

INT. A XIAO'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

FLASHBACK:

A XIAO and ZHANG YUYAN, wearing a white dress, laugh as they wipe cream from their faces.

ZHANG YUYAN (laughing)
You got me!

NUANNUAN walks in, stopping cold. The living room is decorated for a party.

A XIAO and ZHANG YUYAN freeze.

NUANNUAN
A Xiao. What's going on?

ZHANG YUYAN
We were just—

A XIAO lunges for napkins but slips. The cake in his hand flies—

Slow motion close-up, the cake smashes into NUANNUAN's face.

NUANNUAN staggers back, wiping cream from her eyes. She gasps.

A XIAO is laughing, but then realizes it's NUANNUAN. His smile freezes.

NUANNUAN tastes the cream. Her face changes. She starts coughing, struggling to breathe.

A XIAO
Nuannuan? I thought you were at your conference—

NUANNUAN clutches her chest and collapses to the floor.

A XIAO (panicking)
Nuannuan!

A XIAO rushes to support her.

ZHANG YUYAN (fearfully)
Is she...?

A XIAO (frantically)
Call 120! NOW!

ZHANG YUYAN
I'm calling!
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

The DOCTOR and NURSES rush down the corridor pushing NUANNUAN on a hospital bed. A XIAO follows alongside, looking anxious.

A XIAO
Please save her!

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

NUANNUAN lies in the hospital bed, receiving an IV drip. A XIAO stands by the bed. The DOCTOR is speaking to him.

DOCTOR
Severe anaphylaxis. Another ten minutes, we might've lost her.

The DOCTOR shakes his head and leaves.

A XIAO walks to the bedside and holds NUANNUAN's hand.

A XIAO
Nuannuan, I'm so sorry. I forgot—

NUANNUAN opens her eyes and looks at him.

NUANNUAN
(raspy)
You celebrated her birthday... in our home.

A XIAO
Nuannuan, you...

A XIAO's phone rings. He walks aside to answer it.

A XIAO
Hello?

ZHANG YUYAN (V.O.)
(crying)
Brother A Xiao? I'm at the office alone. The security alarm went off. I think someone's breaking in.

A XIAO
Yuyan, get out. Call building security—

ZHANG YUYAN (V.O.)
Please come. I'm scared.

A XIAO hangs up and turns to NUANNUAN.

NUANNUAN (O.S.)
Go save your secretary.

A XIAO
Nuannuan, it's a real emergency. I'll be back.

A XIAO turns and hurries away.

NUANNUAN lies in bed, devastated, tears streaming down her face.

After a while, NUANNUAN struggles to sit up and picks up her phone. She scrolls through it—seeing a photo of A Xiao and Zhang Yuyan, heads together at a restaurant, posted last night.

NUANNUAN dials.

NUANNUAN
Mom. Tell Gu Chuan I accept. And move the wedding up.

She hangs up, staring at the ceiling. The tears stop. Her expression hardens into resolve.

context:
Title: Universe Cave Heaven
Description: An immortal cultivator confronts the embodiment of the Heavenly Dao to break through the barriers of time and return to the mortal realm.

INT. IMMORTAL REALM - DAY

The Immortal Realm, shrouded in clouds and mist. Giant floating stone islands hover in the air, waterfalls cascading from their edges, frozen mid-flow.

CHEN YULONG, magnificent armor bearing a charred scar across the chestplate, sits cross-legged on a floating rock. A golden light formation flickers around him, unstable.

He opens his eyes. The light fades.

CHEN YULONG
(to himself)
Three hundred years, and still the mortal heart beats beneath immortal skin.

He touches his chest. A faint blue lotus tattoo pulses, then disappears.

EXT. ENTRANCE TO THE RIVER OF TIME - DAY

Chen Yulong stands at the edge of a cliff. Below, time flows as liquid silver.

The sky changes color. A massive blue vortex appears.

CHEN YULONG
(alert)
So you knew I was coming.

The HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT emerges from the vortex, an old man in white robes woven with constellations.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
I am the guardian of all cause and effect. You achieved Immortal Venerable to escape grief. Do not throw away eternity for a ghost.

CHEN YULONG
She is not a ghost to me.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
Return to your cultivation. The mortal world has forgotten you.

CHEN YULONG
Then I will remind them.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
I have witnessed ten thousand ascensions. All who return become less than memory.

Chen Yulong draws his sword. The blade bears a single notch near the hilt.

CHEN YULONG
This notch remembers. That is enough.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
Infinite Universe, Ten Directions Earth Treasury!

The sky fractures. Crystal pillars of causality descend.

CHEN YULONG
Azure Lotus Sword Art.
continuation:
His sword meets the first pillar. The impact ripples through his arm.

A lightning bolt tears through his shoulder, leaving a smoking wound.

CHEN YULONG
(strained)
Sword Wind.

He deflects the bolt, but staggers. Blood drips from his gauntlet.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
You bleed eternity. How much can you lose before you are no longer yourself?

CHEN YULONG
(steady)
As much as it takes.

He channels energy. The sword's notch glows blue.

CHEN YULONG
Azure Lotus Sword Art. Sword Force.

The golden net of sword qi strikes. The Heavenly Dao Embodiment flickers, briefly transparent.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
(surprised)
You use your own soul as blade edge?

CHEN YULONG
What else would I use?

Chen Yulong's charred scar spreads across his armor. His hair shows a streak of white.

CHEN YULONG
(shouting)
Azure Lotus Sword Art! Sword Song!

A massive golden sword shadow erupts from his blade, consuming the Heavenly Dao Embodiment. As the embodiment shatters, he laughs.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
You win the battle. But against time... you will lose yourself.

The vortex collapses. Chen Yulong falls to one knee, breathing heavily.

EXT. MOUNTAIN PEAK IN THE MORTAL REALM - DAY

Chen Yulong materializes, sword planted in earth to support himself. He is visibly aged, armor cracked beyond repair.

He gazes at a distant village. A blue lotus blooms in the valley below.

CHEN YULONG
(quietly)
The pond... it still holds water.

He touches the notch in his sword—now cold.

He transforms into a white light and vanishes.

context:
Title: After Divorce, CEO Lu Becomes a Simp and Helps Me with My Shoes
Description: A woman diagnosed with terminal liver cancer discovers her husband's mistress is pregnant and decides to end her three-year marriage to live for herself.

INT. HOSPITAL - DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

GU XINGMAN sits across from the DOCTOR.

DOCTOR
Miss Gu, you have late-stage liver cancer. I'm afraid you only have a year left.

GU XINGMAN's breath catches. She reaches for the report, fingers trembling. Stares at the words until they blur. A tear lands on the paper. She doesn't wipe it away.

INT. HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - DAY

GU XINGMAN moves through the hospital corridor, the report clutched to her chest. The world blurs around her.

She stops by a window, fishing out her phone. The lock screen shows a wedding photo: her and a man, smiling.

A notification appears: BAI JINROU. A message.

She opens it. An ultrasound. Then a photo of her husband's watch—on a nightstand she recognizes—next to a pregnancy test. Two lines. A third photo: the same watch, on Bai Jinrou's wrist in a mirror selfie. No words. None needed.

Gu's hand goes slack. The diagnosis report slips, pages scattering. She stares at the images, then at her reflection in the window. A woman crumbling from the inside out.
continuation:
EXT. LU FAMILY VILLA - DAY

An aerial shot of the manicured estate. Text on screen: LU ESTATE, 3 YEARS LATER.

INT. LU FAMILY - LIVING ROOM - DAY

Fresh lilies overflow from crystal vases. The HOUSEKEEPER adjusts their stems.

GU XINGMAN enters, her keys clicking on marble. She inhales—and a ragged cough tears through her. She covers her mouth, body convulsing.

HOUSEKEEPER
Madam? The master requested these. Said the roses were... predictable.

Gu straightens, wiping her watering eyes. She approaches the vase, running a finger along a petal. Her throat itches. Her skin flushes where pollen touched.

Without a word, she plucks a lily. Crushes it in her fist. The petals bruise, then tear. She opens her hand. The mangled pieces fall like confetti.

She climbs the stairs without looking back.

INT. LU CORPORATION - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

LU SIYE sits at the head of the table, checking his watch. ASSISTANT HE hovers nearby.

ASSISTANT HE
The quarterly review begins in two minutes. Secretary Gu isn't responding.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
She's never missed a board meeting. Not once.

LU SIYE dials. Voicemail. His knuckles whiten.

LU SIYE
(to Assistant)
Find her.

ASSISTANT HE
Yes, sir.

The door swings open.

GU XINGMAN (O.S.)
Looking for me?

GU XINGMAN stands in the doorway, red silk dress cutting through the beige corporate landscape. Sunglasses hide her eyes. She holds a manila envelope—not her usual leather portfolio.

She walks to the head of the table, each step deliberate, and sets the envelope before Lu SiYe.

The room holds its breath.

title: The Transmigrated Princess's Counterattack Strategy
description: A modern forensic pathologist is transported into the body of a betrayed princess consort who lost everything to a scheming concubine and her cruel husband.
context:
Title: The Transmigrated Princess's Counterattack Strategy
Description: A modern forensic pathologist is transported into the body of a betrayed princess consort who lost everything to a scheming concubine and her cruel husband.

INT. PRINCE'S MANOR BEDROOM - DAY

LING SIWAN sits on the bed, leisurely stirring a bowl of medicinal tonic with a silver spoon.

THE PRINCESS CONSORT kneels on the ground, clothes disheveled, blood at the corner of her mouth, her expression a blend of grief and banked fury.

PRINCESS CONSORT
(coldly)
If it's revenge you want, take it from me. But my child—he's innocent. Give him back.

LING SIWAN
(sinisterly sweet)
Sister, don't be dramatic. You caused my fall—accidents happen. Though I must admit, your child's... gift... has done wonders for my recovery.

The PRINCESS CONSORT's eyes widen with comprehension. She lunges at LING SIWAN, grabbing her throat with trembling hands.

PRINCESS CONSORT
(hoarsely)
You monster.

The PRINCE rushes in and shoves the PRINCESS CONSORT away. She collapses.

PRINCE
(furious, weary)
Still at it? Even now?

PRINCESS CONSORT
(coughing blood, laughing bitterly)
She used our child for her medicine, and you ask if I'm still at it?

MAID
(rushing to support her)
Your Highness, the physician said she mustn't be distressed—her vitals are already—

PRINCE
I don't care! She had an affair and birthed that bastard. She deserves every ounce of this.

PRINCESS CONSORT
(quietly, dangerously)
It was that night. The fire. You were delirious. I carried you out.

LING SIWAN
(feigning shock)
Sister... the stable boy with the lazy eye? Even for a lonely noblewoman, that's desperation. The whole manor knows. Just admit it.

PRINCE
(explosive, embarrassed)
Stop lying! I defended you to the court, to my father. And this is how you repay me?

The PRINCE turns to leave. LING SIWAN walks past, her heel "accidentally" grinding into the PRINCESS CONSORT's hand.

The PRINCESS CONSORT lies motionless, blood pooling beneath her.

PRINCESS CONSORT (V.O.)
Chu Chen'an, when you learn it was my blood that saved you, my body that warmed you that night—regret won't be a sharp enough word.
continuation:
EXT. ANTIQUE ARCHITECTURE PLAZA - DAY

A SCIENTIST sits on a rideable suitcase, watching a short drama, shaking her head.

SCIENTIST
Five episodes of "Chasing Wife to Crematorium" and she hasn't even planted a single piece of forged evidence. Amateur hour.

She accelerates the suitcase, swerving to avoid a CHILD crossing her path while shouting.

SCIENTIST
Watch it! Garbage sorting is a civic duty!

The suitcase clips a stone pillar. The SCIENTIST is launched into the air, strikes her head, and crashes down, unconscious.

PASSERSBY gather.

PASSERBY A
Someone call emergency services!

PASSERBY B
Is she breathing?

The scene flashes between the SCIENTIST's bleeding temple and the PRINCESS CONSORT's lifeless form.

INT. PRINCE'S MANOR BEDROOM - DAY

THE PRINCESS CONSORT lies on the bed, eyes snapping open—cold, clinical, assessing her surroundings like a crime scene.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

context:
Title: Ultimate Teacher
Description: A man named Su Ming accepts a challenge to reform the worst school in the province within a month to win a marriage contract with a beautiful CEO, aided by a mysterious system.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

On a rainy day, a man in a leather jacket, SU MING, stands on the rooftop holding a black umbrella.

SU MING (V.O.)
Longhua Academy. Not a school anymore—just a warehouse for problems the system gave up on. Ranked dead last province-wide.

FLASHBACK:

Students in uniform loiter in chaotic clusters. One group huddles around a phone, another shoves a classmate against a locker.

BACK TO PRESENT:

On the exterior wall behind SU MING, a weathered poster reads: "REFORM ACADEMY, WIN CONTRACT" beside a photo of CEO QIAO XUE.

SU MING (V.O.)
If I can pull them back from the brink in thirty days... I win a marriage contract with CEO Qiao Xue. The terms are clear.

SU MING's knuckles tighten on the umbrella handle, rainwater streaming from the spokes.

SU MING (V.O.)
They were my classmates once. I know exactly how they think.

A STATIC HISS fills the air. Geometric equations materialize, glowing faint blue around SU MING's silhouette.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Umbrella Protocol activated. Experience-based behavioral correction will trigger reward distribution.

SU MING flinches, fingers brushing his earpiece.

SU MING
System?

SU MING (to himself)
Two years in the wilderness. About time the universe cashed its debt.

SU MING's jaw sets. He snaps the umbrella shut.

SU MING
Let's see what dead last really looks like.

He strides past the poster. His fingers tear it from the wet brick as he passes.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Commencing operation.
continuation:
INT. PRINCIPAL'S OFFICE - DAY

Modern campus buildings visible through floor-to-ceiling windows.

SU MING waits by the window, arms crossed. His dry shirt suggests he's changed since the rooftop.

Sharp FOOTSTEPS. QIAO XUE (late 20s, sharp suit, glasses) enters, tablet in hand.

Her presence catches SU MING's attention. He subtly straightens his posture.

SU MING (quietly)
Impressive.

QIAO XUE settles behind the desk, scrolling through the tablet.

QIAO XUE
The certificate photo didn't do you justice, Mr. Su. You're the ninety-ninth candidate this year. The others broke contracts, not students.

SU MING
I don't break easily. Though I'm curious—is the contract clause still binding?

QIAO XUE
One month. Measurable improvement in behavior metrics. Today's monthly exam is your baseline assessment. Ready to observe?

SU MING
I'll need a uniform.

QIAO XUE (puzzled)
You're administrative staff.

SU MING (leaning forward, precisely)
Tigers don't change their stripes from the observation deck.

title: After My Husband Cheated, I Became a Matchmaker
description: A woman discovers her husband and best friend's betrayal while battling terminal illness on a hospital rooftop.
context:
Title: After My Husband Cheated, I Became a Matchmaker
Description: A woman discovers her husband and best friend's betrayal while battling terminal illness on a hospital rooftop.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOFTOP - NIGHT

XUE NING supports SU LI, who is wearing a patient gown and hat, as they walk on the rooftop.

SU LI
Xue Ning, thank you for these nights. I know Yan Li's been working late. You shouldn't have to--

XUE NING
(smiling gently)
What are best friends for? Yan Li wanted tonight to be perfect. He'll be here soon.

XUE NING and SU LI stop at a bench. XUE NING holds SU LI's hand.

XUE NING
We prepared something. Wait by the trellis? He wants to see your face when you see it.

XUE NING leads SU LI to a corner with a decorative trellis, partially hidden by hanging vines. XUE NING makes a "shh" gesture, then turns and leaves.

SU LI leans against the wall, her face showing an expectant smile.

XUE NING walks to the other side. JI YAN LI approaches, and they embrace.

SU LI overhears from her spot. The smile fades.

JI YAN LI
(quietly, to XUE NING)
The lawyer called. Papers are ready.

XUE NING
(softly)
We should wait. She's weaker tonight.

JI YAN LI
We've waited six months. Every day she holds on, we're--
continuation:
XUE NING
(lowered voice)
--I know. But she trusts us.

A beat of silence. Su Li's tears begin. She shifts, and a small decorative stone falls from the ledge.

JI YAN LI and XUE NING turn abruptly.

SU LI staggers out from behind the trellis, clutching her hat.

SU LI
(trembling, but controlled)
Six months.

JI YAN LI
(hesitating, not angry)
Li, you don't understand--

SU LI
(pointing, voice breaking)
I understand perfectly. The late nights. The "gala planning." The way you stopped touching my head when the hair fell out.

JI YAN LI steps forward, not in fury, but panic.

JI YAN LI
Stop. You're making yourself sick--

He reaches for her arm. She jerks back. He grabs harder, instinctively. The hat falls.

SU LI
(different voice)
Let. Go.

She yanks free. Her legs buckle from chemo-weakness, not his force. She goes down, catching herself on the trellis. The hat lies on the ground, bald head exposed.

JI YAN LI stares at his hands. XUE NING moves toward Su Li, then freezes mid-step.

SU LI is on her knees, not crying hysterically, but making a sound like she's dying all over again—quiet, breathless, final.

Title: My Teacher (Episode 46)
Description: A devoted rural teacher helps his three female students escape their families' attempts to stop them from attending prestigious universities abroad, sacrificing himself to ensure their departure.

EXT. RURAL DIRT ROAD - DAY

A pockmarked dirt road bakes under midday sun. Dust motes hang in the air. TEACHER LIN ZHIYUAN (50s, threadbare shirt, deeply weathered hands) stands with three young women: SU HONGYU (clutching a patched duffel bag), JIANG QING (gripping a worn suitcase), and LIN QINGQING (holding a canvas satchel with paint stains). Their luggage sits at their feet, dust-covered.

Lin Zhiyuan reaches into his pocket and pulls out three envelopes, his fingers trembling slightly.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Hongyu. Jiang Qing. Qingqing.

He places an envelope in each student's hand, lingering on the touch.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Keep them safe. Right next to your passports.

SU HONGYU
(quietly)
Teacher, your hands...

She notices his knuckles are raw, nails cracked.

JIANG QING
You sold the last of the rice paddies.

LIN ZHIYUAN
The soil was tired anyway.

LIN QINGQING
(whispering)
Uncle...

Lin Zhiyuan meets her eyes. A shared understanding passes between them.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Your scholarships cover tuition. This... this just covers distance.

A distant engine. They all turn. A minibus appears, kicking up red dust.

Lin Zhiyuan quickly loads their luggage into the bus hold, his movements urgent but gentle.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Go now. Before your parents finish market.

SU HONGYU
(turning back)
Teacher, they'll know you helped.

LIN ZHIYUAN
(smiling)
I'm just an old teacher. What can they do, make me teach more?

But his smile doesn't reach his eyes.

He herds them toward the open bus door. As they climb in, the sound of ANGRY SHOUTS cuts through the air.

Down the road, LIN ZHIJIANG leads a group of VILLAGERS at a dead run. LIN QINGQING's father carries a broken broom handle.

LIN ZHIJIANG
(shouting)
Lin Zhiyuan! Stop that bus!

SU HONGYU'S MOTHER sprints ahead, her market basket abandoned.

SU HONGYU'S MOTHER
continuation:
Hongyu! Get down from there!

Lin Zhiyuan SLAMS the bus door shut and bangs on the side.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Driver! Go!

The minibus lurches forward. Through the window, we see the girls' faces pressed against the glass.

Lin Zhiyuan stands in the road, arms spread wide, blocking the pursuing villagers.

LIN ZHIJIANG
Qingqing, if you leave, you're dead to this family!

LIN QINGQING
(from the bus)
Dad, please!

Lin Zhiyuan grabs Lin Zhijiang's arm, pulling him away from the moving bus. The other villagers swarm.

A fist catches Lin Zhiyuan's jaw. He staggers. The broken broom handle swings at his ribs. He goes down in the dust.

Inside the bus, the girls witness this.

JIANG QING
(screaming)
No!

SU HONGYU
Teacher!

Lin Zhiyuan curls on the ground, shielding his head, but his eyes find the bus. He mouths one word: "Go."

The bus accelerates. The villagers' figures shrink in the dust.

LIN QINGQING
(whispering)
He's still down...

INT. MINIBUS - DAY

The bus rattles over potholes. The three young women stand in the aisle, gripping seatbacks for balance. They exchange looks—guilt, terror, determination.

Lin Qingqing fumbles with her envelope. Inside, besides the ticket, there's a folded sketch: a crude drawing of four figures under a tree, childish but recognizable. Their teacher and them, years ago.

Her hands shake.

LIN QINGQING
We never asked what it cost him.

SU HONGYU
We never had to.

Jiang Qing pulls out her own ticket envelope. Inside, a small, pressed wildflower falls out. She catches it.

JIANG QING
We know.

Lin Qingqing looks at the sketch, then toward the rear window where dust still hangs in the air.

LIN QINGQING
Then we know what we have to do.

They don't kneel. They simply stand there, three young women watching their village disappear, their teacher's blood still drying on the road behind them.

FADE OUT.

Title: Master Bo's Rise Through His Son
Description: A young maid is coerced into delivering drugged soup to a wealthy young master, leading to an unexpected night together and a life-changing consequence.

INT. LUXURIOUS ROOM - NIGHT

Candlelight flickers. BO XIANGQIU, late twenties and sharp-featured in a black silk shirt, sits alone in a leather armchair, swirling a glass of red wine. A legal document lies on his lap—he's been staring at the same paragraph for minutes.

AN QIAN, nineteen, appears at the doorway holding a porcelain soup bowl, her expression hollow.

AN JINCAI, forty-five with a small mustache, intercepts her in the corridor. He produces a white pill and drops it into the steaming soup. It dissolves instantly.

AN JINCAI
(quietly, almost fatherly)
Your grandmother's surgery deposit—paid in full.
(leans closer)
He's had three bottles. He won't remember. You won't either.

He squeezes her shoulder and disappears. An Qian stares at the bowl, then forces herself forward.

AN QIAN
Young Master... your sobering soup.

BO XIANGQIU looks up, sets his wine down. He studies her trembling hands, her downcast eyes.

BO XIANGQIU
You're new.

AN QIAN
(whisper)
Two months.

Something in her voice makes him pause. He reaches for the bowl.

BO XIANGQIU
Then you should know—I don't bite.

He drinks it in three measured sips, holding her gaze. An Qian watches his throat work, her own constricting.

The wine glass suddenly tips—Bo jerks, trying to catch it. It shatters against the floor. Wine bleeds across marble. He grabs the chair arm, knuckles whitening.

BO XIANGQIU
continuation:
What the...

He stands, swaying. His eyes find An Qian's—confusion giving way to dawning horror.

BO XIANGQIU (CONT'D)
You...

An Qian backs away, but the bed blocks her path. She falls onto it as Bo staggers forward. He collapses onto the mattress, his body pinning hers. She goes rigid, a strangled sound escaping.

An Qian's hands push against his chest—futile. Bo's fingers find her wrist, his grip surprisingly gentle even as his consciousness fades.

BO XIANGQIU (CONT'D)
(slurred)
Don't... be afraid...

He leans down. The candlelight flickers out.

ON SCREEN: TWO MONTHS LATER

INT. MANSION LIVING ROOM - DAY

AN QIAN walks out of a room looking anxious, her hand hidden behind her back. Her uniform strains slightly at the waist.

MAN'S VOICE (O.S.)
Where is she?

AN QIAN
(responding hastily)
Coming!

She stops, turns the pregnancy test over with trembling fingers.

CLOSE-UP: Two stark red lines.

AN QIAN (V.O.)
(quiet, shattered)
Grandma's medicine is expensive. This costs more.

She lifts her head, staring at the door to Bo's wing. Her reflection ghosts in the polished wood—trapped in the same corridor, the same nightmare.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

CHEN HAN
Dad, Mom, please head upstairs. We'll be up for the tea ceremony shortly.

LIU'S MOTHER

Subtle. Send our regards.

Married.

WANG FANG

Congratulations, Chairman.

Cancel it. Retrieve those black pearls from the vault.

The deep-sea pair you never sell?

LIU QIANQIAN and bridesmaid ZHANG LIYA sit in the luxury sedan.

ON SCREEN: Liu Qianqian, Chen Han's Wife

ZHANG LIYA

Modest security, simple flowers... Qianqian, men test boundaries. We'll establish yours now. Follow my lead.

INT. LU CORPORATION OFFICE - DAY

The POOR GUY sits rigid in a leather chair, hands clenched. The FEMALE LEAD stands at the floor-to-ceiling windows, back to him. Her ASSISTANT waits by a desk.

FEMALE LEAD
Your sister's medical bills. Three hundred thousand. Overdue.

The POOR GUY's jaw tightens.

POOR GUY
How did you—

FEMALE LEAD
(Turning, sliding a contract forward)
I need to disperse five billion from my trust. Charity requirement. I lose everything if I don't.

FEMALE LEAD
Hold it for thirty days. One hundred million is yours. The rest comes back.

continuation:
POOR GUY (V.O.)
One hundred million. Yaoyao's engagement gift. Mom's chemo. A life.

POOR GUY
What's stopping me from keeping it all?

FEMALE LEAD
The same thing stopping me from finding someone else. Mutual destruction.

She leans in, her voice low.

FEMALE LEAD
Sign. Save your family. We'll both get what we need.

The POOR GUY signs. The ASSISTANT slides the black card toward him.

FEMALE LEAD
Welcome to the Lu Corporation's charity program.

Title: Super Powered Baby Finds Daddy
Description: A skilled assassin mother and her gifted daughter escape from a secret organization to find the child's father and seek a cure for her inherited condition.

INT. DARK PAVILION - NIGHT

FAST CUTS of animated imagery: A wolf howling at the moon on a snowy mountain, an ancient tower glowing red, two girls running through streets, then leaping through the night sky.

The animation transitions to live action. YE GE and her daughter TANGTANG hold hands, their figures graceful as they leap from a rooftop and land in a traditional courtyard.

YE GE
Today we leave the Dark Pavilion behind. All of it.

YE GE crouches down, looking at TANGTANG tenderly.

TANGTANG
Mommy, can we find Daddy? Before the cold inside gets worse?

YE GE
(smiling)
That's why we're going.

TANGTANG
(happily)
Will he like my candies?

YE GE
He'll love them.

SFX: Motorcycle engines snarling closer.

TANGTANG
Mommy, someone's coming.

YE GE and TANGTANG quickly put on masks. Several motorcycles rush into the courtyard, surrounding them. ELDER RONG, the leader, gets off his bike. He wears clown makeup and has gray-white hair.

ELDER RONG
continuation:
(laughing maniacally)
The Pavilion's finest, running away with a child? You know the price of betrayal.

YE GE
I taught you everything. Even how to fail.

ELDER RONG
(laughing loudly)
Attack!

TANGTANG
Mommy, let me! Let them taste my candied hawthorn!

TANGTANG takes several spherical objects from her small bag and throws them forcefully at the motorcyclists. The spheres emit bright light upon impact, knocking the targets down.

ELDER RONG
(angrily)
Worthless.

TANGTANG proudly eats one of her "candied hawthorns." ELDER RONG, seeing this, prepares to attack personally.

YE GE
Tangtang, stand back!

YE GE steps forward, her body radiating golden light, transforming into a phoenix form. She engages in fierce combat with ELDER RONG. After several exchanges, YE GE defeats ELDER RONG.

The battle ends. YE GE withdraws her aura and removes her mask.

TANGTANG
Mommy, where are we going to find Daddy?

YE GE gently removes TANGTANG's mask.

YE GE
(eyes determined)
The Imperial Capital.

title: Freeloading Cousin
description: A struggling young man's act of kindness leads to an unexpected opportunity that could change his fortune forever.
context:
Title: Freeloading Cousin
Description: A struggling young man's act of kindness leads to an unexpected opportunity that could change his fortune forever.

INT. ROAST DUCK SHOP - DAY

COUSIN (20s, lean, quick-eyed) sweeps duck debris. His stomach RUMBLES. He glances at a GOLDEN CRISPY DUCK hanging by the counter.

DUCK SELLER (40s, weary) bags a duck for a CUSTOMER. The Customer pays with worn bills.

COUSIN'S eyes track the transaction. As the Customer turns, a piece of duck skin slides from the bag. In one fluid motion, Cousin catches it, pops it in his mouth.

DUCK SELLER
(catching him)
Hey! What're you doing?

COUSIN
(chewing, casual)
Cousin, just checking it's not spoiled.

DUCK SELLER
(snatching the broom)
Spoiled my ass. You work three days, you eat for free. Those are the rules.

COUSIN
(grinning)
Guess I'm still on day two, then.

EXT. COUSIN'S HOUSE ENTRANCE - DAY

Rain drizzles. GRANDPA (80s, frail but sharp) clutches a faded PHOTO of young Cousin with his parents.

OLDER COUSIN (30s, well-fed) and his WIFE hustle Grandpa toward a waiting car.

OLDER COUSIN
We're late. Let's go.

Grandpa turns back. Cousin stands in the doorway, holding a WARM BOILED EGG.

COUSIN
Grandpa. For the road.

Grandpa takes it. Their hands touch. The rain falls harder between them. Grandpa's mouth trembles, but no words come. He nods once, slow and heavy.

The car door SLAMS. Tail lights vanish into the gray downpour.

EXT. WAREHOUSE - DAY

Cousin hauls fifty-pound rice sacks. Sweat darkens his camo shirt. He stacks them with machine precision.

BOSS (50s, gruff) counts cash, then holds out THREE RED BILLS.

BOSS
Five days. No complaints.

Cousin takes the money. Counts it. Folds it carefully into his shoe.

COUSIN
Thank you, boss.

BOSS
(shrugging)
You earned it. Come back Monday.

EXT. OLD HOUSE - DAY

Cousin trudges up to a sagging wooden house. Paint peels like old skin. He stops on the steps, exhausted.

QIAN CAIQING (20s, beautiful despite threadbare clothes) sits on a stool, dabbing her lips with crushed petals for color. She spots him and smiles.

QIAN CAIQING
Tough day?

COUSIN
Forces a smile. Pulls out the three bills.

COUSIN
Got us something.

He produces a small BUNDLE: second-hand clothes. She unfolds a dress. The SEAM splits slightly.

QIAN CAIQING
(laughing despite herself)
Champion of the discount bins.

COUSIN
(defensive)
The vendor said it was last year's style—

QIAN CAIQING
(pressing finger to his lips)
Hush. It's perfect.

She holds it against her body, twirls. For a moment, they both forget the roof leaks.

COUSIN
Your mother called again?

QIAN CAIQING
(sighs)
She wants twenty thousand dowry. Or we wait another year.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

Cousin walks the crowded street in his warehouse camo. Billboards advertise LUXURY CARS, MANSIONS. He looks at his cracked phone screen: 86 RMB balance.

A siren WAILS in the distance.

EXT. ROAST DUCK SHOP - DAY

MR. WANG (60s, elegant but unassuming) guides MRS. WANG (50s, pregnant, radiant) toward the shop.

MR. WANG
The skin is crispier than the city hotels.

MRS. WANG
Then what are we waiting—

A SCREECH of tires. A DELIVERY VAN swerves toward them. Mr. Wang freezes.

Cousin, passing by, SHOVES them aside. The van's MIRROR clips his shoulder. He hits the ground hard.

Mrs. Wang screams. Blood pools beneath her.

MR. WANG
(frantic)
Someone call an ambulance!

COUSIN
(clutching his arm)
Hospital's two blocks. My tricycle's faster.

He points to a battered THREE-WHEELER with a cargo bed.

EXT. HOSPITAL - CONTINUOUS

Cousin pedals wildly through traffic, Mr. Wang cradling Mrs. Wang in back.

MR. WANG
(holding her bleeding head)
Stay with me. Please stay.

INT. HOSPITAL EMERGENCY ROOM - DAY

DOCTOR (40s, calm, urgent) and NURSES wheel Mrs. Wang away. Mr. Wang tries to follow. A NURSE stops him.

NURSE
Wait here.

MR. WANG
(to Cousin, trembling)
You saved us. Thank you.

COUSIN
(grimacing at his own cut)
She'll be okay. Strong lady.

MR. WANG
How can I ever—

COUSIN
Just doing what's right.

The Doctor emerges, pulling off bloody gloves.

DOCTOR
Mr. Wang? Your wife has severe internal bleeding. She needs AB negative. We have... one unit. We need three.

MR. WANG
I'll pay anything. Import it.

DOCTOR
No time. The nearest is two hours away.

COUSIN
(quietly)
I'm AB negative.

MR. WANG
(turning to him)
What?

COUSIN
Test me. If it matches, take it.

INT. HOSPITAL - BLOOD DRAW ROOM - DAY

Cousin lies on a bed, tube in his arm. Blood flows dark red into a bag. He watches it, pale.

Mr. Wang sits beside him, holds his other hand.

MR. WANG
I have no children. This baby was... our hope. Now I just want my wife.

COUSIN
You'll have both.

MR. WANG
Why are you doing this?

COUSIN
Someone once told me: when you can give, you give. That's all.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - LATER

Cousin stumbles out, arm bandaged. Mr. Wang supports him.

COUSIN
(weak smile)
You owe me a watermelon. The expensive kind.

MR. WANG
(laughs through tears)
I'll buy you the whole farm.

The Doctor reappears.

DOCTOR
She's stable. Your blood saved her.

MR. WANG
(to Cousin)
My name is Wang Dekuang. My home is empty. Too empty. If you ever need...

INT. HOSPITAL LOBBY - LATER

BUTLER LIN (50s, precise) arrives with TWO BODYGUARDS. He takes in Cousin's bloodied camo, the bandage.

BUTLER LIN
Mr. Wang? Is Madam—

MR. WANG
Stable. Thanks to this young man. Where's the village project file?

BUTLER LIN
(pulling out a TABLET)
Ready. But sir, the board—

MR. WANG
(to Cousin)
You understand hard work. You understand sacrifice. Our rural education initiative needs someone who's lived it. Not another MBA.

COUSIN
(confused)
Me? I barely finished high school.

MR. WANG
You finished life school. Top of your class. Try it. Three months. Paid.

BUTLER LIN
(softly, to Mr. Wang)
Sir, his background check—

MR. WANG
I know exactly who he is. The only person who mattered when my world was ending.

Butler Lin hesitates, then bows to Cousin.

BUTLER LIN
Young Master Wang. Welcome to Kuangshi Group.

COUSIN
(overwhelmed)
I just wanted the watermelon.

MR. WANG
(chuckling)
You'll get it. And maybe a future worth building.

context:
Title: Return of the Dragon King
Description: A legendary Dragon King loses his wife to terrorists and abandons his power to live in mourning, seeking vengeance against the Death God organization.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY

A crude wooden tombstone stands in the wilderness, inscribed with "Tomb of Beloved Wife Shen Wenwan."

LI PING'AN, in tattered clothes and unshaven, kneels before the grave, holding a wine flask. He pours a last drop onto the earth.

LI PING'AN
(quietly)
Every day I tell myself I'm done. And every night... I see you.

He touches the tombstone, then pulls his hand back as if burned.

LI PING'AN
(whispering)
I'm sorry.

His shoulders tremble, but he makes no sound.

DISSOLVE TO:

INT. ABANDONED BUILDING - DAY (THREE YEARS AGO)

SUPER: THREE YEARS AGO

The PRODIGY DRAGON KING (LI PING'AN) in black armor, sword at the DEMON KING's throat. Around them, defeated terrorists.

PRODIGY DRAGON KING
Your stronghold is dust. Your men are gone. End this.

DEMON KING's mask is cracked, blood seeping through. He coughs a laugh.

DEMON KING
You think this is the end? We knew you'd come. Death God knows your true weakness.

The Dragon King's grip tightens.

PRODIGY DRAGON KING
What did you do?

DEMON KING
(gasping)
Three squads. Fire Mountain Village. By the time you hear this... she's already ash.

The Dragon King's sword clatters to the ground. He grabs the Demon King by the throat.

PRODIGY DRAGON KING
(voice deadly quiet)
Liar.

DEMON KING
(strangled)
Check... your phone. The Death God organization... will be waiting.

The Prodigy Dragon King's palm strikes. The Demon King disintegrates.

PRODIGY DRAGON KING
Bastard! Go to hell!
continuation:
EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

LI PING'AN's SUV screams to a halt at the village edge. He stumbles out, armor half-removed, phone showing fifteen missed calls.

EXT. FIRE MOUNTAIN VILLAGE - DAY

BING FENG meets him halfway, her expression saying everything. Behind her, Shen Wenwan's body lies covered.

LI PING'AN
(stumbling)
No. No, I ordered—

BING FENG
They were waiting. They knew our response time.

LI PING'AN pushes past her to the body. He pulls back the cloth. Sees the gold ring on her finger, the one he gave her before he left.

LI PING'AN
(voice hollow)
I told her she was safe. I promised.

He doesn't roar. He goes still, like something inside him has snapped.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY (THREE YEARS AGO)

LI PING'AN digs the grave himself, places the wooden marker, then buries his Dragon King insignia at its foot. Subordinates watch from a distance.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY (PRESENT)

LI PING'AN takes out his phone to make a call.

LI PING'AN
Dragon King hotline, transfer to Office Number One. Immediately issue the directive: activate the global Underground Dragon, exterminate the Death God organization.

OFFICE NUMBER ONE (V.O.)
Office Number One, directive received. Activating Underground Dragon, exterminating Death God.

MONTAGE: Rapid cuts of battle sequences across the globe. Underground forces mobilize, launching a comprehensive extermination operation against the Death God organization. Gunfire, explosions, flames shooting into the sky. Each team bears the dragon-and-sword insignia.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

The CHIEF watches the operations on wall screens. LI PING'AN enters in civilian clothes, face unreadable.

CHIEF
You're burning the network you built. For what? More blood won't bring her back.

LI PING'AN
It'll make sure no one else has to dig a grave like mine.

CHIEF
Your title... your power... you'll lose everything.

LI PING'AN
I already did.

The Chief hands him an envelope.

CHIEF
Her parents found this. She wrote it the week she died.

LI PING'AN takes it, doesn't open it.

LI PING'AN
When it's finished.

He turns to leave.

CHIEF
Ping'an... you can't outrun what you are.

LI PING'AN
(over his shoulder)
I'm not running. I'm just a husband keeping his promises.

He walks out, the envelope gripped tight. Through the window, we see him stop in the courtyard, looking at the sky—finally free of the weight, but utterly alone.

FADE OUT.

The camera pans across a rundown farmhouse courtyard.

It's Double Ninth again.

What did you do? Lili, why?

Title: Elder Brother as Father
Description: A young boy desperately tries to find a home for his sister after their parents' death, flashing back to a tragic family dinner one month prior.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

CHEN DACHUN and CHEN WENWEN kneel before a silver sedan, kowtowing to a well-dressed MAN and WOMAN loading luggage.

CHEN DACHUN
(voice cracking)
She's all I have left. I can't keep her safe anymore.

MAN
Jesus Christ... stand up, kid. We're not—where are your relatives?

CHEN DACHUN
Dead. All of them. Please. She'll be no trouble.

WOMAN
(softening)
How old are you?

CHEN DACHUN
Twelve. Too young to work. Too young to be her father.

The woman crouches, studying Wenwen's face. Dachun pulls a small locket from his pocket.

CHEN DACHUN
(continuing)
This is our mother's. So she won't forget.

He presses the locket into Wenwen's palm, forcing her fingers closed.

CUT TO:

Black screen with white text: ONE MONTH AGO

EXT. FARMHOUSE COURTYARD - NIGHT

Fireflies drift through twilight. CHEN DACHUN helps his younger siblings—CHEN BIN and CHEN XIAOYUN—catch them in jars.

MOTHER (O.S.)
Dachun! Bring them in. The chicken's getting cold.

CHEN DACHUN
Last one, Mom!

He lets the firefly go. The children sprint inside.
continuation:
INT. FARMHOUSE - NIGHT

Oil lamp light flickers across a modest feast—vegetables, peanuts, and one steamed chicken. FATHER bounces CHEN XIAOYUN on his knee.

CHEN XIAOYUN
Mom only cooks chicken on special days! I want the drumstick.

CHEN BIN
Me too! I called it first!

CHEN DACHUN
(cutting calmly)
Drumsticks go to the youngest. That's the rule.

FATHER winks at Dachun, mouthing "good man."

MOTHER
Dachun, you're the oldest. You know what everyone needs.

CHEN DACHUN
Yes, Mom.

He tears the drumsticks, placing them on Bin and Xiaoyun's bowls.

CHEN DACHUN
(to CHEN WENWEN)
Second sister?

CHEN WENWEN
The wing tip. It has the best flavor. Mom always says so.

Dachun smiles, separating the wing tips for his parents' bowls.

CHEN DACHUN
Here. The best parts.

FATHER
You eat them. Dad's happy with peanuts.

MOTHER
And Mom loves vegetables. You eat.

CHEN DACHUN
(lowering his voice)
Please. I divided them already.

FATHER's eyes glisten. He squeezes MOTHER's hand.

FATHER
Our boy's growing up too fast.

MOTHER winces, touching her temple briefly, but forces a smile.

MOTHER
Then let's eat before it gets cold.

They raise their chopsticks. MOTHER sways. Her bowl slips.

FATHER
Wife?

She seizes, chair tipping back, and crashes to the floor.

CHEN WENWEN
Mom!

FATHER catches her head, shouting toward the door.

FATHER
Dachun—get Doctor Li! Now!

Dachun freezes, staring at MOTHER's pale face. Wenwen yanks his arm.

CHEN WENWEN
Go!

He bolts out the door. The remaining children collapse around MOTHER, wailing.

CUT TO:

EXT. FARMHOUSE - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS)

Dachun sprints down the dirt path, clutching the chicken wing he grabbed from MOTHER's bowl. His shadow stretches long under the moonlight.

FATHER (V.O.)
You eat, you eat.

The wing trembles in his fist. He runs faster, tears flying behind him.

title: Zero Degree Ambiguity
description: A couple bound by a marriage of convenience struggles with their conflicting emotions as physical attraction complicates their agreement to stay distant.

Title: Zero Degree Ambiguity
Description: A couple bound by a marriage of convenience struggles with their conflicting emotions as physical attraction complicates their agreement to stay distant.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

A projection screen displays a romantic movie. On screen, a man and woman are kissing.

MOVIE FEMALE VOICE (V.O.)
This is a mistake. We're not supposed to—

MOVIE MALE VOICE (V.O.)
I know. Tell me you don't feel it too.

CUT TO:

WEN XUAN lies on the bed, hugging a pillow, watching.

WEN XUAN
(to herself)
Forty episodes for that.

JIAN YUCHEN appears at the door, pulling a suitcase. He looks exhausted.

WEN XUAN sees him and tenses.

WEN XUAN
You're back.

JIAN YUCHEN
The deal closed early.

He notices the screen. A beat.

JIAN YUCHEN
Our blueprint?

WEN XUAN
Background noise.

JIAN YUCHEN removes his jacket, folds it.

JIAN YUCHEN
Guest bathroom's leaking.

WEN XUAN
Maintenance comes tomorrow.

JIAN YUCHEN
Then I'll use this one.

He unbuttons his cuffs. WEN XUAN grips her pillow.

WEN XUAN
continuation:
I'll go.

JIAN YUCHEN
Stay.

He sits on the bed's edge, tugs the blanket lightly.

WEN XUAN
The contract—

JIAN YUCHEN
I wrote every clause.

Movie dialogue swells.

MOVIE FEMALE VOICE (V.O.)
We promised simplicity.

MOVIE MALE VOICE (V.O.)
We lied.

JIAN YUCHEN's fingers brush hers. She doesn't move.

JIAN YUCHEN
Three weeks. No messages.

WEN XUAN
You didn't either.

JIAN YUCHEN
I wrote twelve. Deleted them all.

She searches his face.

WEN XUAN
This is how deals collapse.

JIAN YUCHEN
Let's renegotiate.

He leans in. She could pull back. She doesn't.

WEN XUAN
Distance. Autonomy.

JIAN YUCHEN
Void the contract.

He kisses her. She meets him halfway.

The camera pans to their wedding photo—crooked.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Shock, Poor Wife is Actually a High-Born Heiress

Title: Shock, Poor Wife is Actually a High-Born Heiress
Description: A woman endures humiliation in her husband's family, unaware of her true identity as a wealthy heiress, until fate intervenes.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

ZHENG JIAMING and LAN XIN are intimately embracing.

ZHENG JIAMING
Lan Xin, you make me feel alive again.

LAN XIN
Your wife—does she suspect?

ZHENG JIAMING
Gu Wan? She's too busy scrubbing floors to notice anything. I married her out of pity, but she's been nothing but dead weight.

LAN XIN
Still, three years...

ZHENG JIAMING
Three years of charity. She should be grateful I haven't sent her back to that village.

EXT. STREET - DAY

GU WAN tends to a small herbal medicine stall. A CUSTOMER examines her goods.

PASSERBY (O.S.)
The city patrol is coming!

GU WAN
(to a customer)
Sir, you haven't paid yet—three yuan for the ginseng!

The customer disappears into the crowd. GU WAN scrambles to pack her wares into a worn satchel. Her hands move with practiced urgency.
continuation:
EXT. PARK - DAY

GU WAN sits on a bench, catching her breath. She counts crumpled bills in her palm—clearly insufficient.

GU WAN
(quietly)
Dr. Chen's consultation fee... and Jiaming's mother needs her heart medicine. There has to be a way.

She touches a simple silver locket around her neck—her only jewelry.

ZHENG HUANHUAN strides by with two friends, carrying shopping bags from designer stores. She stops, recognizing GU WAN.

ZHENG HUANHUAN
(tilting her sunglasses down)
Well, well. The charity case is playing shopkeeper now? How delightfully desperate.

GU WAN
(standing)
Zheng Huanhuan. I was properly married into this family. I kept your household running when your mother was ill.

ZHENG HUANHUAN
(clicking her tongue)
A maid's work. Nothing more.

She signals to her friends. They block GU WAN's path.

HUANHUAN'S FRIEND 1
Sister Huan, is this really your sister-in-law? She looks... provincial.

ZHENG HUANHUAN
Let me educate you. This is what happens when my brother tries to be noble. He saved her from poverty, and this is her contribution—embarrassing us in public parks.

She snatches GU WAN's satchel and dumps the carefully wrapped herbs onto the ground.

ZHENG HUANHUAN
Let's see what trash you've been peddling.

GU WAN
(trying to retrieve them)
Those took weeks to harvest!

ZHENG HUANHUAN
(coldly)
And they're worth exactly what you are. Nothing.

She grinds one package under her heel. GU WAN freezes, her hands trembling—not with fear, but restrained fury.

GU WAN
(low voice)
I am still your brother's wife.

ZHENG HUANHUAN
A title, not a truth. Remember your place.

HUANHUAN'S FRIEND 2
Maybe we should help her find her "place." The service entrance is that way.

They laugh. GU WAN meets their eyes steadily, a quiet dignity in her bearing that seems out of place with her worn clothes.

Suddenly, a convoy of three luxury SUVs pulls up. Black-suited bodyguards emerge, scanning the area. One approaches, his eyes fixed on GU WAN's locket.

SENIOR GUARD
(to GU WAN, formally)
Miss. We've been searching for three years. Your grandfather's estate awaits your return.

ZHENG HUANHUAN
(stunned)
What did you call her?

The Senior Guard turns to her with a look of ice.

SENIOR GUARD
Step away from the heir to the Gu Fortune. Now.
